quests.title: Intro
quests.completionMessage: "Wow!  Look at you, all the way up here.  Since you are so resourceful, I have a task for you. However, it will be a little tricky."  [More]

quests.title: Lazeels
quests.completionMessage: "Those flying things you see around here are a breed of Lazeel.  Their larva can be used as a weapon by the Amphibious race.   [More]

quests.title: Item for Plank"l
quests.description: "However, in this case, one of them is carrying something for you to retrieve for me.  When you kill the right one, the item will appear directly in your inventory, so check your inventory regularly."
quests.completionMessage: "Hey, great!  You did it.  Well in return for that I"ll give you this key.  This Key will open some property of mine for use somewhere in the adventures you are about to embark on."  [More]
quests.hint: "Kill Lazeels until Plank"l"s item is found."

quests.title: End
quests.description: "A pleasant journey to you." [End]

quests.title: Magic
quests.completionMessage: So you wish to see my wares? Be careful, the tools in which i deal are dangerous beyond belief.

quests.title: 1. RoE is evil!!
quests.completionMessage: Yes, RoE is back, and they have become more and more dangerous.  They carry with them special tokens...tokens which are a part of a special weapon I hope to create to destroy them!  Bring these tokens to me, and I will reward you, keep it if you wish to try and unlock its powers.

quests.title: 2. Token of Death
quests.description: Bring me this rare token, and I will reward you!  You will have to defeat the lighter of the RoE"s to obtain it, but beware, they are not pansies!
quests.completionMessage: WOW, good job, im sure it took an army to take on of them down!  Well, as I promised, heres my stock of the moment. I"m sorry to hear you didn’t want to unlock the secrets of the token, oh well next time!

quests.title: 3. Token of Fire
quests.description: I hear this is a rare item, and you must defeat a powerful RoE who carries it!  Please get it to me, I need it for a weapon I am building which will help us repel their invasions forever!
quests.completionMessage: EXCELLENT!!  This is great news, if you have beaten him, they must be growing weaker.  Go now and enjoy what I have given you.

quests.title: 4. Token of Wind
quests.description: If you can get this rare, I will reward you with many riches and rare items.  You can also keep it for yourself, and use its powers, if You know what they are.
quests.completionMessage: Perfect.  This is just what I needed to keep me going on this project.  Excellent, heres my current stock, keep killing these horrible invaders and bring me more tokens!

quests.title: 5. Token of the Sea
quests.description: First seen in the deepest region of the Dark Sea, this item is truly rare. It would be an honor to obtain one, and If you have one for trade,  I will reward you!!  If you choose to keep it, and use it, you will have to unlock its secret!
quests.completionMessage: MUAHAHAHA!! I will complete my weapon to defeat these RoE"s!!  They will perish when I have all the parts I need!!

quests.title: 6. Token of Earth
quests.description: Absolutely the rarest of them all, this token will unlock the secrets of their attacks, and will bring us close to the end of their reign of terror!!!  IF you can get this, you must choose if you wish to part with it, it may hold special powers to the person who has it.  I can definatly use it, and I have some extroidanary and truly unique items to trade for it!!
quests.completionMessage: FABULOUS!!!  I cant believe yuou got it, and you want to trade it!!!  I will reward you handsomely.  Thank you very much for your help, soon we will see the end of them!!!  MUAHAHAHA!!!

quests.title: Weapons
quests.completionMessage: "I have a wide selection of creatures and swords that would be perfect for using as a weapon.  If you want to see my selection then press F1 and go to the Store menu. If you are ready for a weapon stronger than the Clawjous, speak to Underworld Fernandez behind the Shapeshifting hut."

quests.title: Purchase items
quests.completionMessage: "You can see the store inventory by pressing F1 then selecting the STORE option from the menu."

quests.title: Searching/Examining
quests.completionMessage: "You can search bodies, treasures and interesting areas as well as interact with most NPCs by using the F8 key (EXAMINE). For an example of what a search may reveal, why don"t you try searching that bookshelf over there with all the books? Go ahead and try."

quests.title: Know Your Creatures
quests.completionMessage: "Greetings. I can tell you much about the creatures you will be engaging in battle at your stage of development. Take time to review my list. The creatures are ordered from weakest to strongest. Some important information that you will learn about creatures is that each specializes in a specific channel for attack and defense."

quests.title: After the Fight
quests.completionMessage: "Almost every creature drops an item and cash from their body once they have been slain. You can loot the items from the body and sell them to the stores for more cash. Generally the stronger the creature the better the loot. Some loot may also be used for certain quests, so keep your ears open for rumors about that."

quests.title: Flob
quests.completionMessage: "The Flob is the weakest and - dare I say cutest - creature in all of IIA. They are also an Earth creature. This means that they deal Earth damage, but are also susceptible to Earth damage. This is the only type of channel that works like this. Other channels are susceptible to what is considered their opposite. Flobs employ a melee attack against their attackers."

quests.title: Infant Stount
quests.completionMessage: "Infant Stounts are the developing young of the Stount species. These creatures are considered Normal creatures, which attack on the Normal channel. Normal creatures are most susceptible to the Death channel. Beware of this little bugger for they attack with a ranged acid spit-like projectile. You can also consume their tails to increase your health."

quests.title: Klondon
quests.completionMessage: "The Klondon is a bipedal creature with a long neck. It is larger than any of the other beasts we have spoken of thus far. In fact, it is almost large enough to ride. These dinosaur-like beasts are considered Air creatures and defend themselves with a melee attack. Air creatures are susceptible to Fire, but are immune to Water."

quests.title: Infant Dilirium
quests.completionMessage: "Like the Infant Stount, the Infant Dilirium attacks with a ranged spit attack, but they are considered Fire creatures. In order to do double damage to them use a Water weapon. Beware of using a Relic weapon though, for Fire creatures are immune to the Relic channel."

quests.title: Port to Main World
quests.description: "In order to leave this place you will have to bring me 1 Flob Shell and 1 Small Health Potion. Ask the others you encounter in this valley, and they will help you obtain these items."
quests.completionMessage: "Have a safe trip!"

quests.title: 1.  Purchasing Items
quests.completionMessage: "You can purchase items from the store in two ways; you can select the item you want from the list and click the BUY button, or you can simply select and drag the item from the store list on the right to your inventory list on the left. You may be asked to enter the quantity for a purchase of items that are sold in bunches."

quests.title: 2.  Arming Weapons
quests.completionMessage: "Now that you have a weapon you will want to learn how to arm these items. Anything that you hold or wear like weapons and armor needs to be armed in order to function. You can arm an item either through your Inventory Menu (F5) by selecting the item and clicking ARM, or by binding a hotkey to an EQUIP slot through the Controls Menu (F1/Controls)."

quests.title: 3.  Using Items
quests.completionMessage: "When you USE an item, it produces an effect. Not every item can be used. Those that can include potions, poisons, books, trade skill kits, scrolls, shapeshifting orbs and meat from creatures. You can use an item through your Inventory (F5) by selecting it and clicking USE. You can also bind a hotkey to use a specific type of item."

quests.title: 4.  View Store Inventory
quests.completionMessage: "Here you will find the best collection of items in the area. You can view the store inventory by pressing F1 then clicking the STORE button."

quests.title: Learn to Trade
quests.completionMessage: "You will need another player to trade with. To begin you must stand very close to them to initiate the trade. Press F1 then select TRADE. This will open the trade menu. The name of the person you are trading with will appear above the right window. Your inventory will be on the left and the trade window will be on the right."  <More>

quests.title: Adding Items
quests.completionMessage: "Now you may select an item from your inventory on the left. Press the ADD ITEM button on the bottom of your inventory menu. Use the quantity field to add more than one from a group of stackable items. Add as many items as you want. You will see them appear on the right hand screen under YOUR OFFER."  <More>

quests.title: Trasferring Credits
quests.completionMessage: "To transfer credits to someone else look on the right window under YOUR OFFER for the credit field and type in the amount of credits you wish to trade. When you are done adding all the items and credits you want, you are ready to submit the trade. See the next section - SUBMITTING."  <More>

quests.title: Submitting
quests.completionMessage: "Once you are satisfied with the items and credits you have offered, click the SUBMIT button so the other player can view your offer. Clicking the SUBMIT button DOES NOT mean you have given your final approval for the trade. See the next section -- THEIR OFFER." <More>

quests.title: Their Offer
quests.completionMessage: "Once the other player has clicked SUBMIT, you will see the items and credits they are offering in the top right section of the window labeled THEIR OFFER. If their offer is satisfactory, click the ACCEPT button at the bottom of the window to finalize the trade."  <More>

quests.title: Cancelling a Trade
quests.completionMessage: "If you need to cancel the trade between you and the other player just press the CANCEL button in the middle of the screen. If you have made a mistake in adding items or credits, you will need to cancel the trade and start over. Good luck, and make sure your trades are all legal!"

quests.title: 1. Access Vault
quests.completionMessage: "Welcome to your personal vault. Thanks to modern technology, you can access your personal vault from any bank area throughout the vast expanse of IIA. You may store everything from items to credits to quest items in your vault for safe keeping. Use the withdrawal and deposit buttons to transfer credits. To transfer items use the bank and take buttons."

quests.title: READ FIRST!!
quests.completionMessage: "Listen up, young pup. I have fought many a monster in my day. You would do well to listen to what I have to say. Speak to me again and select "1. REBIRTH (Important!!)"."

quests.title: 1. Rebirth (Important!!)
quests.completionMessage: "The REBIRTH command is very useful. It allows you to set the location you will respawn at when you die. Bind your REBIRTH location to any spot in any safe zone by using your chat function to type in the following - :REBIRTH .  You must use a colon and all CAPS. You will know that your REBIRTH point has been set when you see the message "You remember this place well"."

quests.title: 2. Using a Weapon
quests.completionMessage: "The default key to use any weapon is the LEFT MOUSE BUTTON. This works for any type of weapon, whether it is a range or melee type. If you want to change your fire button to a different key, just press F1 then CONTROLS."

quests.title: 3. Getting Hit
quests.completionMessage: "You will know that a monster has hit you if your screen flashes red very quickly. You will also notice your health points on your HP bar have decreased. If your health points reach zero, you will die. Your survival depends on using your healing potions during combat to replace your lost health. I think we need to talk about HEALING next."

quests.title: 4. Healing
quests.completionMessage: You should pay close attention to your HP bar while in a fight with a monster. Make sure to use your health potions when you get hit. The most effective way to use your health potions is by binding them to a hotkey (F1 - CONTROLS, then select a health potion and bind it to one of the empty USE slots). Please note that you can use only one health potion every 10 seconds. See the next section about RELOADING."

quests.title: 5. Reloading
quests.completionMessage: "The smart way to fight monsters is from a distance with a gun, so you should know how to reload that gun. The ammunition bar is just below the JET bar on the bottom left of your screen. When it gets low, press the RELOAD key (R). See the next section about LOOTING."

quests.title: 6. Looting
quests.completionMessage: "Once you have killed a monster you will want to loot its body. To loot a body, stand next to it and press the EXAMINE key (F8). This will open the loot window. You will see any items or credits that are on the body. Select each item that you want to take and click the TAKE button."

quests.title: Are you ready to fight?
quests.completionMessage: "Are you ready? First purchase a weapon from the store for your race, then we will begin your combat training. Come back and speak to me again once you have your weapon and some ammunition, and choose the "FIGHT!" option. I will then spawn some Flobs for you to begin your training."

quests.title: FIGHT!!
quests.completionMessage: "Here we go!"

quests.title: Beginner"s Creature List
quests.completionMessage: "If you want to know what creatures you should engage as a beginner, speak to Granz."

quests.title: Controls Overview
quests.completionMessage: "Press F1 and click CONTROLS. Select any command that you would like to change from the main list in the center, press the SET KEY button, then the key you want to bind the command to.To bind a USE or EQUIP command to an item, first select an empty USE or EQUIP slot, then select the item from your inventory list on the left and bind it to a key using the SET KEY button."

quests.title: Training Magic
quests.completionMessage: "Magic training begins with the Book Of Ancient Magic, low level scrolls and reagents."

quests.title: Book of Ancient Magic
quests.completionMessage: "I purchased my first Book of Magic from the Magic Shop in Four Falls. I believe the shop is still there. But there is also a shop in the Amphibious Village in Rapport Boomtown, which will be your first destination after you leave this area."

quests.title: Spells and scrolls
quests.completionMessage: "I purchased my first scrolls from the Magic Shop, but I had to search many places to discover some of the newer spells."

quests.title: Reagents
quests.completionMessage: Reagents are necessary components of most spells. You can buy common reagents in magic shops."

quests.title: Book Of Familiars
quests.completionMessage: "Obtaining a Book Of Familiars is the first step to summoning a familiar to your side. I bought my first book from the Magic Shop in Four Falls, but there is also a shop in Rapport Boomtown."

quests.title: Familiar Scrolls
quests.completionMessage: "I bought my first familiar scroll at the same place I purchased my book, but the more powerful familiars I had to discover for myself."

quests.title: Shape Shifting
quests.completionMessage: "I began my Shape Shift training by speaking to the master in the hills above Rapport Boomtown, but I"m sure there are other ways. Anyway, please excuse me. I must get back to my focus training."

quests.title: Accessing the bank
quests.completionMessage: "You can access your personal vault by pressing the F1 key then selecting VAULT from the menu."

quests.title: Ancient vs. Recent discoveries
quests.completionMessage: Time is distorted in this realm. Countless ages may elapse on the home worlds of those who awaken here, yet only a single IIA year will have passed. This time distortion has resulted in a collection of technology and ideas from the past and the future being brought together in one place and at one time -- here and now.

quests.title: Arcane Powers
quests.completionMessage: Magic was the primary manifestation of good and evil in ancient times. Its use is widespread throughout all people groups. It is theorized by many who study this art that there is much more to be discovered. The first magic shop was founded by one of the original members of the Amphibious race to arrive on IIA. He is located in the central city of 4Falls.

quests.title: Art Of Shape-Shift
quests.completionMessage: Shape Shifting was introduced a few years after the first inhabitants arrived on IIA and was documented by the Elder Amphibian named Strife. He built the founding settlement on IIA which he called Amphibious Island. The first Shape Shifters began to practice their skills there.

quests.title: Power of the Blade

quests.title: Guns and Ammo
quests.completionMessage: Guns are what we call any type of range weapon that fires a projectile that hits a target from a distance. The wise adventurer will bind their RELOAD command to a convenient key in order to replenish ammo quickly in the heat of battle.

quests.title: You came to see me?
quests.description: I am sorry, you are not chosen to learn of this today, it would be like casting pearls before swine....go now and train your mind so you may be of use someday.
quests.completionMessage: Ahh, yes, you must be the one that Drothar was speaking of. I am sorry that I do not have more information on this subject, but very little is known about the chests of Sanctum. Legend holds that a great being from a world not known to be connected to IIA blessed the treasury of Kern with the ability to provide treasures from a place known as the Sanctum. That treasury consisted of many chests. They are now scattered among the land, when no one was able to open them they served little use. But now that we may have found a key, it is up to you to open one of the chests and discover if the key is indeed a link to the power! Speak to me again when you are ready to obtain your key
quests.hint: when ready, speak to me again.

quests.title: Vol. XIX, Issue VI
quests.completionMessage: Welcome back, loyal readers! This issue we take a close in-depth look at the proper etiquette for dining with Godions. Now, you are probably saying to yourself, "why would I ever invite a Godion to dinner?" Well first of all, have you ever wondered why your cousin Frieda has such pointy ears? Or why your uncle Jotsam makes those disgusting grunting  noises all the time? Wake up and smell the peroxi flowers! There"s most likely been a little bit of cavorting in the caves in your family tree, if you catch my drift. So when your doorbell rings and you see that short package of ears, fangs and leathery hide, just smile and say "glunschka!" which means "your flies are my flies". And don"t give them a table setting, they always bring their own silverware.

quests.title: The Art of Melee Combat, by Zeg
quests.completionMessage: The true measure of one"s spirit is seen when you stand opposite your opponent with only a blade to defend yourself. Your weapon should always be raised to your forehead to honor your foe before engaging them. As you close watch the eyes of your opponent. A quick redirection of their gaze at any time will tip you of impending attack and the portion of your body that is to be the target. Await their attack and deflect it - do not try to block it, thus absorbing the full shock of their move. Deflecting their blow will throw them off balance, then you must begin your counterstrike before their attacking move has come to a stop. Begin looking for your next opponent before your blade hits home and you will survive many a battle.

quests.title: Rings and Amulets, by Cheever
quests.completionMessage: The art of forging magical rings and amulets has been lost to us, but the charms themselves are still to be found. But many think the sheer attraction of shiny metal causes them to be devoured. Whatever the reason, the hardy adventurer who happens to slay such a beast is the happy beneficiary of whatever protection or enhancement the magic item bestows to its bearer.

quests.title: The Legacy of Ataeus, by Blobar Couch
quests.completionMessage: In the beginning, Ataeus walked the shores of IIA. Being the most powerful force that ever walked on two legs he found his way into the mineral-rich caves and forged weapons for himself out of diamond crystals and the strongest metals. In that day the surface world was a violent and unforgiving place inhabited by great creatures of terrible power, and they eyed Ateaus as a fresh target for their torment. So he strode into their midst and scattered them with a sweeping blow. Seizing a massive slug called Lord Shipron by the tail, he swung him in circles and laid waste to the others until they fled from his sight. Striding into the waters he did battle with two great swimming eyes until all three were exhausted, yet then Ataeus found reserves of strength and slung both beasts over his shoulder, carrying them to the highest mountain on the planet and hurling them to the rocks below so that they feared him above all else and slunk away to hide in the depths. So it was that he ushered in the Age of the Bloblics. Our people began to first appear on this world and Ataeus was their champion. But with the absence of challenge, our champion grew restless. Long ago he left these shores in search of new worlds. We pray he can still hear our cries.

quests.title: Housing Placement

quests.title: Location, Location, Location!
quests.completionMessage: When placing your house, do NOT place it in any location where it is not natural to be placed, such as in a tree or underwater. The forces that oversee this world have been known to wreak terrible judgment on those who attempt such a thing, and at times people have suffered the complete loss of their structure. It is fortunate that they did not lose their very lives! So my friend, use good sense when placing your house. You may not wish to risk the consequences of your folly if you do not.

quests.title: Adventurers Guild
quests.completionMessage: Greetings Citizen!! And welcome to the guild hall of the Brotherhood of Adventurers. My name is Drothar, and I am the appointed guild leader of this world-encompassing brotherhood of heroes-for-hire. It is the role of all guild members to keep this land in balance, and to uphold the ancient pact with the Elders to be custodians of our land, and of course, to make some profit. As the leader of this guild it is my job to accumulate all the tasks that must be performed for the good of the people. I must warn you though, if you wish to assist in our efforts, you may risk your possessions, your life, or even your eternal soul. Now, as you go about your daily business, you may find something called a Quest Pass. If you do, bring it back to me as quickly as possible. My soothsayer, Tika, advised me to scatter these passes around the world, and that those who found them would be worthy enough and be chosen for the task. Tika is very wise, and I trust her judgement. Bring any and all Quest passes you find to me, and I will allow you to assist our cause, and possibly join our brotherhood. As I said before, many dangers may stand before you, but the rewards may be beyond your wildest dreams. You are welcome to sit and eat around my fire any time. Good luck on your ventures, citizen.

quests.title: RED
quests.description: Only the holder of the Red Quest Pass may attempt this quest.
quests.completionMessage: So....you are ready to attemtp this quest? I must warn you, this is a VERY dangerous quest, one not for the weak or young. But I trust the guidence of my soothsayer Tika, and that of the Ancients, it truely must be your destiny. Now listen carefully...it has come to my attention that the followers of Cron are attempting a rift ceremony to pull Kigor, Lord of the Void into this world.....if this happens, neither the ShadowFlesh or ourselves will abide in this land. But in order for them to complete the ceremony they require the combined power of every preist within their ranks. It is my theory that if we can defeat just 25 of the 1000"s that will attend the ceremony, we will set them back for years to come. We also will need 10 eyes of their eyezora familiers. And lastly we hear that a particular overlord will be attending this ceremony.....bring me his Seal.

quests.title: I have returned
quests.completionMessage: Magnificent, you really WERE the chosen one for this task, you are truely a destroyer of the Void. Here is 50k credits, and I think the Ancients have blessed you with some skill

quests.title: HAZEL
quests.description: Only the holder of the Hazel Quest Pass may attempt this quest.
quests.completionMessage: Thank the spirits, you have been sent to us at just the right time, you surely are the one to save the child....You see, there is a family that lives here in the valley, and their youngest child, a young girl named Cici, has come down with a very rare illness caused by eating under cooked kidion bat meat. The only cure is to boil 100 revital orbic heals into a thick very potent paste that when consumed boosts the bodies natural immune system by nearly 500%. It is up to you to bring us these heals as fast as possible, and believe me, saving the life of a child can do nothing but bring you good things.

quests.title: I have returned
quests.completionMessage: Magnificent, you really WERE the chosen one for this task, you are truely a savior of the children. Here is 7k credits, and I think the Ancients have blessed you with some skill

quests.title: BURNT
quests.description: Only the holder of the Burnt Quest Pass may attempt this quest.
quests.completionMessage: Come closer.....*lowers his voice* I usually do not ask a favor such as this, but if you do not do it, I will do it myself, and we can not be sure of the consequences then now can we? The task is this, an Elder from the shockian nation ordered the assassination of my nephew...my reports tell me that they captured and brought him to their village, where the Elders gathered and...*shudders in rage* sacrificed my dear boy....*Voice raises to a thunder* I WANT THEIR HEADS, EVERY SINGLE ELDER HEAD YOU BRING TO ME WILL BE PLACED ON A PIKE TO SHOW THEM HOW MUCH THEY TRUELY SACRIFICED!!!.....*Calms himself* I want at least 20 Elder Shockian Heads, and 20 Elite Shockian heads. An Emesary was seen entering their village in 4 falls from an influential overking.....bring me his seal. Be gone assassin...do your deed.

quests.title: I have returned
quests.completionMessage: Magnificent, you really WERE the chosen one for this task, you are truely a destroyer of the Shockions. Here is 80k credits, and I think the Ancients have blessed you with some skill. I am in debt to you friend.

quests.title: UMBER
quests.description: Only the holder of the Umber Quest Pass may attempt this quest.
quests.completionMessage: Alright, this is a mission that needs to be kept kind of on the low-down, you got my meaning?  We"ve got a shipment of imported products coming in tonight, and we don"t want to pay the exhorbitant taxes the Elders demand.  Don"t get me wrong, this is a wonderful city, but the money in our treasury needs to go to nobler causes.  So, what I need you to do is go talk to Muth, the guard on the bridge, and give him this counterfeit guard pass to distract him, then return to me and we can send the shipment through.

quests.title: I have returned
quests.completionMessage: Excellent job, the goods got through without a problem, and we"ll all be able to enjoy them now.  Here"s half of what we saved on the taxes, enjoy.

quests.title: EMERALD
quests.description: Only the holder of the Emerald Quest Pass may attempt this quest.
quests.completionMessage: I hope you are truly the chosen one for this task....for if that is not the case, then I must bid you farewell...forever. That aside, the task is this:  We have been breeding skoids in order to create a mounted guard legion. But in order to prepare our steeds for battle, we wish to get our hands on a prototype set of skoid armor so we may backwards engineer it to be used at our discretion. The catch is this, it is in a chest in a very dangerous location, and we have no time for you to travel by your own power, when you aquire the armor, bring it to me as quickly as possible..sooo....Tika, let him have it!

quests.title: I have returned
quests.completionMessage: Wonderful!  I"m so glad you made it out ali...I mean alright.  This will do perfectly.  I"ll present you with one of our best-trained battle skoids.  Treat him well and he will keep you well.

quests.title: CHARTREUSE
quests.description: Only the holder of the Chartreuse Quest Pass may attempt this quest.
quests.completionMessage: Perfect timing, chosen one.  I have a task for you that is vital to our cause, but frustrating in its undertaking.  Feldin, one of our most respected researchers, has been researching the various uses of Grision plasma, for both curative and tactical applications.  He"s recently stopped sending reports, so I need you to go see what the problem is and help him with it.  Also, bring me a sample of the plasma for the researchers here. Quickly, he is on a platform within the Cave of The Ancients!

quests.title: I have returned
quests.completionMessage: Absolute perfection, this is exactly the raw elements that we need to complete our...err...project. You have done very well, and will most certainly do great things in the future for our cause. Here friend, take this reward and use it how you may. You did well this day.

quests.title: PURPLE
quests.description: Only the holder of the Purple Quest Pass may attempt this quest.
quests.completionMessage: Well, I am glad i may leave this task up to you....because to be honest I am at a loss at what we should do! I hoped someone of your talent would come to me at this time. You see....a  strange key was brought to me, I can not read the title that is inscripted on the side, but if it is what my scholars theorize it to be....the contents of the container it opens must be kept safe. Go and speak to Kildar our resident expert on jibberish and the past. He will give you the key of which i speak.

quests.title: I have returned
quests.completionMessage: Please, I do not even wish to know wether you succeded or not....I have no interest in this project any longer, but here is some money for your troubles either way.....we appreciate your help

quests.title: Open
quests.description: You do not have a key to open this chest.
quests.completionMessage: The rusted key turns and breaks but the chest quickly pops open. You recieve the prototype skoid armor.

quests.title: Plants, Roots and Seeds
quests.completionMessage: "Welcome. My people have long studied the growing things of this world. We have become wise in knowing the value of the native plant life. I can teach you these things if you have a mind to learn them. Take this, your first plant extractor. Listen closely and I will explain how to use it."

quests.title: Extractor 2
quests.description: "Take your plant extractor and search for some special plants spread throughout the world. When you find one, examine it making sure your extractor is in your inventory, and you will be able to extract a specimen from that plant. If you will bring me back 5 specimens from the following plants, I will give you another extractor. Bring me some Tug Seeds, Gurg Seeds, Asgon Plants, Mandion Shells, Docux Beans, and Frogidon Saps."
quests.completionMessage: "Wonderful. All plants in this realm have uses, some for health and some for harm. Learn them all and what they are good for and you will be invaluable to your people. When you are ready to obtain your next extractor, speak to me again."

quests.title: Extractor 5
quests.description: "Now, you can take your new extractor and comb the world for new plants. I will give you another more advanced extractor if you will bring me 10 each of the following plants: Edipidone Pollen, Widget Nuts, Viastic Stems, Buctun Weed, Filidian Syrup, Hig Ferns, Insuraitus Bark and Sigpruce.
quests.completionMessage: "Wonderful. All plants in this realm have uses, some for health and some for harm. Learn them all and what they are good for and you will be invaluable to your people. When you are ready to obtain your next extractor, speak to me again."

quests.title: Extractor 6
quests.description: "The final extractor will let you harvest some of the most rare and wonderful botanical marvels on this planet. But you must first bring me 20 samples of each of the following plants: Sagelmic Bulb, Ecolalgae, Magus Leaf, Digdig Root, Wigspruce Stalk and Acban Bean."
quests.completionMessage: "Use this final extractor with caution. The plants that you can extract using this tool are located in dangerous places. Do not let yourself be caught off-guard." [More]

quests.title: Complete
quests.description: "You have mastered the skill of extracting plants, roots and seeds. Do not lose the extractors I have given you, for there are other growing things I have not told you about that may be obtained by using them." [Complete]

quests.title: Dilirium Hunt
quests.description: "Hoom!! Well, this valley does not look quite the same as my old familiar Bloblic caves... it"s MUCH better. How nice it is to not be standing in water all day with my armor rusting, hearing those Infant Diliriums screeching in the background... hush!  What"s that noise?? Oh.. nothing. I thought I heard them again. If this cave gets overrun, I don"t know what I"ll do. The last cave I was at, along the elevated path in the canyon to my right, was infested with the nasty buggers.  I HATE THEM! I am obsessed with exterminating all the Infant Diliriums from this planet! I will reward you if you will help me. Bring back proof of 10 kills and I will reward you with whatever I pull out of this bag of loot I salvaged from the old world."
quests.completionMessage: "Well done! Here is your reward. Keep up the good work, who knows what I will pull out of the bag next time."

quests.title: Examine the chest?
quests.description: You hear the soft lilting voice of Celeste as she directs her attention towards you.."Are you in need of healing friend? That box you are showing interest in is a sacred vessel carved out of the wood of a tree long dead, whose kind has vanished. It is prepared to give health to those that would but make a donation. If you happen to come apon any Agate gems, this chest will reward you."
quests.completionMessage: As you came closer to the chest you feel the Agate within the palm of your hand begin to warm.... then you notice a slight tremble....before you know it you have knelt and placed the agate within the box, almost as if compelled by some unseen force. Almost as soon as the gem hit the dark wood your hand removed a small potion, which you quickly pocket. The chest closes again and you stand, wondering about what just happened.

quests.title: Accessing Store
quests.completionMessage: "We are all having to make sacrifices to keep our businesses running. I am just glad we were able to take control of our beloved town once again. You can also press F1 then Store to access my wares."

quests.title: Accessing Bank
quests.completionMessage: "Welcome to the Four Falls vault. I am glad that we were able to get rid of those nasty beasts. You can also press F1 then Vault to access your storage."

quests.title: Accessing my store...
quests.completionMessage: "Times are hard. If you want to see what I have left, press F1 then click the Store menu."
Aaron (Banker)> "To access your personal vault, press F1 then select VAULT."
Cylic (Engineer)> "You must be interested in mechanical engineering and technology, huh? Well press F1 and select STORE to check out what I have to offer."
Judic (Housing)] "No houses for sale I"m afraid. Feel free to read the books on the counters if you"re bored though. You can play with the toy houses as well if that"s your kind of thing..."
Nikkita (Items)] "Take your time..."
Orbo (Items)> "Welcome to the Bank. If you want to access your personal vault, just press F1 then select VAULT. You can also type :BANK into the local chat window."
Vectra (Alchemist)> "Welcome to my Emporium of Alchemical Delights. To access my fine selection of kits and ingredients, you may press F1 then select STORE."

quests.title: Melee Weapons
quests.completionMessage: "If you want to check out my melee weapons just hit F1 and go to Store menu."

quests.title: Intro
quests.completionMessage: "Greetings!  I can only assume that you are hear because you are searching for melee weapons.  Well I can forge you a Fire sword, but only after you perform tasks for me."

quests.title: Return
quests.description: "I still have quite a few Fire swords to give away. If you want one of them, you need to show me you are worthy in true warrior style. I will summon Sigrap who will appear in Death Valley. Defeat him and bring me the Document of Sli that he carries. You will only have ten minutes to find and defeat him."
quests.completionMessage: "Hey, not bad!  You know I would have done it in half the time, but of course you are not me... HA!  Well take this to my servant behind you and he will give you your new Fire sword."

quests.title: Complete
quests.description: "If you want to collect your sword go see my servant.  I am done with you."

quests.title: Melee Weapons
quests.completionMessage: "Yep, I"ve got some Melee weapons. Press F1 and click STORE or type :BUY in the chat line to see what I"ve got."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I am keeping watch over the Rift"s Gate to the Underworld."
quests.completionMessage: "Trenes just got word to me that you were on your way here to help me break up the Shockion meeting.  To assist you, I"m preparing a clone of myself to heal you during your quest.  The clone will appear west of the Shockion Village when the meeting commences."  [More]

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 6 of 28
quests.description: "You may have to wait until the meeting starts if it hasn"t started by the time you get there. My clone will only last about 20 minutes so you should try to break up the meeting as quickly as possible. I want the Shockion"s Elder Meeting Stone and the Clone tracker when you are completed."
quests.completionMessage: "Well done! This stone is a combination of magic and technology that records the minutes of a meeting using an ancient encryption style. Let me see what information I can gather from analyzing it..."  [More]
quests.hint: Kill the Shockions after they gather

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 7 of 28
quests.description: "I cannot deduce much from this stone, it is beyond my skill. You must get it back to Trenes quickly to see if he can discover anything important from it. I imagine we will meet up again soon."
quests.completionMessage: "Yekby, a traducer??!?  I would never have guessed. There is only one penalty for a traducer, and that is ceremonial execution. We will probably have to take the next best thing, which is sloppy destruction. I will meet up with Hilrom and Sirra."  [More]
quests.hint: Take the Elder Stone Mission to Trenes

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 26 of 28
quests.description: "Seek us out in the Cave of the Ancients after confronting Yekby about Malakai.  We will be setting up there.  They will not go down without a fight.  Make sure to find us."

quests.title: Human Female Start
quests.description: "I"m fairly sure that I have nothing to do with any of your quests. You don"t even have the 14th Celeste Crest!"
quests.completionMessage: "I must verify that you are indeed for our cause.   I believe you are truthful.  Speak with Yekby across the tressel"

quests.title: Human Male Start
quests.description: "I"m fairly sure that I have nothing to do with any of your quests. You don"t even have the 14th Darius Crest!"
quests.completionMessage: "I must verify that you are indeed for our cause.   I believe you are truthful.  Speak with Yekby across the tressel"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Focusing you protection items into one channel will give you the greatest protection for that channel, however it may make you more prone to other types of damage."
quests.completionMessage: "This document details a plan to use dimension-altering technology to release Datro from his lair. He is so strong and so evil that he was forever banished to a hidden chamber and the entrance was sealed up by the leaders of the four races. I will need to decode the entire entry in order to devise a plan.  but for now..."  [More]

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 5 of 28
quests.description: "One of my scouts, Xellion, has received word that a group of Shockions are gathering to have a discussion about Cain.  This, in of itself, is cause for worry. You will find her watching over the Rift Gateway to the Underworld, assist her however you can."
quests.completionMessage: "From what you brought me, it seems that the Shockions have agreed to assist in the re-entry of Cain"s forces and were able to send out a messenger scout to Four Falls just before you disrupted their meeting."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Xellion near the gateway to the underworld

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 8 of 28
quests.description: "No matter, a dead scout returns no scouting report. We will get word to Hilrom to intercept the scout, but you must serve as backup if he fails. You will find him near a statue by one of the temples."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent, you were able to intercept and silence the scout. This is great news! Now what have you brought me? The Spirit Gateway Orb... I am not sure what this is for. It is not something that can be decoded, it must be analyzed from technical standpoint."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Hilrom at the Four Falls Temple

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 11 of 28
quests.description: "You will have to take the orb to Sirra. While you are there please deliver this note which will fill her in on what all has happened. Farewell, I do not think we will meet again."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Datro is immune to most channels.  It is believed that Rune damage is his only weakness."
quests.completionMessage: "Yekby must have briefed you about the group we must stop. They have been appearing briefly in one of the mirror rooms at the end of the underwater tunnel before having to zone out again. If they become accustomed to our atmosphere they"ll be able to stay more perminently. " [More]

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 3 of 28
quests.description: "Find them and prevent them from taking another breath of our clean air. If they prove to be too strong for you, try to at least take down their leader which will throw the rest of them into confusion. Bring me anything he carries for analysis."
quests.completionMessage: "Well done!  Key of Mirrors must be necessary for their entrance to our dimension, so having these will halt their re-entraince attempts for now.  This Encrypted Plan illustrates the desire to relocate Datro, the most fearsome creature in this land.... but to where?"  [More]
quests.hint: "Kill Sinance at end of underwater tunnels."

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 4 of 28
quests.description: "I can"t get much more out of this. You must venture into the crypt in Four Falls and deliver this Decoded Mission to Trenes so he can decipher it further."
quests.completionMessage: "A note for me?  Let me see... okay, Malakai is trying to use the Spirit Gateway Orb to either relocate Datro, or bring reinforcements from Cain"s army into this dimension... or both. This Orb is very powerful and must be kept safe. I think the safest place for this orb will be with Yekby."  [More]
quests.hint: "Take the plan to Trenes in the 4F Crypt."

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 12 of 28
quests.description: "He probably knows more about it than anyone else. Yes, he will know what to do. I have heard him speak of this orb before in the past, and... wait a minute... no, that is not possible, he would never do that... hmm? Oh, nothing. Just forget it. Go quickly!"
quests.completionMessage: "What? A Traducer in our midst!  I knew Yekby was Malakai"s son, but I truly believed he could overcome his heritage. This is disappointing. Now I must stand against Yekby."  [More]
quests.hint: "Take the Spirit Gateway Orb to Yekby."

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 25 of 28
quests.description: "You must notify Xellion of this deception.  He will most likely retreat to the Cave of the Ancients after you confront him.  I"ll meet up with Hilrom there.  We will not move on without you.  Make sure you do the same."

quests.title: Human Female Gun
quests.description: "I can only release an Impulse Cannon from the armory with the permission of my master Yekby. He is across the tressel."
quests.completionMessage: "Here is your weapon, use it wisely."

quests.title: Human Male Gun
quests.description: "I can only release an Impulse Cannon from the armory with the permission of my master Yekby. He is across the tressel."
quests.completionMessage: "Here is your weapon, use it wisely."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "All creatures have a weakness.  Shockions, for example, have no protection from the water channel."
quests.completionMessage: "You have arrived here just in time. I caught the Shockion Scout heading toward one of the falls and attacked him."  [More]

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 9 of 28
quests.description: "I chased the Shockion Scout to inside the Temple. You"ll need the emblem that grants entrance to it!  If my guess is right, he"s carrying something very important and he"s most likely looking for another way out."
quests.completionMessage: "Looks like he was a messenger! He was trying to get the Spirit Gateway Orb to Malakai.  It says in this note that when this orb is used in the correct fashion that it can create a gateway to any realm. The plan looks like Malakai is supposed to know how to use it to free Datro."  [More]
quests.hint: Enter the Temple and kill the Shockion Scout

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 10 of 28
quests.description: "Before Malakai has too much time to regroup you must take the Spirit Gateway Orb back to Trenes to see what he can learn from it."
quests.completionMessage: "While you were gone I spotted Malakai leaving the Temple not too long ago. I assume he"s looking for his missing Shockion Scout."  [More]
quests.hint: Return the Orb to Trenes and do his bidding

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 14 of 28
quests.description: "He was headed towards the local Shockion Village.  Perhaps he"s still looking for the missing scout. Intercept Malakai and take him out if at all possible."
quests.completionMessage: "By the looks of this device Malakai was carrying, what you killed was a clone.  Plus we have just been informed that the real Malakai will be gathering some forces in the Four Falls Tombs."  [More]
quests.hint: Destroy Malakai near the Shockion Village

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 15 of 28
quests.description: "It may be a trap but we can"t miss this chance if it isn"t.  You are to go into the tombs only as far as the first four-way intersection.  You will wait and ambush them from that point.  You are expected to do well."
quests.completionMessage: "So it was a trap.  But you managed to survive and take out their leader. Excellent job! This chip that their leader was carrying may have some significance."  [More]
quests.hint: Stake out the first intersection in the Tombs

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 16 of 28
quests.description: "Take the Plasma Energy Charger to Ira on the Black Market Structure and make sure you get this chip to Yekby along with this battle plan I have devised for taking out Malakai once and for all."
quests.completionMessage: "My intelligence agents have located Malakai deep within the Cave of the Ancients.  With this information, we have little time to spare."  [More]
quests.hint: See Ira on Black Market Building

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 20 of 28
quests.description: "Take the Clone Device you retrieved from the Malakai clone to Ira.  He will need this to continue with the plan."
quests.completionMessage: "Wha...Yekby has betrayed us? No wonder you were being ambushed everywhere you went. Yekby knows of everything we do. He is a Traducer! We must stop him right away."  [More]
quests.hint: Take the Clone Device to Ira

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 24 of 28
quests.description: "Quickly, take this note to Sirra. We will need her assistance to take down Yekby. This note will explain what must be done."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "The Impulse Cannon is designed to deal Rune damage."
quests.completionMessage: "Good thing Hilrom found a way to get me this Plasma Charger. Yekby informed me of your coming and I had ordered the replacement parts, but the courier crashed into a mountain on Slal Island. The parts were shipped in individual canisters and are scattered all over the land and sea around Slal Island. "  [More]
quests.hint: Speak to Yekby before you talk to Ira

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 17 of 28
quests.description: "Here are keys that will open each canister. I suggest you search for them on and around the island, and I wouldn"t be surprised if one of them managed to fall in the water."
quests.completionMessage: "Let"s see, Knock Generator, Impulse Compressor, Trigger System. Let me just charge these boys up and you can take my Plasma Charger with you.  I will no longer be keeping you." [More]
quests.hint: Find 3 lost canisters on Slal Island

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 18 of 28
quests.description: "Inform Yekby that I have worked out an enhancement to the Impulse Cannon to squeeze another 30 joules out of her projectile. I"ll need you to run this hardcopy of the design back to Yekby for his final approval."
quests.completionMessage: "I am almost finished! I started early on the Impulse changes because I just knew Yekby would say yes. What else did you bring me? Ah yes, the Clone Device from the Malakai clone. Hilrom wants me to use this to construct a device that will help us locate the real Malakai wherever he is."  [More]

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 21 of 28
quests.description: "Ah, here it is! Yes, one thing I need for you to bring me while you are globetrotting around the world is 10 Impulse Shell Plastiques. You should look for a high level Alchemist to make them. Go get me that plastique and I should be ready by the time you get back. See you then."
quests.completionMessage: "Congratulate me.  I just finished the new Impulse Cannon prototype and all I need the plastique you brought me. This should be one hell of a test."  [More]

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 22 of 28
quests.description: "Now, let"s see... whoah! A Spy!! Look Out!"
quests.completionMessage: "Oh no! While you were engaging the spy, the Impulse Cannon prototype was stolen! That"s not the worst news, though. I ran the DNA tests on both Yekby"s DNA sample you brought me and on Malakai"s DNA sample from the Clone Device. It turns out that Yekby and Malakai are related!"  [More]

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 23 of 28
quests.description: "As a matter of fact, Yekby is Malakai"s son! We assumed there was an insider tipping Malakai off but who would"ve thought it is Yekby himself! We have a word for those who betray their friends in this manner. We call them Traducers. You must get word to Hilrom on this. He must know right away!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I have an urgent mission. Speak to my assistant Uma across the tressel. If she approves you, I will share my troubles."
quests.completionMessage: "Do you feel that energy? It is the presence of an evil in this world that I have never felt before.  I am a master engineer and have developed a weapon that will turn the tide in our favor. To help me in my quest, bring me these 2 things."  [More]

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 1 of 28
quests.description: "The "Eye to the Soul" can be found on certain enlightened siltrons, and the Signet of the Overking must be torn from the corpse of the overking which dwells at the bottom of the crypt beneath the earth of Four Falls."
quests.completionMessage: "The evil I speak of will soon emerge, and I have designed a weapon to give us the advantage against it. I call it the Impulse Cannon, and I will equip you with one if you continue to aid us."  [More]
quests.hint: Hunt Siltrons for the Eye; seek Overking

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 2 of 28
quests.description: "Cain, the evil demigod is attempting to gain power. He has called for reinforcements from his own dimension. Four of his soldiers are attempting to enter IIA.  You can help us by finding my comrade Sirra in the catacombs and lending her your assistance."
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, the Spirit Gateway Orb... this is quite a find!  I see that Sirra is on top of things, I should have known that Malakai was involved in this mess. Take this plan, to Hilrom, on how to deal with Malakai. Also, we were just recently raided for supplies. Nothing important was taken but some essential prototype parts were damaged."  [More]

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 13 of 28
quests.description: "To remedy this you will also need to find Ira ,my Chief Supply Manager, on top of the Black Market entrance building, after checking in with Hilron. He will be able to give you replacements for these damaged parts. He has also requested my DNA be delivered to him, so take that as well."
quests.completionMessage: "Let me see what you have. So Malakai has once again foiled our plans to stop him. How does he stay one step ahead of us? Maybe I don"t want to know. But Hilrom"s plan is a good one, and it looks like it could succeed in drawing Malakai out."  [More]
quests.hint: Hilrom is waiting for my response

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 19 of 28
quests.description: "Notify Hilrom of the final battle plan immediately and tell Ira that his impulse design improvements are quite impressive.  I approve of his changes."
quests.completionMessage: "What do you mean, "how could I?" You know nothing! You are pitiful mortality while I am eternal! Hehehahahahaha!! [ulp, wait! My mind is overcome by the domination of my father, but I must fight it...]"  [More]
quests.hint: Return to Hilrom with the Final Battle Plan

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 27 of 28
quests.completionMessage: "Wrong! I am going to the Cave of the Ancients and work my deep magic with the aid of all the work you have done for me, hahahaha!! I will bring about a new darkness to this land... Grgrh... "  [More]

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Part 27 of 28
quests.description: "[Quick, take this half of a key! Destroy me in CoA and you will break my father"s hold on my mind.  I should return here after you"ve defeated me.] Yaaa!! Stop speaking, I command it! Your possession of that half-key matters not. You and your friends will fail and I will become your new master!"
quests.completionMessage: "You are truly worth the trust I placed in you. You have helped me break the hold my father had on me, and now I can continue my work for the good of the land."  [More]

quests.title: ImpulseCannon Quest: Complete
quests.description: "Take these keys to my associate Bema across the tressel and to the left. She will give you your reward. Many thanks be to you!"

quests.title: (BL)
quests.description: "During a trip to the Crazed Smith, a couple of Deathbots took and scattered my complete collection of Dark Eggs throughout the Black Market Caves. If you would find them and return them to me I will give you a very special item. There are 10 eggs in all and very hard to see in the dim light of the caves."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you! You don"t know how much this means to me. Well as I promised, here is your reward. It is a special ring that has the ability to increase your dexterity by 20 points when you wear it. I hope this comes in handy for you. Take care of yourself my friend!"
quests.hint: "Find 10 Dark Eggs inside Black Market Caves."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I haven"t spoken to my brother Glagrog for a long time.  Nor do I care to."
quests.completionMessage: "You must be pretty tough if you beat the Friganton Gang. There"s NO way I"m talking to Glagrog. He did a bad, bad thing with my watchamado."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Glagrog tossed my thingamijiggy up to a GI Bat, who in-turn gobbled it up. In fact, if you go outside right now you"ll find it flying around the top of this mountain just to taunt me. Cut off its laughing head and I"ll think about forgiving Glagrog."
quests.completionMessage: "Hooch-a-ma-wow!  You killed the monster that ate my widgeywunko.  As a reward, I will give you the head of a GI Bat one of other brothers killed long ago...don"t ask."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Part 8 of 9
quests.description: "I had forgotten how much he cared for me once upon a time. Take this to Glagrog and tell him I"m sorry for telling him our parents got him free from a cereal box."
quests.hint: "You should tell Glagrog the good news."

quests.title: Human Male
quests.description: "I am Glagrog"s armor-keeper.  He"s a great smith but he"s also something of a practical joker."
quests.completionMessage: "You have finished with Glagrog"s problem I see. He told me to give you this suit of Pridio Armor.  Also, here is your Pridio Emblem. This can be used to gain access to the underworld. Here is Glagrog"s Key which will allow you to speak to his friend Ocsylop in the underworld. Good luck in your further adventures."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "If you were stronger you could help me retrieve the components to a weapon I was developing, the Netlauncher."
quests.completionMessage: "There were a few of us engineers developing components for a new weapon, until Sodo and his band of thieves somehow found out.  Anton, Antex, and I were raided for our contributions to the Netlauncher. If we"re going to finish, we need those components back."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest:
quests.description: "Before I was a weapons engineer I was a stripper. It could happen."
quests.completionMessage: "I was working on the Core Regulator, but as I said, it was stolen by Sodo. He is inside these caves, but he doesn"t look to be going anywhere. So, you should start by looking for Anton in 4 falls, he has been tracking the men that stole his piece away." [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 1 of 22
quests.description: "The components I need to complete the Netlauncher are the Plasma Net Generator, Net Actuator Arm, and the Plasma Core Regulator. Bring me these items when you have them."
quests.completionMessage: "Ahhhhhh... This is great!!  These will enable me to finish my masterpiece!! Here is a token from me to you.  Assembling this for you will take some time, so I want you to do a little something for me in the time being."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 22 of 22
quests.description: "Bring me a teardrop from the strongest flying creature, and a gemstone from the strongest swimming creature in this realm. You may want to check near the tower in the darkest water, and toward the west. By then I will have my work done."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you so much!!  These will look good in my collection room.  I have your weapon ready now. Here is your collection pass."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Complete
quests.description: "See my Servant for your reward. And bring your 16th crest."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I"m watching out for a band of thieves that took something that belonged to me."
quests.completionMessage: "Thanks for my toolbox. Falene must have sent you to help. Sodo"s men have the most essential component to my Plasma Net Generator...the Casing. They have been in the temple for quite a while now. I"m afraid they have found an alternative way out."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 2 of 22
quests.description: "Search carefully throughout the dungeon for them...You must find the group"s leader and acquire the Plasma Generator Casing from him. Come back to me when you have it."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you so much! They didn"t damage it at all!I just have to do a few quick things to it and it will be done. Give me a minute...And here you go!"  [More]
quests.hint: "The thieves must be in the dungeon."

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 3 of 22
quests.description: "Now you must go and search for my brother Antex. He has been tracking some thieves too. He is somewhere in this side of the realm where he can get a good view of the beautiful surroundings. Try one of the Falls areas within Four Falls."
