quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "We are Master Sodo.  All tremble in the presence of Sodo, even you."
quests.completionMessage: "So you have taken down two of Sodo"s squads?  Not bad.  Yes, Lord Sodo does possess the final peice of the Netlauncher you"re looking for, but Sodo will not give it to you."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 9 of 22
quests.description: "One of Sodo"s squads patrols the Catacombs from time to time to make sure we have a grip on things. First see if you can locate them, then see if you can terminate them... Muhahahaha!  Sodo the Hilarious taunts you."
quests.completionMessage: "Sodo the Powerful is adequately impressed... let"s move on. See if you can take down the Eyezion Lord."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 10 of 22
quests.description: "You are a weakling compared to Sodo. We, Great Sodo, are strong compared to you.  The Eyezion Lord will see that you are not as mighty as Sodo.  His eye holds the proof of your weakness."
quests.completionMessage: "Give us the eye. We believe Sodo feels you"re ready to take the next test. Our Galleoni team is scattered throughout these caves. Let"s see if you are strong enough to take them all down..."  [More]
quests.hint: "Sodo requires the Eye of the Eyezion."

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 11 of 22
quests.description: "Sodo would have no problem with the Galleoni.  But Sodo is not weak.  Defeat the Galleoni team for Brave Sir Sodo."
quests.completionMessage: "We giggle in suspense...You are ready to fight our elite squad."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 12 of 22
quests.description: "Sodo the Handsome has readied our elite squad in these caves."
quests.completionMessage: "Everything you do is just barely adequate, unlike Sodo who finishes things with flourish.  We will fight you. Sodo the Cunning is waiting in the deepest part of these caves. "  [More]
quests.hint: "Sodo"s Elite will have no trouble with you."

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Travel towards the blue portal and Sodo you will find. You are starting to annoy Sodo the Patient. We look forward to killing you."
quests.completionMessage: "You defeated one of Sodo"s shadows... Most disturbing... There are not many who can do that... You must not be too weak, but you lack speed.  The final piece has already been passed to our scientist, Mofirrets.  He will complete it, making Sodo even more powerful."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 13 of 22
quests.description: "What, you think Sodo would tell you the location? HAH!! Find Mofirrets yourself, that is if you can... Muhahahahah!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I am waiting for the assistant from Sodo.  I"ll be able to identify him by his ring.  You are obviously not the assistant....no ring."
quests.completionMessage: "That ring!! I have been waiting for you. I need to test the endurance of my creations in real combat, and I need you to gather a few items for me. When we are all done you can have this component for the Netlauncher."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 14 of 22
quests.description: "Before the testing can begin I need you to bring me back a Fire Rune, Earth Rune, and a Mayzora gem. Normally the rare Mayzora gem would be carried by the Mayzora, however it seems that the field grazing Elder Shockions have stolen it."
quests.completionMessage: "Ahh... What beautiful runes.  My first experiment is now ready for testing."  [More]
quests.hint: "Yes, I wonder where you might find a Mayzora gem, hmm..."

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Experiment 1 of 7
quests.description: "If you defeat BH-01-X, I will require its Data Core.  Now go...the first experiment is active.  I test all of my experiments in these caves."
quests.completionMessage: "I see you have completed the first experiment. The Data Core will assist my data analysis.  Each of my creations has a Data Core.  From my analysis, I will then alter each further creation."  [More]
quests.hint: "I require the Data Core from BH-01-X."

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 15 of 22
quests.description: "The Data Core will log all the data from the combat for me to improve my creations.  For materials I will need a Blue Gem and a Black Pearl.  Hunt Siltrons and Lidions for these items.  I will require these materials in order to continue with the experiments."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent! Ah, the Blue Gem and Black Pearl.  To be honest, I didn"t think these existed but I"m glad to see they do.  Thank you.  While you were gone I completed my adjustments for the next test."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Experiment 2 of 7
quests.description: "SH-0081-X is waiting for you in the back of the cave. It will be more adapted to the environment and thus a more difficult opponent. Bring me back the Data Core."
quests.completionMessage: "Tremendous, the ability to improve one"s creations is exciting."  [More]
quests.hint: "SH-0081-X is in the back of the cave."

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 16 of 22
quests.description: "You should know that each one of my exeriments will become stronger and more advanced than the last. For the next one I will need for you to bring me 3 black onyx stones. You will have to hunt down the Elite Ascherions for this one... Seriously."
quests.completionMessage: "These experiments are giving me wonderful data. As I collect the data from each of the fights, I learn more about what to do and what not to do for my bots.  These Onyx stones may give my next construct the edge it needs."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Experiment 3 of 7
quests.description: "Science always looks forward. I call this one ZZ-1070-X.  This next experiment should prove more interesting. Why must my bots be bound to the ground, hmmm? Don’t forget to bring the Data Core."
quests.completionMessage: "Man you did that quicker than I thought you were going to. Good job! Now for the next analysis."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 17 of 22
quests.description: "Hmm... I think I need to redo the designs completely. Yes... I think I got it... The next thing I will need is a Wos Robe. Come back to me when you have it."
quests.completionMessage: "To analyze or not to analyze- that is the question. Now my question to you is why are you here? Only the most advanced and experienced warriors know of what goes on here. Oh yes, the robe."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Experiment 4 of 7
quests.description: "Oh my, I think I was right about those onyxes I had you get.  I think it did the trick. Well, we"ll see.  Go challenge MSB-00X and see if I"m right."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent!! I am getting great information from these tests!! Ohhh let us see what this analysis will bring us."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 18 of 22
quests.description: "For the next experiment I will need an Eyezion eye.  You"ve aleady gotten one before?  Well then getting me another one shouldn"t be any harder."
quests.completionMessage: "See I knew you could do it.  Not hard at all."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Experiment 5 of 7
quests.description: "NGBB-00X, the next prototype is ready, and it is quite the machine too.  Hee hee hee.. Muhahaha!! I love it when things come together."
quests.completionMessage: "You look pretty banged up. Too bad... silence! We have no time to play around right now. I need to perform the next analysis."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 19 of 22
quests.description: "This is very interesting.  According to this I should try exploring the mystic channel elements.  For this I will need a tail from Datro!  I"m brilliant!"
quests.completionMessage: "You did it!  You are almost as good an assistant as I am a Mad Scientist!"

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Experiment 6 of 7
quests.description: "Ahhh... Yes.  My next experiment is ready.  GHM-001 is a tough one. I know you won"t do this, but don"t forget to bring me the Data Core."
quests.completionMessage: "We are getting so close now. My creations are almost perfect, just a few more tweaks. Quickly now, there is no time to waste!"  [More]
quests.hint: "GHM-001 doesn"t start or end in X"

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 20 of 22
quests.description: "Impressive!  I will have to work more on the firepower...  For the next step I will need Cain"s Robe. I know I ask a lot of you, but it is not anything you cannot handle. Hurry back, we are almost done here."
quests.completionMessage: "I could just take this robe and walk around naked while wearing it....OR!"  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Experiment 7 of 7
quests.description: "I could use it to complete my final Xperiment!  Finally... My final most intense Xperiment is ready! There is no way you will defeat X-1!"
quests.completionMessage: "Ahhh, thank you, thank you.  I"m Mad I tell you Mad! This string of Xperiments will prove to be very valuable to my overall research. Because you lived, here is the piece of equipment I promised. Do whatever you want with it."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 21 of 22
quests.description: "You may run into some of my Xperiments while traveling the realms so keep your eyes open.  And yes I took it upon myself to respell Xperiment!  Why?  Because I"m Mad!"
quests.hint: "You now have everything you were looking for."

quests.title: (HF) Netlauncher
quests.description: "You women are so strong.  That"s why Falene is my protector.  She keeps me safe.  So I stick with her at all times, but not too close cause she says I smell."
quests.completionMessage: "Yes, yes.  Your Netlauncher."

quests.title: (HM) Netlauncher
quests.description: "If I were human, I"d be very attracted to Falene"s behind region."
quests.completionMessage: "Here you go sir."

quests.title: Bloblic
quests.description: "I am very impressed with your size."

quests.title: Frog
quests.description: "You"re like a cuddly little slimy frog."

quests.title: Chest
quests.description: You do not have the key to this chest.
quests.completionMessage: You receive Centriole Power Generator!

quests.title: Chest
quests.description: You do not have the key to this chest.
quests.completionMessage: You receive Thermantidote Arm!

quests.title: Chest
quests.description: You do not have the key to this chest.
quests.completionMessage: You receive Nuclear Contrivance!

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Shaman Intro
quests.description: "I am the Stontrile Shaman. You should explore the world to find your place in it."
quests.completionMessage: "You say this vial came from Dr. Toad?  Well I"ll be...Wait,  What"s that?? LOOK OUT, SON!!"  [More]

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Dark Guard
quests.description: "Darius"s Dark Guard is here to kill me!! Please protect me!!"
quests.completionMessage: "Many thanks, my friend. Now where was I?  Oh yes, Someone is altering the genetic makeup of these Eyembas. I don"t know exactly what they are trying to do yet, so they must not be close to success. About all this strain would accomplish is to give them more frequent bowel movements."  [More]
quests.hint: Protect Shaman from the Dark Guard

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Stontrile Present
quests.description: "Take this inscribed stone back to Dr. Toad with my findings, but first I wish to reward you for helping me. Go and seek out Boon Frog in the Black Market caves. He is the keeper of our young. Travel through the center and make your second left. Peace be with you."
quests.hint: Take Badge to Boon Frog in the Black Market Caves

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Sailor Intro
quests.description: "I can read letters.  If you have an envelope with a letter in it I"ll read it, as long as it"s not actually to someone of course.  Reading someone else"s letters is not a good thing.  But reading mail that"s addressed to nobody...that"s dandy."
quests.completionMessage: "Curses!  The letter is encoded.  We are going to need some help with this.  I know Dr. Toad can help us here."  [More]
quests.hint: Take letter to Dr. Toad on the north part of Uoc Penn

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Encoded letter
quests.description: "Dr. Toad is on the Northern Peninsula on the Mainland of Uoc Penn.  Find him, and give him this encoded letter."
quests.completionMessage: "Quickly, let me see it.  Yes! Well done. The document is a message from the Bloblic Leader Bo detailing his plans for retaking the Bloblic Colonies from the invaders. Yet it was found on a member of the Shadowflesh army."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Dr. Toad on the Mainland

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: C.I.Amphibious
quests.description: "I need you to take this letter to Underworld Fernandez. He must give us direction."
quests.hint: Take this letter to Underworld Fernandez

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Dr. Toad Intro
quests.description: "I am Dr. Toad. I have been doing experiments and research for the Amphibious race for centuries. Now, what is it I can help you with, my  lad?"
quests.completionMessage: "This Encoded Letter is a difficult one indeed. For this I would require an encryption key, which unfortunately was stolen by the evil Aria. One of the few human females who have risen against the Amphibious race."  [More]

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Encryption Key
quests.description: "Aquadic Intellegence puts her at the Slal Island Comm Tower around this time of day. You had better hurry, she doesn"t stay in any one place longer than 20 minutes."
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, you are back, my boy! Good, good, let me see it. Ahh, very interesting... Here is the decoded document."  [More]
quests.hint: Aria has the Key at Sial Comm Tower

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Decoded document
quests.description: "Take this back to Sailor Toad, and be quick about it. I will need something from you in the future, follow Sailor Toad"s instructions and you will see."
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, these must be in response to the rumor that Darius has been doing a little funny business with the DNA, eh? And I"ll just take that Token of Strife from you, thanks."  [More]

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Second Opinion
quests.description: "Hmm, this is puzzling. I need you to take this solution sample to the Stontrile Shaman deep within the Solothic Caves. He will give me a second opinion."
quests.completionMessage: "Well done!! Let"s have a look shall we? Ah hah! The Stontrile Shaman confirms my findings. Great minds think alike, eh? Can"t say that I approve of giving all the Eyembas a massive case of diarrhea, though."  [More]
quests.hint: Take vial to Shaman within Solothic Caves

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: C.I.Amphibious
quests.description: "That will probably make them mighty upset. Well, take my report back to Underworld Fernandez. He will know what to do."

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Boon Intro
quests.description: "A Stontrile Larva must be given only to an Amphibious owner who will take care of it."
quests.completionMessage: "You have proven that you come from the Stontrile Shaman. I am the keeper of their young. He has authorized me to entrust a Stontrile Larva to your care. With the right care and training, he can be used as a powerful weapon in your hand."  [More]

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Stontrile Larva
quests.description: "Treat the Stontrile Larva well, I don"t want to hear about any neglect or abuse. Now you must take this larva and the stone you received from the Shaman back to Dr. Toad. Farewell."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Move along....move along."
quests.completionMessage: "Your job will be to check on all the Unified Guards and make sure they are at their stations. Also you will be bringing them ration"s.  Good...  Then report back to me and I"ll pay you."  [More]

quests.title: Guard Quest: Part 1 of 13
quests.description: "Your first stop is Amanda. You can find her overlooking the bloblic city. All the Guards know the routine, so they"ll tell you who to go to next."
quests.completionMessage: "Well good work. Here is 5000 cash for your trouble."  [More]

quests.title: Guard Quest: Complete
quests.description: "Make good use of that cash. If I were you I would deposit what you are not using into your vault for safe keeping. Keep your eyes out for any unwelcome red players."
quests.hint: "Credits in the vault is a very good thing!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Isn"t it such a beautiful day.  Flobs are rolling, Si Bats are flying, trees are treeing.  Isn"t it just gorgeous? Anyway, if you would like to join the Unified Guards then go and talk to Sudate across the river from Strife"s tree!"
quests.completionMessage: "How I love being outside. It"s so much nicer than being stuck indoors all day. Smell that fresh air. Smells like, like....."  [More]

quests.title: Guard Quest:  Part 2 of 13
quests.description: "Rations?  Oh, you brought rations.  Cardboard flavor, my favorite! Brig is over by the human quarter. He"s probably pretending to work around the lounge."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I have no time for you, go talk to Sudate. WELL I DON"T KNOW BUT I THINK I"M RIIGHT, A KZIIAN"S BUTT IS WATER-TIGHT! WE FIGHT ALL NIGHT AND WE SWIM ALL DAY AND WE DO IT ALL FOR LOUSY PAY! Sound off, 1, 2...  that"s right, soldier."
quests.completionMessage: "Brig reporting in, Sir! What? Sudate sent you? Yes, Sir!  Tell Sudate I"m on guard, Sir." [More]

quests.title: Guard Quest: Part 3 of 12
quests.description: "I beleive you have my rations, Sir. Thank you, Sir. Your next post can be found to the West."
quests.hint: Look for Kip to the West of the Lounge.

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I"m a little busy right now.  I"m trying to arrange a special surprise for a fellow guard that"s kind of been annoying me lately. If you would like to join the Unified Guards then go and talk to Sudate near the Air Kingdom portal!  So with that I bid you a good day sir!"
quests.completionMessage: "Kip reporting in sir.  Rations recieved."  [More]

quests.title: Guard Quest: Part 4 of 13
quests.description: "Your next check point will be Muth.  He usually spends his time spying on Celeste. And keep an eye out around him.  I have a feeling something has mysteriously happened to something he cares about. TeeHee..."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Money, I love money, so much money.  I love to make the money, and I love to roll around in the money, and sometimes others will drop their money  and then I pick up the money, and then I keep the money.  You know why, because I LOVE THE MONEY..."
quests.completionMessage: "Nooooo...My money, all my beautiful money is gone.  Someone has broken into my vault and stolen all my fabulous moola.  Sniff, Sniff,...  It...was...my...baby...I loved it like it was my child, and now it"s gone, all gone.  Atleast I can comfort myself with these rations."  [More]

quests.title: Guard Quest:  Part 5 of 13
quests.description: "Go bother Frylon on the land bridge.  Which one?  Do I look like I"m in a state to remember...Sniff, Sniff...WaaaahhhhH!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Huh?  Yeah I"m here.  Man it"s boring.  Can you stay and talk a minute.  No.  Ok I understand.  You don"t happen to have a magazine do you?  Oh well.  See ya" later.  And PLEEASE come back and visit... "
quests.completionMessage: "Oh...I"m so bored, but at least I get to eat.  I hate my job.  Nothing ever happens.  I stand and just watch the river flow, and flow, and flow, and fl.....umm.. anyways, it"s not very fun."  [More]

quests.title: Guard Quest:  Part 6 of 13
quests.description: "But I suppose you"ll be wanting to go see Eld across the river.  He never comes over and chats with me. He rarely leaves the inside of his stone wall! Oh well, back to watching the river floooooooow."
quests.hint: "Eld is across the River, behind walls of stone."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "If you would like to join the Unified Guards then go and talk to Sudate near the Air Kingdom portal! Which way ya gonna go, huh?  Which way?  You don"t even know, do ya? Do ya?"
quests.completionMessage: "Eld reporting in, Sir. Yes it"s true, I don"t get out of this stone fortress much.  In fact, the outside world kinda scares me.  It"s so wide open, dangers can come from any direction. I feel like I could be eaten any moment, and be gone forever, Sir!"  [More]

quests.title: Guard Quest: Part 7 of 13
quests.description: "Anyways, go speak to Trisha, she is watching over Strife"s tree from the other side of the river, she also has the mission of protecting the entrance to a hunting ground..."
quests.hint: "Find Trisha on the other side of the river."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I would rather be with my Grossy Poo then standing guard.  Oh how I miss him.  My little green hunka hunka burnin love.  Why hasn"t he written me?  Is it me?  Am I not pretty enough for him?  Aaawww my Grossy Poo, Come home to momma.  Pleeaaasseeeee...."
quests.completionMessage: "I miss my Grossy Poo.  I write and I write but I never hear back.  Oh Grossy!  How I miss the long nights where you would run your long green fingers through my hair.  How you used to sing to me our song."  [More]

quests.title: Guard Quest: Part 8 of 13
quests.description: "Huh, Sy?  Try looking for a small island in the river.  Oh Grossy Poo, please mend my broken heart..."
quests.hint: "Find Sy on an island in the river."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Why am I stuck on Guard Duty? Make love, not war. That"s my motto. You want to be Guard? Hmmm, go talk to Sudate near the Air Kingdom portal, he will help you."
quests.completionMessage: "Hello, my name is Sy. Do you know the difference between a female and male Kziian? Neither do I, but I sure want to find out! Oh, thanks for the rations, this will keep me going, if you know what I mean."  [More]

quests.title: Guard Quest:  Part 9 of 13
quests.description: "Hmm, I have many things to think about, like women. Go bother Jennifer between the human and amphibious cities. She"s a pretty woman. She likes to overlook the town. Now where was I?  Oh yes, women......."
quests.hint: "Jennifer is between the human and the amphibious city."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I tell you if I have Trisha whine about that guy one more time I"m going to kill them both.  Have you ever seen them together?  It"s gross.  Yeah right.  They"re both a few sticks short of a suncrest if you ask me."
quests.completionMessage: "Jennifer reporting in. Thanks a bunch for the rations."  [More]

quests.title: Guard Quest: Part 10 of 13
quests.description: "Now Deej, that"s a man.  He"s a manly man.  Oozing with machismo.  What? Oh yeah, next you need to go and speak with Trisha"s guy Gross on a small hill in the human shopping district.  He"s a little strange so watch out.  Mmm Deej..."
quests.hint: "Find Gross on a small hill in the shopping district."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Sigh, I"m sorry I"m just very sad.  My girlfriend hasn"t written me back lately. She"s so nice, I really love her..."
quests.completionMessage: "Sniff, Sniff...Oh Trisha why have you refused me...Oh how I miss her.  The way she used to rub my belly.  I hope she didn"t find someone else.  My little heart couldn"t take it."  [More]

quests.title: Guard Quest: Part 11 of 13
quests.description: "Huh, Deej, he"s watching the river, you can find him on the beach east of here.  Oh Trisha, dear Trisha.  You want to hear my Trisha song, ok ready.  Trisha, Ooh Yeah, Oh Trisha You So Hota, Ooh Yeah, How I want to Love you all Night and Day, Ooh Yeah."
quests.hint: "Find Deej on the beach to the east."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Hey come over here.  Hey I was thinking you look like a strong and beautiful person.  Give me a hug. Oh yeah that feels good, you are strong and so young. I can tell you like it...too much!  Hey, back off! I"m on duty!"
quests.completionMessage: "Did you get the stuff?  Awe, you"re a dream.  Oh yeah come here and let me hug you for all your trouble. C"mon, let me give you a great big hug.  No?  What"s the matter?"  [More]

quests.title: Guard Quest: Part 12 of 13
quests.description: "Ok whatever; I guess some of us aren"t as secure as others.  Anyway I"m the last guard, so just run on back and talk to Sudate and he"ll give you your check. Oh yeah, I live for this stuff."

quests.title: (BL)
quests.description: "I have lost my precious eggs! After moving to this Pub I noticed that my beautiful Dominion Egg collection was missing!  If you were to find all 9 missing eggs, I would reward you with a extraordinary ring."
quests.completionMessage: "Oh... You found my eggs!  Thank you so much!  Oh, my eggs... my beautiful little eggs! That was so nice of you. Here"s that ring I told you about. It will increase your strength by 20."

quests.title: (AP)
quests.description: "I have lost my precious eggs! After moving to this Pub I noticed that my beautiful Dominion Egg collection was missing!  If you were to find all 9 missing eggs, I would reward you with an extraordinary ring."
quests.completionMessage: "Oh... You found my eggs!  Thank you so much!  Oh, my eggs... my beautiful little eggs! That was so nice of you. Here"s that ring I told you about. It will increase your strength by 20."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Too long have the Sarins been slaughtered for their hearts. We will have our revenge. I will not speak to an untrusted overworlder."
quests.completionMessage: "A key from Glagrog means trust to the Sarins.  We are gearing up for war, but our biggest weakness is the blinding frenzy of our warriors at the sight of an overworlder. They attack without pause nor reinforcements. Therefore they are always defeated."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 1 of 9
quests.description: "If I was a small puppy, I would want my puppy tummy rubbed."
quests.completionMessage: "Keep the key for safe keepings.  An overworlder like yourself could show them the value of teamwork and organization.  Agreed?  Good!  Word of your arrival will be sent but don"t expect a warm reception. I will give you my Jewel for identifation."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 1 of 9
quests.description: "Sometimes I dress up like a little girl."
quests.completionMessage: "First instruct Trus at Unity Outpost, due east of here.  He will tell you where to go from there."  [More]
quests.hint: Check in with Trus at Unity

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 1 of 9
quests.description: "By helping us, I Ocsylop, promise that you will be spared after we conquor the Overworld.  I can offer you a few pieces of rare armor from our war stockpile, carefully modified to your measurements."
quests.completionMessage: "You have done TOO well. You have exposed all of our weaknesses and we are a long way from fighting as a unit. See my servant for your reward, but if you leave now before collecting it, you may not get it in the future."  [More]
quests.hint: Check in with Trus at Unity

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Complete
quests.description: "I have also recommended your services to a friend in the Underworld Catacombs who has a problem that affects all of us. The letter will grant you audience with him, and the special emblem you receive with your armor will act as a key to the Catacomb portal."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I will wait for my orders...mMmMust resist killing you....mMmMust wait for orders...."
quests.completionMessage: "You are the one, eh? Good! We have summoned a force of Sarins to oppose you. They will undoubtedly defeat you with ease and end this farce of an experiment."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 4 of 9 Fight!
quests.description: "You must travel quickly to Death Valley and engage them in battle. In the unlikely event you should defeat them, bring back what they are carrying as proof, or I will know you ran like the cowardly overworlder you are."
quests.completionMessage: "Wait... is this it?? This is only what Purt was carrying... you mean no one else showed up?? ARGH!! How can we hope to overcome the masses on the overworld if we cannot summon more than ONE warrior to battle?"  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 4 of 9
quests.description: "I have changed my mind about you, it is essential we learn how to organize in times of battle. Take my letter to Quis on the western coast of Sial Island."
quests.hint: Find Quis on the Sial Island coast

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I do not know you. Bother someone else, please."
quests.completionMessage: "We are nearly out of trained warriors. Fortunately, the Elder Shockion have allied with us. I understand they are ready to show us how it is done."  [More]
quests.hint: "You must talk to Requess before talking to me."

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 5 of 9
quests.description: "Take that sealed letter to Digson in the Arilous Mining Caves. Your service is almost at an end, for good or ill."
quests.hint: Find Digson in the Arilous Mining Caves

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Do not trifle with me, overworlder."
quests.completionMessage: "I see you"ve come from Digson."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 7 of 9 Fight!
quests.description: "It is true, Quis is paranoid. Yet he does have a point. Digson says you are here to train my men.  If that is so, go train them.  Take your best shot.  They should all be here by now."
quests.completionMessage: "Why was only Gisgis here?  What happened to my minions?!  Grospon will know what to do!  I will trust that you are no spy.  Take this so he will know I sent you."  [More]
quests.hint: Train my men if you can

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 7 of 9
quests.description: "Grospon"s forces are gathered inside Firetown near the exit of the underworld."
quests.hint: Near the exit of Firetown, find Grospon

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "My companions and I might have some use for you when the time comes."
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, our overworld correspondent. Many thanks for showing us the weaknesses of our Sarin commanders. But today you will see how the Shockions do battle. They have sent a force of Elder Shockions who are at my command."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 8 of 9 Attack!
quests.description: "They will defeat you easily, and in turn, we will use them as our force to conquer the overworld."
quests.completionMessage: "All for nothing! The Elder Shockions have pulled out of our alliance. They say that there is more honor in our most recent demonstration of solo combat than in overwhelming our foes with numbers. There"s no way we"d win like that."  [More]
quests.hint: "I dare you to prove me wrong."

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 8 of 9 Payoff
quests.description: "Are you pulling some kind of trick?"
quests.completionMessage: "We are ruined!  There is nothing left to do but honor our agreement with you.  I give to you the Sarin Badge."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 8 of 9
quests.description: "History will show that Ocsylop made a wise choice when he selected you. I bestow upon you the greatest honor in all Sarindom. The Sarin Badge. Take it back to Ocsylop and he will reward you."
quests.hint: Show your Sarin Badge to Ocsylop

quests.title: (BL) Cyclopean Armor
quests.description: "You should not be talking to me.  I am just a slave to the Sarin."
quests.completionMessage: "I"m so, so sorry.  This is all the armor I can give you.  The other pieces are much more rare and must be found in the more dangerous parts of the world. I"ve also given you an emblem that will give you access to the catacombs."

quests.title: Kzon-removed-archived
quests.description: "You should not be talking to me.  I am just a slave to the Sarin."
quests.completionMessage: "The Sarin"s hold many dark secrets. You have just found one of them. Here quickly take this battle suit before they find out. Tell no one of this for they will have my hide if they find out I gave this to you. Go quickly now!"

quests.title: Infant Hipion-removed-archived
quests.description: "You should not be talking to me.  I am just a slave to the Sarin."
quests.completionMessage: "The Sarin"s hold many dark secrets. You have just found one of them. Here quickly take this battle suit before they find out. Tell no one of this for they will have my hide if they find out I gave this to you. Go quickly now!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "If Cain were allowed to grow in strength, little could oppose him. You bear no token for me."
quests.completionMessage: "Welcome, you have come highly recommended. There is a great evil that grows and threatens to envelop all of IIA. I am in need of your assistance to stop it. Cain has been awakened and he grows stronger by the day. Some of my brothers have fallen in their battle with Cain and some of them have joined his side."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 1 of 20
quests.completionMessage: "Cain is preparing for a war to end all wars. He has been recruiting many solders. We must find a way to imprison him again. I will send you as my envoy to many people and you must use your best judgment as to how to deal with them."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 1 of 20
quests.description: "When you"ve completed your mission, I will take from our storehouse a piece of unique armor with a special emblem that gives access to the Cave of the Ancients. Go now into the Catacombs and speak to Nargas."
quests.completionMessage: "This is most disturbing. We seem powerless to keep Cain from recruiting new solders. You must call upon my brother Argos and seek his assistance."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 10 of 20
quests.description: "Argos will be on the Uoc Penn peninsula. Take him this letter and bring me back his reply."
quests.completionMessage: "The Cross of Bane! You have done well. Cain"s power grows, as does his influence. He knows we are close to defeating him and he panics. He has taken over the mind of one of my brothers in an attempt to distract us. Yet in so doing he has spread his power too thin."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Argos on Uoc Penn peninsula

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "I need you to find Tregoh on Sial island he will be able to help you find my brother. If you succeed, Cain"s power will be diminished enough to make him vulnerable. Go quickly."
quests.completionMessage: "Well done! Your defeat of Tipston has dealt a heavy blow to Cain. Now he is ripe for defeat."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat my brother Tipston on Slal Island

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!!
quests.description: "He has had to assume material form deep within these Catacombs in order to recover his strength.  Go now and defeat him."
quests.completionMessage: "You have done it! Cain has been defeated, and with the loss of his material form we have managed to imprison his spirit once more. I am in your debt. Take this token, and turn it in to my servant whenever you are ready for your reward."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and defeat Cain in the Catacombs

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Complete
quests.description: "Have you tried out the armor you earned?"
quests.hint: Redeem Blapstion"s token with his servant

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I only know of the things I know.  You know?"
quests.completionMessage: "Blapstion must trust you or he would not have sent you to me. Listen closely, Cain is a terrible being and cannot be taken lightly.  I wish for Vlas to look at this Moss covered Stone."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 2 of 20
quests.description: "You must take the Stone to Vlas on Moon"s Rift. Do not examine it too closely, the less you know the less you can divulge under duress."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Would you judge yourself strong enough to join Cain"s army!"
quests.completionMessage: "Yes, I am Cain"s agent. Would you like to join our army? No! You have the Scepter of Power! I... Must have it back! Listen to me. I am Cain"s lead recruiter in the Black Market. Battle my top recruit for the Scepter. If we win, we take it back. But if you win, I will leave Cain"s army and cease recruiting for him."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Meet one of Cain"s warrior"s, before you die.  Algona!"
quests.completionMessage: "Wow. You slaughtered him. I guess Cain"s army isn"t as impressive as I thought. I"m joining the side with you on it. I can help stop Cain"s recruiting."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 4 of 20
quests.description: "Take this letter to my friend Lasgat, he is located in the sewers of Trendor."
quests.completionMessage: "The Orb of COA!! This is a great find. Cain had hoped to use this to close the entrance to the Cave of the Ancients and turn that place into his command center. It looks damaged... I will try to repair it."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Lasgat in the sewers of Trendor

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 9 of 20
quests.description: "In the meantime, take this vial to Blapstion, for he has requested it. While you are there, ask him for a status report."
quests.completionMessage: "This Scepter belongs to Kiston, as you doubtless have deduced. You must take it to him along with this letter of instruction. He has sent word asking for your help, though I do not know his need."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 12 of 20
quests.description: "Go now. Kiston keeps watch over Uoc Penn from the high towers of Trendor City."
quests.hint: Deliver scepter to Kiston atop Trendor city

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I support the strong."
quests.completionMessage: "Yes, Flogran and I are fast friends. Hmmm... his letter says that you beat his top recruit, and that you are opposing Cain!"  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 5 of 20
quests.description: "You must speak to Val in the Catacombs and convince her to leave Cain"s service. Return with her answer."
quests.completionMessage: "That pains me that she would not join us, but your triumph over her confirms that I am on the correct side. Let us try to sway another of Cain"s minions."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 7 of 20
quests.description: "Take this letter to Tasgot, he is beyond Val in the Catacombs."
quests.hint: Find Tasgot beyond Val in the Catacombs

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Be careful who you talk to in these parts."
quests.completionMessage: "Yes, I am in Cain"s service, what of it? You have a letter from Lasgat? Well, let me see it! I see that he wants me to leave Cain"s army and join his enemies. He says you are more than a match for any of Cain"s warriors. You must be very powerful, I need to think about this a moment..."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "That"s enough thinking. Attack him, Zeg!"
quests.completionMessage: "You have Zeg"s tablets! Give them to me!"  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!!
quests.description: "Destroy the Intruder, Jarude!"
quests.completionMessage: "Jarude, is only but a minion.  He is no example of power Cain"s commands."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!!!
quests.description: "Based on your performance, you have earned a fight with me!"
quests.completionMessage: "You have defeated me."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 6 of 20
quests.description: "Take my Sword to Lasgat. I am not worthy to join either side. At least I will no longer be used by Cain."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Cain needs ruthless, cunning soldiers."
quests.completionMessage: "I know and trust Lasgat, but I don"t believe that you are as tough as he says you are. Prove it to me."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 8 of 20
quests.description: "Gather 8 Rancon Hides. I will also be sending Closlpen, one of my recruits after you to keep you honest. Prove that you are worthy of my respect by taking him down as well."
quests.completionMessage: "Lasgat was right, you are tougher than you look. Forgive me for doubting. I will leave Cain"s service and join the resistance."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 8 of 20
quests.description: "As proof of my allegiance, take this vial to Flogran, he will find it useful.  Also, the orb that my recruit was carrying may be more than it seems."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Cain divides families and should be opposed at any cost."
quests.completionMessage: "You are right to oppose Cain, his evil goes back farther than anyone knows. He was instrumental in having two of my brothers cursed by the Supreme High Priest of Crom. But I believe we can use his work against him."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 11 of 20
quests.description: "You must bring me the Grey Rune and the Blue Rune so we can use them to undermine Cain"s power before it grows too strong."
quests.completionMessage: "By divining these Runes, we should be able to determine the power tha......"  [More]
quests.hint: Bring the Grey and Blue Runes to Argos

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Prepare yourself!  One of Cain"s minions is here! Defeat Glactian!"
quests.completionMessage: "You are truly a great ally. I believe this Scepter Glactian was carrying belongs to Kiston, but I do not remember which side he is on. We must be cautious about this."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 11 of 20
quests.description: "Take that scepter to Flogran. He will be able to tell you more."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I don"t know why, but I"ve always wanted to speak with a dramatic, booming voice instead of this hissing lisp."
quests.completionMessage: "I have uncovered a plot by Cain to recruit many of my people. The Shockions are fearsome warriors as you must know, and if Cain succeeds in gathering them all, no force will be able to withstand him."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 18 of 20
quests.description: "Take this amulet to my kinsman Dablo in the Black Market caves. You must convince him to join us. He has a holy symbol that aids Cain called the Cross of Bane. Retrieve it whether or not Dablo agrees to join us."
quests.completionMessage: "Wonderful news! With Dablo on our side, Cain will lose his Shockion support and his numbers will dwindle. Plus you have returned with the Cross of Bane!"  [More]
quests.hint: Find Dablo in the Black Market Caves

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 20 of 20
quests.description: "You must hold on to the Cross of Bane for safekeeping, I cannot think of anyone else who can keep it safer. Take my report back to Blapstion."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Really? You are here to talk me out of gambling? Care to make a little wager on that?"
quests.completionMessage: "Vecapan is greatly respected among our people. But I am more a man of chance, myself.  You take on my high risk game and not only will I join you...I"ll reward you for playing.  What do you say?"  [More]

quests.title: Armor Lvl 13: Fight!
quests.description: "Let"s start with a hard 8...Salspton, destroy the infidel!"
quests.completionMessage: "Hold on there slappy!  Here"s some money! Now are you ready for the next deal?"  [More]
quests.hint: My Salspton will slap you silly!

quests.title: Armor Lvl 13: Fight!!
quests.description: "Aquan, Sick"em!"
quests.completionMessage: "More money for the infidel!  Wanna go again?"  [More]

quests.title: Armor Lvl 13: Fight!!!
quests.description: "See how this one fits! Papstaon!"
quests.completionMessage: "Now you"ll be able to buy yourself some infidel underpants.  It wouldn"t surprise me if you got the glow-in-the-dark kind."  [More]

quests.title: Armor Lvl 13: Fight!!!!
quests.description: "Momma needs a new pair of boots! Nanontan!"
quests.completionMessage: "Okay, have you ever heard of double or nothing?" [More]

quests.title: Armor Lvl 13: Fight!!!!!
quests.description: "Double or nothing, Bosia!"
quests.completionMessage: "So you called my bluff.  My luck isn"t going so great but I feel a change of favor coming on..."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat Bosia and bring loot to Dablo

quests.title: Armor Lvl 13: Fight!!!!!!
quests.description: "I"ll stand pat with Pasp!"
quests.completionMessage: "Speaking of worthless paper, here"s another one.  This one"s more of a parchment though."  [More]

quests.title: Armor Lvl 13: Part 19 of 20
quests.description: "You are nothing short of amazing... I understand why Vecapan gives you his vote of confidence. Go ahead and take that Cross to Vecapan.  Go in peace my gambling friend."
quests.hint: Take that cross back to Vecapan

quests.title: Wispion Armor
quests.description: "I am only a servant to Blapstion."
quests.completionMessage: "I first gnaw on a Tilidon Spine and spit the powder into my hands... [CRKGRRRCK!!] Then the paste is rubbed on the armor which nullifies its poisonous effect on your tender flesh. Here is your reward. Rest in the knowledge that you have saved the lives of all who dwell on this planet."

quests.title: Intro
quests.completionMessage: "I see that you are in the market for new guns. Well I sell clones of special questable guns, of course at a worthy price... for me that isss! Why would you want one of these? Well I hear that engineers can modify my here guns into different channels.  If you are a froggie that wants a modified Dilirium you can just speak to me"  [More]

quests.title: Preparation
quests.completionMessage: "Well there is a buddy of mine that can create these for you, but he will not tell you what he needs.  This is where I come in.  Ok, listen up because I hate to repeat myself.  I will tell you what you need for each Dilirium conversion - Fire, Water, and Earth.  Let me know when you are ready."  [More]

quests.title: Fire Dilirium
quests.completionMessage: "Ok, for the Fire conversion you will need the following - Fire Rune, four Lava rocks, and of course the Normal version of the Dilirium. Now for the Water one. Are you ready?"  [More]

quests.title: Water Dilirium
quests.completionMessage: "Ok, for the Water conversion you will need the following - Water Rune, two Water stones, and of course the Normal version of the Dilirium. Last, but not least, the Earth. Are you ready?"  [More]

quests.title: Earth Dilirium
quests.completionMessage: "Ok, for the Earth conversion you will need the following - Earth Rune, twenty Lafe stones, and of course the Normal version of the Dilirium.  Seek out Gorges over on the other side of Fire Town when you are ready."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Greetings, ground worm. Are you ready to get your feet off the ground? I teach Amphibians how to fly. To learn this skill, one must have a set of wings which can be purchased. So go purchase a set. I"m glad I could help."
quests.completionMessage: "Look at this, a frog and his wings. Brings tears to my eyes it does. You will need to arm  or equip them before you use them. If you didn"t arm them before, I just armed them to get you start. Now, press the ForceJet key to use them." [More]

quests.title: Introduction to Fly:  Lesson 1
quests.description: "Good. Okay, ready for your first lesson? Well, fools always rush in... but here we go. I need you to find a canister on this island that you can open with your key. Once you have found it, bring its contents to me and I may let you move on to lesson 2."
quests.completionMessage: "Well, you succeeded, and I"m amazed. The next task will be more difficult. The canister you need to find is much higher than it was last time, make sure your wings are ready for it. You need to go retrieve the contents of the second canister for me."  [Ready]

quests.title: Introduction to Fly:  Lesson 2
quests.description: "Well, hop along now little froggy. Isn"t this just the greatest fun?"
quests.completionMessage: "Fabulous, you"ve returned. I hope you didn"t fall too many times. At my age I didn"t think anything could shock me, but you have. Here"s your Inceptor License. Practice and learn.  Fly free and all that nonsense." [More]

quests.title: Introduction to Fly:  Complete
quests.description: "Well, I don"t know much about those Hovermajiggies and Jetskabobs, but I do know that in the Black Market area there"s a Blob named Samuan who can help you out with the blasted things if you so desire. Don"t tell him I trained you, because I"ll deny it."
quests.hint: Find Samuan on the West side of Black Market Island

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Go buy a jet pack and return, cadet."
quests.completionMessage: "Okay, cadet, you seem equipped for your first instruction on personal propulsion transportation. My jetpack training will qualify you for your Inceptor License.  Without this license you will not be able to continue on to operate more advanced jetpacks and vehicles. So this is a must-have, cadet." [More]

quests.title: Introduction to Fly:  Lesson 1
quests.description: "I have already put the jetpack on you if you hadn"t figured it out before. Press the ForceJet key to use it. Your instruction begins with a simple task. Find a canister above us that you can open with this key. Bring its contents to me ASAP. Dismissed, cadet."
quests.completionMessage: "Too slow, cadet... but we"Il remedy that right now. Now listen up. I need you to find a second canister, it is further away this time, and harder to obtain. You can find it near in the bridge area."  [Ready]

quests.title: Introduction to Fly:  Lesson 2
quests.description: "Okay, now, go find that canister. You"ll need a full jetpack. I don"t want to see you ground hugging, cadet."
quests.completionMessage: "Acceptable performance, Cadet. Remember that keen observation, persistance, and willingness to accept risk are essential traits for BO"s service. You have earned your first license, but this is not the end.

quests.title: Introduction to Fly:  Complete
quests.description: "Go speak to Officer Samuan in a bunker near the Black Market. Dismissed, and may Ataeus guide your strikes as you battle in the sky.."
quests.hint: Find Samuan on the West side of Black Market Island

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Hey there! Go buy yourself a jetpack and I"ll teach ya how ta fly!"
quests.completionMessage: "Alright, hun, you are ready for your first Inceptor License lesson. You need this license to be able to operate your jetpack legally. Without it, you can"t move on to more advanced jetpacks and vehicles. You need this training, so let"s go!"  [More]

quests.title: Introduction to Fly:  Lesson 1
quests.description: "Now, if you were a little slow before I have armed your jetpack. Press the ForceJet key to use it. Alright then! Now, what ya have to do is search outside of this city on uoc for a little canister on a really tall hill and bring me what you find inside. Hurry back and be careful!"
quests.completionMessage: "Alright!  Wonderful job! The next task will be more difficult. You need to leave the city, and find the canister in the area around the city this time. Be careful of the waters below."  [Ready]

quests.title: Introduction to Fly:  Lesson 2
quests.description: "Take your key and get to finding that canister. Isn"t this just the greatest fun?"
quests.completionMessage: "Awesome, you made your way through the jump pads. I hope you didn"t fall too many times. You have now earned your inceptor license." [More]

quests.title: Introduction to Fly:  Complete
quests.description: "If you"re ready to play with some brand new toys, go see Samuan near the Black Market. He"ll be sure to help you!"
quests.hint: Find Samuan on the West side of Black Market Island

quests.title: (BL) Sting Layzor
quests.description: "I redeem Master Uspoan"s token from his easy game.  You might have me confused with my brother, or you haven"t a token at all."
quests.completionMessage: "I take the token and give you the gun. Token is much lighter to hold. Whew! Thank you."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I am not feeling well...(Gurgle, Gurgle)  Oh, my tummy."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you messenger of Ligs.  Pligton Liquid keeps me regular, but you"re crazy if you think I"ll forgive Glagrog now.  Don"t push me.  I"m very touchy about this subject." [More]
quests.hint: "If only I had some Pligton Liquid."

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "I warned you. My patient Listop is ready and waiting for your challenge."
quests.completionMessage: "I told you!  Forget it!  Long ago, Glagrog replaced my medicine with Neglik Nectar as a joke. I took a big swig...nearly choked to death!!  Give me one good reason!?" [More]

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Fight!!
quests.description: "Ewww...Ok that"s a good reason, but not a great reason. A great reason would be taking on my friend Kro, behind you."
quests.completionMessage: "Still here?  How about taking on my Datro! Ok, you got me, I don"t have one of those...but at least that"s funny.  Take a package to Sol for me and accept this present as a thank you for helping our family." [More]
quests.hint: "How"s the fight with my Kro going?"

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Part 3 of 9
quests.description: "He"s on Sluggith Island.  That"s the adjoining island just north of here past the Black Market"s Northern Tower.  Plus, he might be able to tell you what that rusted thing is I gave you.  As for me, I think I"ll write Glagrog a letter."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "You can"t just go around bothering people for no reason. Begone and trouble me no more."
quests.completionMessage: "You say that Sol sent you? Look, I would be more than happy to forgive Glagrog, but I"ve got bigger problems."  [More]
quests.hint: "Some of my brothers are chattier than I."

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Part 5 of 9
quests.description: "I keep getting hassled by Forgral Friganton"s gang. Their hideout is in the first main rock cavern inside Black Market. Here"s his wanted poster.  Ugly looking mug if you ask me."
quests.completionMessage: "You really defeated the Friganton Gang!  Now I can start illegally smuggling again. Hooray!  I"ll be sure to accept Glagrog"s apologies...in a letter."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Part 7 of 9
quests.description: "Do me this favor for Glagrog"s sake? Carry my report to our brother Phigon, he"d be interested in seeing that we"re back in business.  He lives in the same mine where Glagrog lives but they don"t speak."
quests.hint: "Find Phigon in the same Mine as Glagrog."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Whoa, you must be lost.  Plus you ain"t got business with me."
quests.completionMessage: "So Bok sent you to me, huh?  Oh and look at this, you carry my picture with you.  You must be a fan.  Here"s my card, call on me when you"re ready for a beating."  [MORE]
quests.hint: "You wouldn"t want to mess with me just yet."

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "My gang was hoping you wouldn"t back down! My young apprentice, Brisk, is looking over us now and is itching for a fight. Finding him is the easy part.  He"s not hiding.  Bring me his sword if you dare."
quests.completionMessage: "You beat him, eh?  I"ll give you another chance to run away. If not, I"ll introduce you to another member of my gang. She won"t be as accommodating as Brisk."  [MORE]

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Fight!!
quests.description: "You can"t say I didn"t give you fair warning. Trin is in one of these adjoined tunnel"s entrances.  Your reward for finding her will be a swift and painful death."
quests.completionMessage: "I can"t say I"m not dissappointed in my companions, but I"m a different story.  If you don"t leave now you"re in for a big surprise."  [MORE]
quests.hint: "You couldn"t have found Trin yet, you"re alive."

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Fight!!!
quests.description: "So you wanna rumble with me.  Well this ain"t me.  This is my automated projection.  So, here are my rules. You have 30 minutes to find and defeat the real me in these caves.  Starting now!"
quests.completionMessage: "No fair! You hit me when I wasn"t looking! Plus I know you got that gun illegally and to top it off you were clipping! You speed-hacking exploiter!"  [More]
quests.hint: "I might check behind me and to the left, but that"s just me."

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Part 6 of 9
quests.description: "Well, I"ve already given you my badge. Go on and take it to Bok and tell him we"ll leave him alone from now on. Dirty, rotten cheater..."
quests.hint: "I hope Bok doesn"t gloat "cause I lost."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I"m in too much pain to talk with you now.  Gwenam assures me that all pain heals with time."
quests.completionMessage: "You spoke with Gwenam?  It is true I am a master smith and I would reward you for helping me, but it would take some time to do.  Think about it and speak to me again if you are interested, until then I"ll just stand here and sulk." [More]
quests.hint: Gwenam is always looking out for me

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Part 1 of 9
quests.description: "You"re ready now?!  Wonderful. To begin, find my brother Ligs on Sial Island northwest of here and give him this peace offering.  If you can express my apologies to all my brothers I shall craft you armor that cannot be lost in death."
quests.completionMessage: "This is great news! I now have my family back. You have truly done me a great favor. Take this token. Safron will exchange it for the suit of armor I prepared for you while you were gone." [More]
quests.hint: Ligs resides in the center of Sial Island

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Completed
quests.description: "Have you tried out my armor yet?  Armor that can"t be lost can come in handy."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "You say you come from Glagrog?  Pah!  The name Glagrog is as the stench at the bottom of a well-worn set of boots.  Now go away!  I don"t want to lose my lunch.  I"d have to catch it again."
quests.completionMessage: "You dare to bring me a peace offering from that worthless Glagrog?!  There"s only one response I can give to anyone bearing a gift from him; a sound beating from my Isp! What do you say to that?" [More]

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Isp!  Attack!!!"
quests.completionMessage: "Hold on there tough guy!  If you say Glagrog is sorry for that joke he pulled on Bis, I"ll believe you. How about doing me a favor?" [More]
quests.hint: "My Isp will wipe the ground with you."

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Part 2 of 9
quests.description: "Great! You take this medicine to my cousin Bis inside the main room of the Black Market, east of the 4 Falls Portal in this world, if you can get him to forgive Glagrog, then maybe I will too."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Leave me. Can"t you see my underpants are glowing!  I don"t care much for practical jokes!"
quests.completionMessage: "I have no idea what that rusted piece of junk is, just hold on to it! But I suppose I could let my own personal embarrassment go for the sake of family. Bok has also been hurt deeply by Glagrog, although not to the degree of humiliation that the glowing underpants gag was for me."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 11 Quest: Part 4 of 9
quests.description: "He will want to know about Glagrog"s change of heart.  Take my message to Bok.  You can find him hiding just inside the Northern most water entrance of the Amphibious Caves northwest of here."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Do I know you? More importantly, do you know me? Through this fog of memory loss I still recall the standards of this world and I can sense who has power and who is weak. I will not speak to any who have not achieved the highest level of honor among Strife"s forces."
quests.completionMessage: "Who am I? That is a good question. My past is hidden from me and I cannot begin to contemplate my future. This is because my mind is engulfed by the strange fog of memory loss.  But I do know that I need help to reclaim the memories that are rightly mine."  [More]
quests.hint: Bring the highest Gidion to the unknown amphibian

quests.title: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "Distant memories are whispering to me of deep magic and ancient remedies. I have grasped the fleeting thread of an old cure for head trauma from the tumult in my mind and I recall the instructions for making a poultice which should clear some of my cobwebs."  [More]

quests.title: Crom Quest: Part 1 of 10
quests.description: "It requires a rare growth from a type of Elder Shockion that has long since vanished from this planet. Take the trench and encounter the Cave of Ancients Elder just before you reach the first chamber at the end of the tunnel. Kill the Elder and extract the growth from its corpse. I will be waiting."
quests.completionMessage: "Let me add the final ingredient you have obtained to the poultice I have prepared. I will now apply it to my head in hopes of gaining a foothold on this mist that assails my mind. Ahhh, that is soothing... let us wait a moment in silence and see what healing this brings."  [More]
quests.hint: Elder at the bottom of the CoA trench

quests.title: Crom Quest: Part 2 of 10
quests.description: "Things are a little clearer now. Yes. I believe I am the victim of powerful magicks that are actively hiding my past, present and future from me. I further believe that the Air Rune contains some magicks of its own for dispelling this curse that keeps my past from me. Be swift, for I am lost here without you."
quests.completionMessage: "Now I must grind this Air Rune to powder and ingest it. Nothing around to use as a tool, so I will just use my hands... mmphh... there. You seem surprised that I can do this... is this not something everyone can do? Now I must wait for the effects of the powder to take hold."  [More]
quests.hint: Bring the Air Rune back to me

quests.title: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "It is working. I can remember my origin. I recall the moment I took my first breath, and I know I am older than the seas of this world. I can see in my mind"s eye that I was born completely sentient, created by ancient powers for a purpose which... ah, a purpose that I cannot remember."  [More]

quests.title: Crom Quest: Part 3 of 10
quests.description: "The foul magicks still keep that from me. But I can now call on ancient magick of my own to help myself. If you can bring me the Earth Rune I can use it to break the hold these cursed magicks have on my present memory. I long to know my name and be able to tell it to you."
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, thank you for this. I must reduce this Earth Rune to its raw energies and absorb them through my skin. I can do this with but a single mental command... there. Ungghh!! By Crom, this magick is strong! I must wrestle with it and drive it from my body if I am to regain the memories of my present self."  [More]

quests.title: Crom Quest: Part 4 of 10
quests.description: "Are you still there? Good, for I have need of you again. My ancient remedies are working and I now know my name. Forgive me, but I must keep that from you for now. You must trust me. I must know my purpose in this world, and for that I will need the Future Rune. Bring it to me and you will earn more of my favor."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent. You return with the proper rune. This may amuse you... watch as I convert this Future Rune to liquid form using deep magic. Now I suspend the liquid before me and consume it. Mmm.... I tell you, I am eager to learn of my future and my purpose. Let us hope this will loosen the grip of this nefarious curse."  [More]
quests.hint: Bring the Future Rune to me

quests.title: Crom Quest: Part 5 of 10
quests.description: "Uhnnggh... my head!! Memories are flooding back, yet the curse besetting me is not easily defeated. I must re-allign the molecular structure of my body to more effectively rid myself of this curse. You must find me an Orb of Dark Jouster and let me hold it in my hands."
quests.completionMessage: "Again you prove yourself to me. Let me hold the Dark Jouster Orb. I can see the pattern within this item... I will simulate this pattern within myself, yet not quite as intense... Ngghghg... Yes! Ah, free at last! Here you are, you may have your orb back. Now I must focus my attention on those who dared to do this to me."  [More]
quests.hint: Bring me an Orb of Dark Jouster

quests.title: Crom Quest: Part 6 of 10
quests.description: "Someone did this to me, and I will not rest until I discover who it was. The power to discover my attackers lies within me, and once I determine their identity then you will be my messenger of retribution. Show me that you possess the Oafinster weapon before we continue."
quests.completionMessage: "I see you have your Oafinster quest weapon.  I have managed to determine the names of those who have dealt with me so treacherously. Oh, they were careful. But they underestimated their foe and will now face the consequences."  [More]
quests.hint: Bring me the Oafinster quest weapon

quests.title: Crom Quest: Part 7 of 10
quests.description: "The ones who affected my memory are quite powerful. Oh, they would be no match for me. But against you, they will prove quite a challenge. I do have compassion for you and will not let you go into battle unprepared. That is why I must have you show me the Tristnarak Rune Gun before I will let you face them."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent, you have your Tristnarak weapon with you. It will be necessary in order for you to deliver my judgment to those who did this to me. Yes, I now know their identities. Rest up and prepare, for I am sending you against them. Speak to me again when you are ready."  [More]
quests.hint: Show me the Tristnarak rune weapon

quests.title: Crom Quest: Part 8 of 10 Fight!
quests.description: "Listen closely, I have discovered the name of the first of my tormentors and am sending you to kill him. He is the leader of the Bloblics and his name is Bo.  I have lured him here with a distress signal from an ancient acquaintance of his. Take the trench passage down to the first chamber and bring me his head."
quests.completionMessage: "Did I not tell you that Bo could be defeated? You must trust my words and that I will not lead you astray. Now I must lay a trap for the second member of this conspiracy. Prepare yourself for another difficult battle.  Things are falling into place, my young apprentice."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat Bo in the 1st chamber at the bottom of CoA

quests.title: Crom Quest: Part 9 of 10 Fight!!
quests.description: "I have lured the second member of the conspiracy against me to the bottom of CoA and it will be your job to show him my wrath. The name of your foe is Darius. Take the trench down to the bottom of CoA and look for him on the far side of the second chamber. Bring me his head."
quests.completionMessage: "Congratulations, my agent of destruction. You have helped me gain revenge upon those who treated me cruelly. The taste of revenge is ever-sweet!  As for your reward, I have one more task for you."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat Darius in the 2nd chamber at the bottom of CoA

quests.title: Crom Quest: Part 10 of 10 Fight!!!
quests.description: "I have uncovered an even deeper plot than the conspiracy of Darius and Bo.  I cannot speak his name aloud, but you will find him in the third chamber at the end of the trench tunnel.  When you return I will reveal my name to you."
quests.completionMessage: "You defeated Crom! He was responsible for all you had been through. But there is more, for you see I am Crom! Yes, I am the reason for all of your trials. Your first reward is my Crest which you can wear proudly to show all that you have completed the trials of Crom."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat the unknown assailant in the third chamber

quests.title: Crom Quest: Complete
quests.description: "Your second reward is a key to one of my five chests. They are located throughout this land and four of them contain a valuable piece of Crom Armor. The fifth one contains the fabled Wings of Crom which are permanent wings of flight bearing my blessing. Find the chests and try your key, but be careful of impersonators."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "You should be careful around these parts.  There are thieves around that will kill you in your sleep."
quests.completionMessage: "You helped my brother get the Generator Casing back. Nice! It turns out that there are a few of those thieves" scouts lurking around inside the ruins with the Sundial atop them. As archaic as it sounds, if I"m to help you, I need an eye from each of them. Now listen..."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 4 of 22
quests.description: "They are all eyez and are not visible all the time. And I imagine that to extract their eye, it will probably be easiest if you kill them first."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent...Here, take this. The Compressor will be safer in you hands anyway.  I have tracked down where they are camping from up here.  I saw them running towards town."  [More]
quests.hint: "Hunt down the Scouts in the Sundial."

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 5 of 22
quests.description: "They must be inside the Black Market facility. Track down a man named Gosh.  He should be able to tell you more about the thieves" location. If you need a reminder of what components I need, check your Quest Journal.  Some components can only be found in chests."
quests.completionMessage: "You did it!  You have gotten all my parts back!  This is excellent.  Now I can finally finish my work... this will take only a minute..."  [More]
quests.hint: "Track down Gosh in a city of criminals."

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 8 of 22
quests.description: "That"s it, one of the most beautiful works I"ve done.  You also got Gosh"s Ring of Ancients?  Ahh... their leader will be surprised to see you carrying this around. Sodo is in for a fight now... time for you to seek out Sodo.  You"ll find Sodo located near Eyezion"s lair in the Cave of Ancients."
quests.hint: "Time to find Sodo in the CoA."

quests.title: Wstone
quests.description: You do not have the correct extractor to harvest this stone.
quests.completionMessage: You gain a Water Stone.

quests.description: You do not have the proper extractor for this process. Please use Extractor 2 for Plants and Roots in order to complete this task.
quests.completionMessage: You have succesfully extracted the leaf.
