quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I have no current business with the likes of you. Get out of my face."
quests.completionMessage: "This letter from Quis says that you are a spy attempting to undermine our war efforts.  I shall enjoy unleashing my horde on you."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 6 of 9 Fight!
quests.description: "Your attempt stops here.  My Acon will show no mercy."
quests.completionMessage: "Acon is only the first.  What makes you think you can take on my next minion?"  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 6 of 9 Fight!!
quests.description: "Bosdon is going to hurt you for sure."
quests.completionMessage: "I don"t believe it!  He was the best tracker I had!"  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 6 of 9 Fight!!!
quests.description: "Now you"re in trouble.  Lolo will show you my true power."
quests.completionMessage: "So, should I take this as a sign of our overconfidence or that you"re a cheater just like Quis says?"  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 6 of 9
quests.description: "Ylog is going to have the same concerns I have.  While I ponder this, take my letter to him. You"ll find him located under the Bridge to Bloblic City."
quests.hint: Ylog is at the base of Bloblic City bridge

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I am so happy to be back in my nice DRY home. After having to relocate to that wet tunnel for a while, I don"t care if I ever see the ocean again."
quests.completionMessage: "Deflection Coating? I know I have some, but I just moved and it must be still boxed up! To be honest, the best solution is for me to just make a fresh batch for you. Would you mind picking up some supplies for me? Here is a list of the items I will need."  [More]

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 15 of 23
quests.description: "I will need 3 Heal Gun Ammo Bases, 2 Realgars, 2 Chrome Greens, and 1 Vitamin Juicer. The last item is for me because I"m a little deficient in my nutrients after having caught so many colds in that damp tunnel! Hurry back, I"m feeling a chill coming on."
quests.completionMessage: "Oh goodie, you"re back! Ahhh, refreshing and tasty! Okay, let me see what else you have. Great, it"s all here. There you are, one dose of Deflection Coating.  And here is a little something extra for you."  [More]
quests.hint: These items are all related to Alchemy

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 16 of 23
quests.description: "Now if you came from Huran, you must need Hoverbike components. Huran is my good friend, but he charges high prices for his work. My cousin Conom is a lot cheaper and is just as good. You must go see him before you go back to Huran. Look for Conom outside the Black Market in a bunker and show him this list. Safe travels!"
quests.hint: Find Conom in a bunker outside Black Market

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Mmm, are you for lunch, or are you here to do business?  We"ll I"m not much in the mood for business.  You should go because I"m in the mood for lunch."
quests.completionMessage: "You have come from Lorut. Thank you for the Gauges. I do make the Plasma Screens used as consoles in many vehicles. I have one I can spare, but in exchange I demand a high price."  [More]

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 4 of 23
quests.description: "I will trade the Plasma Screen for the wings of the rare and fearsome Hasten. "
quests.completionMessage: "Here is the Plasma Screen I promised. Now leave me alone. What? Oh, a Plasma Fuel Injector?  Yes, I can make those too. Let us see what else I can get you to get for me." [More]
quests.hint: A Hasten may be found on the Root of the Oracle

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 5 of 23
quests.description: "Not selling many right now, so I will let one go for the price of an Evonsa Vial.  Sarins and Dark Jousters have been known to carry them. Lucky for you all I"m asking for is one. Sarins are tough and mean and nothing I know will give you any advantage, but the Dark Jouster is weak against Air attacks."
quests.completionMessage: "You are back with my Evonsa Vial. This is wonderful news! I bathe in the liquid they contain because it leaves much more of my natural scent than plain water, and the males of my species have found this helps in attracting mates. Here is your Plasma Fuel Injector."  [More]
quests.hint: Evonsa Vials drop from Sarins and Dark Jousters

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 6 of 23
quests.description: "Lorut should be quite pleased with these components. He and I have an understanding. He sends me customers, and sometimes lunch. Are you quite sure you aren"t supposed to be lunch?"
quests.hint: Return to Lorut with the components

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I"m a Master Smith specializing in vehicle parts. Mostly I make engine mounts, but since things have been so slow I"ve been perfecting a new Slider Attack Shield for the Xtx Hover Bike."
quests.completionMessage: "Hmmm. Aress wrote down a Slider Attack Shield and Sonic Engine Mounts. Okay, I"m not in any position to charge you full price since demand is so low. If you get me the things I want, we"ll call it even."  [More]

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 17 of 23
quests.description: "Here are the items on my list you need to get. 1 Sub-micron Alumina, 1 Ceramic Flex Unit and 2 Titanium Carbides. Also, I need you to stock up my fridge for these hot, Black Market evenings. I need 1 Tiki Olo Daiquiri, and 2 Dew Drop Brain Brews."
quests.completionMessage: "Hey, that"s all the stuff I asked for! I made the shield from the parts I had while you were gone. Here you go! And since you are my first customer in a month, I"m gonna throw in a free set of Sonic Engine Mounts. That is incentive for you to come back. I also do impersonations and I"m a riot at parties! Oh, one more thing." [More]

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 18 of 23
quests.description: "I might not be the brightest bulb in the house but I can tell you are gathering hoverbike components for Huran. He"s going to want some Titanium Sheets, and there"s really only one guy to get them from. His name is Rigin and he"s inside the Black Market. Here"s a pass so that he will talk to you. Good luck."
quests.hint: Find Rigin in the Black Market building

quests.title: Intro
quests.completionMessage: "You got a ride? Sweet. I talk to lots of people all the time about hoverbikes and hydrocraft. I have this sweet water rocket with an ion-booster that will outrun a Trine at full speed. And my Hoverbike"s got dual-frequency sonic modulators that toast the ground when I open "er up."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "What a revoltin" development... having to relocate my forge way up here in the cheap seats... and me being afraid of heights!! Anyway, I only cater to Advanced Inceptor Pilots. My shop is closed. Come back later."
quests.completionMessage: "What, you have my Tool Case? Heh, that"s impossible, because it"s right over... uh... that"s funny. It was here just the other day. Where"d you find it? Oh, Amblik had it. Why, I just had him over for dinner last night, it must have gotten stuck to his shoe, or... or something."  [More]

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 12 of 23
quests.description: "Plasma Fuel Case? Oh yeah, I can make those. Very simple. For me, that is. What"s it worth to ya?I charge 50 Evonsa Vials per case, and it just so happens I got one left. But since you returned my Tool Case, I"m gonna give you a special deal. Only ONE Evonsa Vial for you. Better hurry before I change my mind."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent. [gulp, gulp, gulp] Ahhhh. Mmmm, that hits the spot. Here ya go, good deal. That"s about all I can do for now, I"m afraid. Was there something else?  Yeah, I have the specs to make the Hover Xtx Hull, but you"ll need to do something for me first."  [More]
quests.hint: Evonsa Vials drop from certain creatures

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 13 of 23
quests.completionMessage: "You see, I like to catch some rays on the beach over by the Mining Caves. But last week this pesky Eyemba killed me and took my best hammer. I"m not making any Hulls until I get my hammer back. And there are some other supplies I will need besides my hammer, so listen closely."  [More]

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 14 of 23
quests.description: "I need one dose of Deflection Coating, 4 Andros Alloy Units, 2 Platinum Stocks and 3 Titanium Sheets. For the Deflection Coating, you"ll need to talk to my little friend Aress the Alchemist on Amphibious Island. I don"t know where you will find Titanium Sheets, so keep your ears open."
quests.completionMessage: "Oh, this is great, my favorite hammer! She"ll make short work of this hull. You got everything else too, eh? Let me get right to work. [BAM! BAM! BAM!] Now smooth out the edge... [SCRAAAPE!] Now test for tensile strength... [CREAAAKKK!] And.... DONE. There you are, my friend." [More]
quests.hint: Eyemba near the Mining Caves has the hammer

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 22 of 23
quests.description: "Looks like you probably have everything you need to put this baby on skates. You should probably head back to Amblik and see what he thinks of my work. And hey, when you"re in his shop, keep hold of your stuff with both hands if you know what I mean."
quests.hint: Head back to Amblik with all the parts

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "What a great day for hoverbiking! Just not for me. I hafta stay and make components for those dudes who get to play."
quests.completionMessage: "Whoah!! Dude, Amblik found my fuser! Anyways, I can make the Hover Sonic Engine if you can help me with the supplies. Because I lost my fuser for so long, I had to subcontract these out with a foreign engineer named Bleka out of Black Market. Yeah, lame I know."  [More]

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 3 of 23
quests.description: "This guy is really good, but he sometimes takes a bite out of his customers. No, I mean literally, dude. Look for a place in the Black Market caves with a hard, flat surface to set up his tools. Take him this set of gauges and he should be able to hook you up with the Plasma Screen and Plasma Fuel Injector. Good luck."
quests.completionMessage: "I told ya that he"d come through for ya! Hang on to these pieces, dude. I"ll need them later. The Hover Sonic Engine I can make myself. I have 4 storage containers in the man-made section of Black Market caves, here are 4 keys. Plus, there are some plant types I"ll need you to extract for me."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Bleka in a flat place in the Black Market caves

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 7 of 23
quests.description: "These are the items I need from my storage containers. 1 Voltage Regulator, 1 set of Intake Valves, 1 Cycle Timer, 1 set of Sonic Thrusters and 1 set of Titanium Pistons. Dude, I also need these plants: 3 Wigspruce Stalks, 5 Ecolalgae plants and 1 Sun Plant. Got all that? Righteous."
quests.completionMessage: "Primo, dude! Okay, first let me put these plants in water. What do you think?  Now let"s see about your engine... [ting! ting!] Ha ha! There ya go, one Hover Sonic Engine. Oh, and dude, I saw that Amblik had Yelvien"s Necklace at his place last time I was there and snagged it." [More]

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 8 of 23
quests.description: "Maybe you can take her necklace back to her for me. She"s one righteous babe! I gotta tell ya, keep hold of your stuff with both hands around Amblik, if you know what I mean. You need directions to Yelvien, dude?  Her crib is in Four Falls, ask around. Hope that helps. Burn rubber, dude!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Everybody comes to me for Sheet Metals. I gladly sell them for rare gems. I love rare gems. Hey, did you know you can"t pound gems into sheets? Believe me,  I"ve tried."
quests.completionMessage: "I am always in the market for rare gems, and I have some metal sheets to trade for them. Lucky for you, I already know where you can get the gems I"m craving. They are in a locked chest and I have the key."  [More]

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 19 of 23
quests.completionMessage: "What do you mean, why dont I just go get them myself? How about I don"t feel like it? Hey, why all the questions? Do you work for the Unified Guard? No? Good. Then stop asking stupid questions. Just take this key and bring me the gems that are in my chest. Now, lean in close so I can tell you where it is..."  [More]

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 20 of 23
quests.description: "There are two pieces of fine Jade and two exquisite Garnets locked in a chest in a maze of stone deep within these caverns. I believe the entrance to the maze is in a high place. If you bring me those gems and don"t ask any more stupid questions I"ll give you three titanium sheets in exchange."
quests.completionMessage: "You didn"t tell anyone about this did you? Great! Keep it that way. A deal is a deal, so here is your set of three Titanium Sheets."  [More]
quests.hint: Seek the stone maze in a high place for the chest

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 21 of 23
quests.description: "If you need these sheets to make a Hoverbike, you"d best take them back to Huran. But if not, you are on your own. Stay frosty and good luck."
quests.hint: Huran can do something with these sheets

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I hate when I lose my necklace. Have you seen it? It is so beautiful, like me."
quests.completionMessage: "Oh! Where did you find this?  You say Amblik had it?  I was just over to his place for dinner last week, I guess I must have left it there. How strange... So, how to reward you..."  [More]

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 9 of 23
quests.completionMessage: "I know! I can make you a Plasma Fuel Cell, how does that sound?  Oh, that"s what you came here for, is it?  Perfect. Everybody leaves happy. Now pay attention and I will tell you what supplies you will need to bring me."  [More]

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 10 of 23
quests.description: "These are the items I will need: 5 packs of Hyper Cell Material and a Plasma Unit from an Engineering Shop. Also, 5 Ecolalgae plants and 5 Proving Opal Marbles. The Proving Opal Marble is actually an extra organ in some Ulines. "
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you so much for gathering the plants for me. I needed them for a potion. Okay, now turn around so I don"t give away my trade secrets... [sssZOT!!] There you go. And here"s that Plasma Fuel Cell I promised. Huran? Oh my, I picked up his Tool Case when I was at Amblik"s!  I wonder why Amblik had Huran"s tools?"  [More]
quests.hint: Extractors are needed to harvest plants

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 11 of 23
quests.description: "If you wouldn"t mind, could you please take this to him since you"re headed that way anyhow?  Yes, I can tell you where he is.  I think....I think....maybe he"s in the Bloblic City?  Does that sound right?"
quests.hint: Find Huran in the Bloblic City

quests.title: (BL) ZiraelSlayer-F
quests.description: "Master says that I am not to hand out swords to just anyone."
quests.completionMessage: "Here you go master warrior - your Fire ZiraelSlayer."

quests.title: (AP) Omsevenier-F
quests.description: "Master says that I am not to hand out swords to just anyone."
quests.completionMessage: "Here you go master warrior - your Fire OmseveNier."

quests.title: (HM) SteelBoltshik-F
quests.description: "Master says that I am not to hand out swords to just anyone."
quests.completionMessage: "Here you go master warrior - your Fire SteelBoltshik."

quests.title: (HF) SectaliescshNim-F
quests.description: "Master says that I am not to hand out swords to just anyone."
quests.completionMessage: "Here you go master warrior - your Fire SectalieschNim."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "You are delaying me from an appointment. Begone."
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, welcome slave of Ocsylop. My warriors are looking forward to turning your carcass into ashes. I just told them to take a 5-minute break, but they will be ready. Prepare yourself, and tell me when you are ready to die."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 3 of 9 Attack!
quests.description: "Zolog has returned.  Why bother to wait for the others? He will have no trouble killing you by himself."
quests.completionMessage: "Yes, you defeated Zolog... but the rest of the force wasn"t back from their break yet. But I see some coming back."  [More]
quests.hint: "Zolog is one of my most punctual soldiers."

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 3 of 9 Attack!!
quests.description: "Brias, clean up Zolog"s mess!!"
quests.completionMessage: "How can this be.  You so tiny!"  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 3 of 9 Attack!!!
quests.description: "Ligadoom! Do something!"
quests.completionMessage: "You terrible little runt!  You will not be so lucky next time."  [More]
quests.hint: "Ligadoom enjoys long walks on the beach."

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 3 of 9 Attack!!!!
quests.description: "Sospoon! You"re next!"
quests.completionMessage: "Wait... what happened to the rest of my forces? THEY WENT TO GET A DRINK? No, those are not your orders! What"s that? I don"t CARE if you wanted to watch the Shockion fight, you OBEY ME!! Who"s left, now?"  [More]
quests.hint: "Sospoon is as strong as he is ugly."

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 3 of 9 Attack!!!!!
quests.description: "Alright, Nillin, time to go for broke!"
quests.completionMessage: "So you did. You defeated my entire force. What a disaster! Not a single warrior teamed up with any one else. We will never succeed with that kind of performance. What can we do about this? I hope you have some answers, because it is a mystery to me."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 3 of 9
quests.description: "Enough humiliation for now. You"ll find Requess in the Solothic Caves."
quests.hint: "Requess"s group is in the Solothic Caves."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "My Sarin Legions are strong.  You"d be smart to hide when the fighting commences."
quests.completionMessage: "Ocsylop says that you are going to whip us into shape.  I doubt that an overworlder like yourself has the ability to back up that boast."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 2 of 9 Fight!
quests.description: "I only have one soldier at my disposal, but that should be more than enough to crush you."
quests.completionMessage: "I never can wait for reinforcements, and the sight of an overworlder makes Usag crazy. Maybe we do need your help. Keep the document Usag was carrying for Ocsylop, it"s loss will fall on his head. I give you this Broken hammer to symbolize my defeat."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 12 Quest: Part 2 of 9
quests.description: "Take my letter to Klion in the Black Market caverns."
quests.hint: "Klion"s forces await you inside the Black Market."

quests.description: "I redeem Master Uspoan"s token from his difficult game.  You might have me confused with my brother, or you haven"t a token at all."
quests.completionMessage: "Here is your reward. You may notice how strong my arms are from holding these guns all day. Do I intimidate you?"

quests.title: Fire Dilirium
quests.description: "Why are you here?  Go away!!  I don"t like people bugging me!! ARRRHHHHH!!!"
quests.completionMessage: "So you must have spoken to Ortsu.  Well then if he told you what I would want then I guess I have to do my part.  Here take this Dilirium.  I have enchanted it with the power of this town.  Now go away!"

quests.title: Water Dilirium
quests.description: "Why are you here?  Go away!!  I don"t like people bugging me!! ARRRHHHHH!!!"
quests.completionMessage: "So you must have spoken to Ortsu.  Quickly take this!  Eeewwwhhh, I hate water!!  Ortsu must warn me when one of you is coming with that crap.  Now go away!"

quests.title: Earth Dilirium
quests.description: "Why are you here?  Go away!!  I don"t like people bugging me!! ARRRHHHHH!!!"
quests.completionMessage: "So you must have spoken to Ortsu.  Well then if he told you what I would want then I guess I have to do my part.  Here take this Dilirium.  I have enchanted it with the power of the earth.  Now go away!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "My master Shaman Raphic resides in the mushroom village next to the waterfall.  However he will only allow you to speak with him if you are accomplished in Mind Control."
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, you have come from Raphic. Excellent! There are two tasks you must perform for me before I send you back to the Shaman. Your first task is to retrieve the contents of a chest in the crypt."  [More]

quests.title: Dual Quazon Horns Quest: Part 2 of 4
quests.description: "The Mineral Key you brought with you will open it. Inside, you will find some specific minerals we need. This should be simple enough for you to accomplish. Return to me when you have completed this first task."
quests.completionMessage: "Now for your second task. I would like you to hunt and kill two of the Crosps which frequent this valley." [More]
quests.hint: "Find the mineral chest in the crypt."

quests.title: Dual Quazon Horns Quest: Part 3 of 4
quests.description: "Bring back two of their horns. These are essential because the Shaman will make your  horns from them."
quests.completionMessage: "You have completed all the tasks I have requested of you."  [More]

quests.title: Dual Quazon Horns Quest: Part 4 of 4
quests.description: "Here is everything that you have gathered for me. Take it and return to the Shaman.  He will see that you have earned your Dual Quazon Horns."

quests.title: AP Text
quests.completionMessage: "Greetings, welcome to our Shaman"s place of peace. Train your Mind Control to a higher level if he will not speak with you."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I provide the Quazon  Only those amphibians who have attained the rank of Mind Control level 6 will be allowed to embark upon this quest."
quests.completionMessage: "I provide the Amphibious Horns of Protection for those who wish to quest for them. You are a brave amphibian or you would not have achieved such a level of Mind Control. This first quest will grant a single Horn of Protection to the successful."  [More]

quests.title: Single Quazon Horn Quest: Part 1 of 1
quests.description: "You must bring me three items in all. The first is a horn from the Crosp that roams this land. The second and third are the contents of two chests hidden away within the crypt. These keys will only open the chests that they match.  Return with all that I require."
quests.completionMessage: "Very nice indeed. Don this horn as you would equip armor, and it will give added protection to your Normal Channel. The Mineral Key I have given you is necessary for your next quest. I will explain it to you when you are ready."  [More]

quests.title: Dual Quazon Horns Quest:
quests.completionMessage: "The Mineral Key I have given you is necessary for your next quest. Do not shy away from this task, it will be very rewarding for you."   [More]

quests.title: Dual Quazon Horns Quest: Part 1 of 4
quests.description: "Take this key to Aner for his instruction. You will find him in town."
quests.completionMessage: "So you have met my trusty apprentice Aner and fulfilled his requests. I see no reason to keep these from you any longer."   [More]

quests.title: Dual Quazon Horns Quest: Complete
quests.description: "May these Dual Horns protect you from much harm. Dual Horns will protect you from Normal. Display them with honor, and may peace always travel alongside you."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Cain remains on the loose. All of IIA is doomed."
quests.completionMessage: "Quickly, let me see the stone you carry... this moss is a clever covering that masks our sophisticated communication devices. I see that we have uncovered the whereabouts of one of Cain"s recruits inside the Black Market. Will you be the force we  send to crush him?...."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Look Out! A spy has overheard us! He must not be allowed to leave this area alive!"
quests.completionMessage: "Good work! What was he carrying? This Scepter looks familiar... YES! It is the Scepter of Power that Cain uses to extend his will over long distances. He must have been using Salgon to recruit for him since he cannot yet materialize. This will be a heavy blow to his power."  [More]
quests.hint: Salgon must not be allowed to escape

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 3 of 20
quests.description: "Quickly, we must move to disrupt Cain"s recruiting.  Find his agent Flogran in the Black Market caves and do whatever you can to stop him."
quests.hint: Find Flogran in the Black Market Caves

quests.title: Accessing the Store
quests.completionMessage: "Welcome to my shop. To see my goods, press F1 and select STORE."

quests.title: 1. The Realm of the Ancients
quests.completionMessage: "If you wish to venture into the Cave of the Ancients you must first obtain your level 13 armor, then get the key to enter that horrid place."

quests.title: 2. The Catacombs
quests.completionMessage: "If you desire to venture into the Catacombs you must first obtain your level 12 armor and utilize the key to enter that place of death."

quests.title: 3. What is this inner Iia?
quests.completionMessage: "Know that I have long served the sacred task, favoring only those who are great. The inner IIA must never be disturbed. None now live that can even imagine what might occur if the core were to be breached."

quests.title: 4. Entrance Maze
quests.completionMessage: "The entrance to our underworld is protected to ensure only those who are strong can enter this place. Consider yourself strong, then. Or else very lucky."

quests.title: Accessing Store
quests.completionMessage: "Check out my dark items for the dark arts. Use them wisely for they are capable of consuming your soul!"

quests.title: My Collections
quests.completionMessage: "I collect various items. At different times I can reward you with different things, baubles and trinkets and treasures, hee hee hee hah! Sometimes I even have rare items, one never knows!" [More]

quests.title: Eyezora Eyes
quests.description: "Kill for me 20 eyezoras and bring me the remains!!! I will give you a trinket from my collections as a reward."
quests.completionMessage: "Here is your item. No questions, no answers. It is what I choose to give. I may choose something else next time."

quests.title: High Priest of Crom Plasmas
quests.description: "Destroy for me 30 High Priests and bring me the left overs!! I will give you something very nice, yes I will."
quests.completionMessage: "Umbdy gooldy!! Gimme gimme gimme!! Here is your item. It is what I feel like giving out. I may feel differently the next time."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I am so scared. I need some help but I do not think that you can help me. I am waiting for a specific being to come by, one that has been sent by my sister Sush."
quests.completionMessage: "Oh, you must be the one that my sister Sush has sent to help me. I have been trapped in here by a terrible creature. It scares me so much!"  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Please help me! That evil creature is coming to beat and eat me! Oh my, I will soon be sent to Rebirth again!"
quests.completionMessage: "You have no idea how long I have been trapped in here by that creature. I have been so terrified. Here, take this back to my sister and tell her that I will be back as soon as I can."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 20 of 34
quests.description: "Lay off!  This is as fast as I go."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Why do you believe that you can just approach a Shockion and strike up a conversation with one? Do you realize that this action is one of the bravest, but also one of the most idiotic behaviors I have ever witnessed? Go now for I do not communicate with beings that are not of my kind, except for this one time of course."
quests.completionMessage: "I have not seen a root of Pislag in many years. I presume that Sial desires to know where this came from. That is fine, but before I divulge such information you are to do me a favor."  [More]

quests.title: ShapeShift Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "One of Tuscan"s guards has been roaming this area on one of his rampages. Take him out however you can, and bring me the pass he carries. Once you have done this for me I will provide you with the information that Sial seeks."
quests.completionMessage: "Ahh, you have done very well my fellow Shockion. This pass will allow me access to the Tuscan egg chambers. Those eggs are going to be delicious!"  [More]
quests.hint: Bring me the Pass of the Elite Shockion

quests.title: ShapeShift Quest: Part 29 of 34
quests.description: "Now my part is also complete. Take this Book of Viktalpon back to Sial. It will explain everything that he wants to know."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Please can you help me? My brother and I got split up, and he just happens to have the map of this area, and I need it to find my way."
quests.completionMessage: "Ahhhh! Thank you so much for this map. I am glad that my brother is alright, it looks like things have turned out well for both of us. With the map you have given me hopefully I will never get lost again. Hmm... now which way is east?"  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 6 of 34
quests.description: "Don"t worry about me, I will find my way out. Are you going back to Sial now? Great! Please take this Moss to Sial for me please. I know he loves all kinds of damp fungus Hopefully this will help him forgive us for needing to be rescued. Thank you for your help once again!"
quests.hint: Take this moss back to Sial

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Forcing myself to speak your tongue is unrewarding at best."
quests.completionMessage: "So Sial has sent you. He asked me to help you master the Shapeshift orb of my race, the Eans.  I am always willing to help."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 14 of 34
quests.description: "You help me and I"ll help you. I need some very specific items. I require 5 Zog"s Health Elixirs, 10 Tug Seeds, 5 Gurg Seeds, and 5 Neglik Stingers. You can consult an Alchemist in Trendor about the Zogs. Seek out Srag about the plants.  He is inside the amphibious island caves checking out some moss."
quests.completionMessage: "You have obtained all the items I requested, for that I thank you. You have brought me everything I need to make the greatest dion dish ever created, Kurukuru stew."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 15 of 34
quests.description: "Take this leter to my brother Saspla.  He is on the east side of the Sial Island shores.  Sial would also like you to help him with some of his tasks."
quests.hint: Find Saspla on the east side of Slal Island

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I am the shepherd to my young Flobs below. I am looking over my young brothers and sisters as they are slain every day here. I have seen you slay them also. Go now."
quests.completionMessage: "Sial has sent me a Moss mixture. Thank you so much, I needed that."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 3 of 34
quests.description: "Please give this to Sial and give him my thanks. Take care of yourself my fellow Kzon."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Away with you vile miscreant!  You mother was a hamster and your father smelled of elderberries!  Now go away or I will taunt you a second time!"
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, I see you brought that ridiculously heavy envelope from Slaps."  [More]

quests.title: ShapeShift Quest: Part 10 of 34
quests.description: "I do hope it didn"t tire you out too much, because now i need you take this even more insanely heavy orb back to slaps. Bye bye now."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Help me please! I am a lost student of Sial"s. My brother and I were being chased, and my brother tripped and fell down near a large cavern entrance, I stopped to help but then someone grabbed me, and threw me in a sack, and now I"m here. They left but they"ll be back, and its not safe for me to leave. I barely know where I am, nor how to get home."
quests.completionMessage: "Are you here to help me? Oh, thank you! This map from Sial will help me find my way out of here. But my brother Cross is still lost near the mining cavern where we were separated. I can find my way back now, but Cross has a bad sense of direction, and would need this map more than I do."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 5 of 34
quests.description: "Perhaps you can find my brother Cross, and give him this map, then all of his troubles should be solved. He"s probably still by the cavern where he fell."
quests.hint: Find Cross by a nearby mining cavern.

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I could assist you with your Dion training when the time comes."
quests.completionMessage: "Sial understands that the Trisks are planning to attack so we must prepare for them.  I must finish collecting the necessary parts to build the antidote against the Trisk poison."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "I have the perfect task for you; there is a rare Trisk that dwells on this Island. Find him and bring back to me his tentacles. I am sure that the missing link lies within that creature’s blood and poison glands. Hurry we do not have much time to waste."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent job.  This is exactly what I asked for. Thank you very much for retrieving this for me. I do need your help in gathering one last item. There is one specific old Crid that roams this area also."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Fight!!
quests.description: "It is suspected that the fluid in its eyes hold one of the last ingredients that I will need for the antidote. Please find this Crid and bring me back its eyes."
quests.completionMessage: "Great! This is a very good day for us in our battle against the Trisks. I am sure that we will soon be ready for them."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 16 of 34
quests.description: "We Dion will soon be able to fight our own battles. Thank you much for your assistance. You can rest assured that your help here will not go forgotten.  Return to Sial with the good news."

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Intro
quests.description: -There will never be anything read from here-
quests.completionMessage: "The Shape Shift skill will allow you to morph into many different creatures of the same types which you will encounter throughout the realm. When you shift into a creature you will take on all of the target creatures abilities, and in some cases become more powerful than a normal creature of that type."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Preparation
quests.description: -There will never be anything read from here-
quests.completionMessage: "For much of your training you will be sent to speak to various creatures around the realm. In order to communicate with them you must be shifted into the shape of the creature you must talk to. If you do not do this, they will neither understand nor acknowledge you."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: More Prep
quests.description: -There will never be anything read from here-
quests.completionMessage: "This is your first Orb - The Orb of Flob. Try transforming into a Flob and practice with it a bit. You will gain Shape Shift experience by both the act of shifting into a form and by attacking other creatures while shifted.  Return to me when you have practiced the Flob form enough to shapeshift into it at will." [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 1 of 34
quests.description: "Ok, your first mission is going to be fairly easy. I just need you to deliver this moss mixture to my friend Laetion. Now Laetion is a Flob and only speaks Flob, so you should be shifted to that form when you deliver the Moss mixture. He usually hangs out just outside the great city of humans, Trendor.  Return to me after you speak with him."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you very much for running that errand for me. I knew Laetion would love that moss.  You have earned your next orb; the Orb of Infant Stount, which will of course allow you to shift into that form. You must practice enough to be able to use that orb before I will allow you to progress."
quests.hint: Deliver Sial"s moss mixture to Laetion

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 2 of 34
quests.description: -There will never be anything read from here-
quests.completionMessage: "Plispon, another Infant Stount trainee, is supposed to be headed to see his brother Cross. I worry about him traveling alone through the petrified forest as I warned him not to.  I am even more worried that he"s been captured by poachers.  I know that there"s a poachers" encampment near the death valley."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 4 of 34
quests.description: "Check the death valley area for Plispon and save him from any possible danger he may have stumbled into. Also give him this map to help him find his way home so he doesn"t run into any more trouble. Return to me when you have finished with him."
quests.completionMessage: "Those boys are going to be the end of me.  I can already see that you are going to be a much better student than they have been so far. Rather than send you on a further mission before your next orb, I am going to graduate you early. Here is the Orb of Klondon. You must be able to use it before I will speak to you again."
quests.hint: Find Plispon near the petrified forest.

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 7 of 34
quests.description: -There will never be anything read from here-
quests.completionMessage: "Very impressive. You"re coming along very nicely in the art of shapeshifting, but in order to become a true changeling, one must become the creature you are emulating inside as well as out. You must learn to take on the behavior as well as the exterior form."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 8 of 34
quests.description: "It is time for you to discover your inner Klondon.  Klondons are renowned for their migratory travels. For this lesson, take this scroll to Slaps, who will give you further instructions. He is just outside the Bloblic colonies. Do his bidding and return to me when you are finished."
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, wasn"t that fun?  Ready to do that again?  Heh, just kidding! But seriously, you"ve earned your next orb, the Orb of Ean. Try it out! You will need to be able to use it successfully before I will speak to you again."

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 12 of 34
quests.description: -There will never be anything read from here-
quests.completionMessage: "So I see that your Ean training is progressing at a very good pace. You must be ready for your next mission if you are here speaking to me. That is good. There"s an Ean by the name of Klasp whom I believe you should meet."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 13 of 34
quests.description: "Klasp will mentor you in the ways of his people. You will find him near the place where you found my student Plispon.  Return to me when you have finished with Klasp."
quests.completionMessage: "Wonderful news, Klasp tells me you helped him immensely.  Here is the Shapeshift Orb of Ligon. It will lead you into some rather dangerous areas, I"m afraid. The Ligons like most Blods live in the sewers and caves and feed on garbage and refuse and even drink from acidic streams that could kill you or I. You must be able to use it before I will talk with you further."
quests.hint: Klasp near the Plispon will mentor you

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 17 of 34
quests.description: -There will never be anything read from here-
quests.completionMessage: "I can sense that you are capable of assuming the Fadun shape. It is clear to me that you are grasping this level of Shape Shifting skill with ease. You must be ready for your next mission."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 18 of 34
quests.description: "There is a creature of the Blod race who goes by the name Sush. She is located in the a very unusual place for a Blod, the park in the bottom of trendor. I told her that I would be sending someone with a package to help her as soon as I could. Take this package to her and return when you have finished helping her."
quests.completionMessage: "So, was the task simple enough for you to handle? I am glad that Sush was able to enjoy the package and get her sister out of trouble. Your next orb will be your first experience as a completely water-based creature. It is the Orb of Stontrile. You must be able to assume this form before I will speak to you again."

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 22 of 34
quests.description: "Ok, now for your next mission. You must utilize your latest orb in order to retrieve the fin from a rare mutated Stontrile roaming the ocean south of here. Now go and seek out this Stontrile and bring me back the fin."
quests.completionMessage: "You are slicker than I thought. Here is your next Orb - the Orb of Shrite. You must be capable of assuming this form before I will speak to you again."
quests.hint: Kill the Mutated Stontrile to the south.

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 23 of 34
quests.description: "You have reached a plateau of training. Whether you go on or stop here depends entirely on you. I will only train one person in IIA beyond this level, and that is the reigning Champion of IIA. To become the Champion you must earn a ranking and progress through the lesser champions to win the IIA Tournament. You must bring me back the championship belt of Savtan, the current reigning champion. Seek out Vigoss near Trendor to earn a ranking."
quests.completionMessage: "You have done it? My goodness, so you have. All hail the Champion of IIA! This proves to me that you will be able to handle these next missions. Here is your next Shape Shift Orb; the Orb of Ascherion. You must use this to stop a feud between the Slone and Philion races. Until you can use this orb, I will not speak with you again. Oh, and take good care of the Championship belt you have gotten, it might serve you again at a later time."

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 24 of 34
quests.description: -There will never be anything read from here-
quests.completionMessage: "A messenger is on his way to deliver a treaty to a Slone scout by the name of Vor. You should know that Ascherions are of the Slone race. Now Vor has orders to present that treaty to the leader of the Philion race, of which Crids and Trisks are a part. I am interested to know what they are planning."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 25 of 34
quests.description: "You will impersonate the messenger shifted into Ascherion form and deliver this message to Vor on Unity Outpost in place of the treaty. Once he divulges his plans to you, take whatever actions you see fit to prevent war. Return to me when you feel you have done all you can.".
quests.completionMessage: "So the Slones wish to march against the Bloblics? Even with the help of the Philions, it sounds like a lost cause. I doubt they have rightly measured the might of the Bloblic armies. As for you, you have earned the Orb of Adult Shockion. You must be able to use this orb before I will speak to you further."
quests.hint: Deliver the letter to Vor on Unity

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 27 of 34
quests.description: -There will never be anything read from here-
quests.completionMessage: "Now that you are ready, this Root of Pislag needs to be delivered to Sir Cleasp on the Black Market island. He is a Shockion, so your new form will be essential for proper communication. He is one of the only Shockions that our people have been able to trust throughout our time on this planet."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 28 of 34
quests.description: "Once you locate Cleasp on Black Market Island, speak with him and show him the root. He should be able to tell me where it came from and what it can be used for. Return to me when you have finished with him."
quests.completionMessage: "The Book of Viktalpon, what a treasure! This book contains a listing of almost every root in all of the discovered realms. This will help us out tremendously. You have done well. Here is your next Orb, the Orb of Pidion. You must be able to utilize this orb before I will speak to you again."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Cleasp on Black Market Island

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 30 of 34
quests.description: "Our Vigon friend Pos has gone crazy. I need you to put him down before he gets himself into any trouble. I have the feeling that he has been put under a spell of some sort. You"ll find him near the Sial Communications Tower. Put him out of his misery and bring me anything he was carrying or wearing. Return to me with your report."
quests.completionMessage: "Hmmm, it appears that this necklace was the source of his insanity. Hold onto the necklace and this letter for now, I will need you to do something with it later. Here is your next Orb, the Orb of Lauder.  As usual, I expect you to be able to use this orb before I will speak to you again."
quests.hint: Find Pos near the Sial Communication Tower

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 31 of 34
quests.description: "You are to travel deep into the Cave of Ancients and locate Zagison. Hopefully he can provide you with the information that I am looking for regarding who is responsible for this necklace. Return to me with your report."
quests.completionMessage: "The Necklace of Cain! No wonder Pos went mad!  And it turned my friend Zagison mad as well!  I must take this necklace immediately to Strife so he can destroy it. You have done well. Here is the last orb I can give to you; the Orb of Agron. You must be able to use it before I will speak to you again."

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Complete - 34
quests.description: "That was the last Orb I had to give to you, but keep your eyes and ears open for news and rumors. There are other orbs of this nature throughout IIA that can be obtained by different means, and some are far more powerful than the ones I stock. Go in peace, young learner."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Who are you? How do I know that I can trust you? Hmmm, I have a lot of work to do right now, and to be honest, I do not trust you, especially with everything that has happened."
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, I see you are another of Sial"s initiates, and you have taken the first step toward perfecting your Klondon form. But I"ve got an even heavier object -- this letter!!!  Yes, that"s right, a simple envelope, but within its innocuous folds lies a weight so vast and terrible, you just might not make it to where I"m sending you."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 9 of 34
quests.description: "Take that extremely heavy letter to Loat, and he will help you on your way to becoming a better Klondon.  He"s....you guessed it, far...far way, between these colonies and Trendor. Have fun.... MUAHAHAHAHAHA!!!"
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, thank you, you brought me that orb from my brother.  Well, here is the heaviest scroll ever seen by both the living....and the dead."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Loat between the Bloblic Colonies and Trendor.

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 11 of 34
quests.description: "Quickly, take the scroll to Sial, the fate of the world depends on it!!!  Why, you ask?  That"s top secret, I could tell ya, but then I"d have to kill ya, hehehohohaha..........."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "RUN AWAY!!! RUN AWAY!!!!"
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, thank you, you brought me that orb from my brother.  By the way, have you met my good friend Slaps here?  You have?  Hmmm.... Small world, isn"t it?  Well, here is the heaviest scroll ever seen by both the living....and the dead."  [More]

quests.title: ShapeShift Quest: Part 11 of 34
quests.description: "Quickly, take this to Sial, the fate of the world depends on it!!!  Why, you ask?  That"s top secret, I could tell ya, but then I"d have to kill ya, hehehohohaha..........."
quests.hint: Take the scroll back to Sial

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Aye, I am sorry but I am awaiting a courier from Sial. He will be sending me a package soon and I must be alert."
quests.completionMessage: "Let me see what Sial has sent me this time. Oh yes! These are my favorite treats... but alas, I can not really enjoy these without my sister.  I know she has gotten herself into some trouble again. "  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 19 of 34
quests.description: "If I am receiving her telepathy correctly, she is lost in a cave somewhere, and hears stomping nearby of some sort of large monster. I would help her myself, but as you know, we Blods are not the swiftest beings around. She goes by the name of Bislion. I will try to send her a telepathic message to let her know that you are on your way to assist her."
quests.completionMessage: "So you found Bislion. Well thank you again for all of your help. Please take this letter to Sial and tell him that I thank him also. Safe journeys my new friend."
quests.hint: "Go help Bislion in a nearby cave"

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 21 of 34
quests.description: "Now that I know Bislion is safe I"ll go on ahead and enjoy these treats without him.  Serves him right. mmmMumMumMum.  Delicious."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "If I were you, I"d stear clear of any Slones you come across.  I"m warning you. I should kill you now but I"m waiting for something that is much more important."
quests.completionMessage: "We Slones are planning on joining the Philions to rid this realm of the nasty Bloblics. I gather that this is the treaty I must deliver to the Philion leaders.  Good work, this treaty should guarantee the Slone/Philion union."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Wait a moment, there is something not right about you. You are an imposter! This treaty must be a fake!  You think that you can use the power of Shape Shifting to fool us?  Mutated Ascherion!  Attack the imposter!"  [More]
quests.completionMessage: "Alas, we are defeated. You may have discovered our plans for the Slone/Philion union, but we will find a way of ridding the worlds of you and your kind."

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 26 of 34
quests.description: "I surrender these documents to you for now. They mean nothing since we will change our plans now that they are discovered. You will pay for your interference. Now leave me."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "It"s very dark in here normally."
quests.completionMessage: "Hmmm, this is a very strange necklace. I think that I have seen something like this before a long time ago. Wait a second, could it be? I need to conduct some tests on this necklace, but I am in need of some specific items before I can do this."  [More]

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 32 of 34
quests.description: "I need you to bring me 6 Eyezora eyes, 6 High Priest Plasmas, the Earth rune, Air rune, Water rune, and Fire rune. Now hurry, there is no time to waste!"
quests.completionMessage: "Very good young one, now give me the items. Let me place the Runes together in the proper circle formation. Yes this is good. Now I have done some research on the necklace and found out that it was enchanted by one of Cain’s sorceresses from the ancient realms. It is believed that the wearer of the necklace would gain immense power, but only if they were able to withstand the evil within it. If the wearer of the necklace did not possess power enough to overcome the evil, the necklace would begin to eat away at their soul and mind. This is what happened to Pos."  [More]
quests.hint: Make a list of these items

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "But somehow... this is a great find indeed! Yes, this ancient necklace of Cain is all mine now! Muhahahahaha!! No, you can not have it! NO ONE CAN! Hahaha, catch me if you can! The necklace empowers me to leave you speaking to a holocron while the real me escapes deep within these caves! If you want the necklace you will have to find me and pry it from my dead body! Muhahahahaha!!"
quests.completionMessage: "Alas, you have defeated me and I am back where I started. I only wish I could have harnessed the powers of the necklace." [More]
quests.hint: "I am at the heart of this very cave!"

quests.title: Shapeshift Quest: Part 33 of 34
quests.description: "Stop gloating you worthless crumb!  Leave me alone, in the dark! Why don"t you slink back to Sial and boast of your worthless cruelty?"

quests.title: Intro
quests.completionMessage: "Greetings! I collect rare and strange items. I will reward you if you go on a Scavenger Hunt for some items I crave.  My Scavenger Hunt is a piece of cake! You find the following items for me, and I will give you a shiny new weapon for your trouble."  [More]

quests.title: Scavenger Hunt: Part 1 of 2
quests.description: "I need something rusted, a report on smuggling in the Black Market, a comb for a fair lady"s hair, a root from the Digdig plant, a Gi Bat head and the shell from the lesser spider-lord. No, you"ll get no hints from me, that"s part of the fun!"
quests.completionMessage: "Well done, you have gotten everything I asked for. Take this token and redeem it here with my servant, Trawoh, whenever you like.  He holds the rewards for this level hunt."  [More]
quests.hint: If I were you I would write this down...

quests.title: Scavenger Hunt: Part 1 Complete
quests.completionMessage: "If you want to do another scavanger hunt, for another weapon, talk to my brother. He"s standing right next to me."

quests.title: 1.  Tug
quests.description: You do not have the proper extractor for this process. Please use the initial Plants and Roots Extractor for this task.
quests.completionMessage: You have successfully extracted.
