quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I train the Infant Dilrium Champion.  This is a big deal, if you can imagine. Only those who are ranked as a champion may challenge us. Seek out Vigoss to become a ranked opponent before returning."
quests.completionMessage: "So you successfully defeated Lybyan?  I can"t imagine that"s so hard, even Suicide can beat him, so brag not.  Now"s your chance to face a real champion."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and speak to Vigoss first

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 4 of 15
quests.description: "But first you must bring me the Infant Dilirium Pass which our people are hiding from you. Kill as many of us as you must to find the pass, it will only make Blag"s victory over you that much sweeter."
quests.completionMessage: "I"m surprised you came back.  Most just run in fear, never to return.  Take a deep breathe and make sure you"re ready....."  [More]
quests.hint: Kill Infant Diliriums for the pass

quests.title: Champion Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Blag the Cannibal!"
quests.completionMessage: "Oh no, Blag! You took the eyes from our Champion! So much for dramatic build up. Here is the Championship Belt of Blag. It will allow you to challenge the next ranked opponent."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 4 Complete
quests.description: "If you would like to move on to your next victim seek out Varon the Blod master trainer.  You can find Varon on the Black Market Island."
quests.hint: Locate Varon on Black Market Island

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Learning the weakness of your opponents will give you an edge in every confrontation. But if you seek a challenge, you will not find it here if you are unranked. Find Vigoss to obtain a ranking, then work your way up to me."
quests.completionMessage: "So I see that you are a champion yourself.  Well you should feel at home here, for at least a while."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and speak to Vigoss first

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 9 of 15
quests.description: "In order for you to move on with this championship match you must bring me the Fight Ticket for Yial from among the Stontriles abroad in the world. Return with it and I will take you seriously. Or never return and become a source of ridicule for the rest of your days. I"m up for the latter, how about you?"
quests.completionMessage: "Well it appears that you and Yial are both ready for your match.  Good luck to you.. I should warn you that he has been warming up the entire time you were gone, and is very limber by now."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Kill! Maim! Hurt! Yial!"
quests.completionMessage: "Yial!  No, this cannot be!  We have been training for eons now and then you come along and pfft! You must be a true champion to have defeated Yial.  Here is his championship belt."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 9 Complete
quests.description: "Well, it was a good fight. You certainly don"t look that tough. You look more like a librarian. If you are ready to proceed to the next ranked champion you must seek out Rocon.  He is wandering somewhere on Moons Rift.  Good luck!"

quests.title: Champions Of IIA
quests.completionMessage: "To become the Champion of IIA, you will need to track down the champion for each type of creature and defeat them in single combat, climbing up through the rankings from bottom to top. The prize for such an accomplishment is unlimited fame and secret treasures. You will find the trainer for the lowest ranked champion near Trendor City. His name is Vigoss. Good luck!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Becoming the Champion of IIA is not an easy task. I am just one in a chain of challenges that must be overcome. Until you become ranked I can grant you no satisfaction. Seek out Vigoss for a ranking. One more thing, Wargazm is a sissyboy. You can tell him I said so."
quests.completionMessage: "Unlike most Klondons, Lacran will show no remorse in defeating you."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and speak to Vigoss first

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 6 of 15
quests.description: "Like those that have come before me, I must ask for you to bring the Lacran Fight Ticket to me in order to fight our champion. It is being carried by a Klondon. You find it."
quests.completionMessage: "You have proven formidable enough to challenge Lacran."  [More]
quests.hint: Kill Klondons to find the ticket

quests.title: Champion Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Lacran!"
quests.completionMessage: "Well I must say that I am very surprised. Here is his belt and you most certainly earned it.  Now, if you want a real challenge you will go seek out Fisiel."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 6 Complete
quests.description: "Your next stop will be the trainer of the Ean champion.  You can find Fisiel located near the Bloblic Colonies."
quests.hint: Locate Fisiel near the Bloblic Colonies

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "There are over a hundred Champions of IIA. Fortunately they are not all ranked, much like you. I can grant you no fight without a ranking. Seek out Vigoss to become ranked."
quests.completionMessage: "So I see that you were successful in defeating Lacran.  Well quite honestly Lacran is a wimp.  And now, he"s an unranked wimp which is infinitely worse. Anyhow, if you are really looking to take on Psykian you must prove to me that you are worthy of the Ean champion"s time."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and speak to Vigoss first

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 7 of 15
quests.description: "You must locate the Psykian Fight Ticket from among all the Eans. Kill the right one and bingo, you will have the ticket. Bring it to me if you still want to fight Psykian. But there is no shame in leaving me and never returning. Well, yes there is."
quests.completionMessage: "I pray you know what you are doing.  For once I release Psykian, I have no control over what he might do to you."  [More]
quests.hint: Kill Eans to find the ticket

quests.title: Champion Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Psykian!"
quests.completionMessage: "Our champion Psykian has been defeated. This cannot be.  Who are you? There is something special about you.  I sense... no, it cannot be... you cannot be the one that they have spoke of.  I have already said too much."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 7 Complete
quests.description: "Now go to Oian... he should be roaming around Moons Rift somewhere."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "So you think that you are capable of taking on our champion Via?! Ha, I laugh at that notion. You aren"t even ranked, that I can see. Seek out Vigoss to become a ranked opponent, and then we will talk."
quests.completionMessage: "So it looks like you are serious about talking on Via. Well I guess I can satisfy your desire for destruction and pain, but before I do so you must go collect some things for me."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and speak to Vigoss first

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 14 of 15
quests.description: "I need you to show me the Via Fight Ticket which you can only obtain from killing mature Stounts to find out which one of our race holds this prize. We will not give it up lightly."
quests.completionMessage: "Well you are very adept in your hunting skills. Let us see how well you fight. You have advanced to the heavyweight division in the Championship series. If you are able to defeat Via, not only will I reward you with his championship belt, but I will also give you a gift just for making it this far."  [More]
quests.hint: Kill Stounts to find the ticket

quests.title: Champion Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Kick his posterior, Via!"
quests.completionMessage: "Your skills are most impressive little one! Well now for my end of the deal... In addition to Via"s Championship Belt, I give you something that may come in handy in other circumstances."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 14 Complete
quests.description: "The Agron Spirit Boost will give you protection while in your Agron Shapeshift form, if you have one that is. If you don"t, it makes a good paperweight. Your next stop is Laspcan.  You will find him not far from the shores of the Black Market island."
quests.hint: Locate Laspcan off of the shores of Black Market

quests.title: Champions Of IIA
quests.completionMessage: "To become the Champion of IIA, you will need to track down the champion for each type of creature and defeat them in single combat, climbing up through the rankings from bottom to top. The prize for such an accomplishment is unlimited fame and secret treasures. You will find the trainer for the lowest ranked champion near Trendor City. His name is Vigoss. Good luck!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I am Laspcan. I represent the reigning Champion of IIA. And you are not ranked high enough to waste my time. Speak to Vigoss to begin your ranking, but I doubt you will make it very far."
quests.completionMessage: "So you think you are ready to take on our champion?  Well, I am sorry to say that you are not.  You must first complete one task for me."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and speak to Vigoss first

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 15 of 15
quests.description: "Fetch me the Fight Ticket for Savtan from among the Trines. I don"t remember which one has it, you will have to kill all you see. Once you return with the ticket, then we will grant you a Championship Bout with the reigning Champion of IIA."
quests.completionMessage: "Savtan is waiting. He will appear behind you and completely devastate your weak flesh, cooking it inside your pitiful armor. He will then suck out your innards, begin laughing at your weak fighting style, and then spew your liquified remains from his nostrils while laughing uncontrollably. At least that"s what usually happens." [More]
quests.hint: Kill Trines to find the ticket

quests.title: Champion Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Savtan! Keep a straight face!"
quests.completionMessage: "You have defeated Savtan. Fine. Well, you just wait until the rest of the Champions make it to IIa. They are all traveling here from their native realms to show you who is the toughest in the universe. You just wait. Also, here"s a little something that Savtan won"t need anymore." [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Complete
quests.description: "The Trine Aqua Force is a very special item amongst the Trines.  While shifted into the Trine form it will allow you to gain extra powers that the normal Trine does not have. That is just one of the many benefits of being the Champion of IIA. Farewell for now."

quests.title: Champions Of IIA
quests.completionMessage: "To become the Champion of IIA, you will need to track down the champion for each type of creature and defeat them in single combat, climbing up through the rankings from bottom to top. The prize for such an accomplishment is unlimited fame and secret treasures. You will find the trainer for the lowest ranked champion near Trendor City. His name is Vigoss. Good luck!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "In order to participate in the Championship tournament for IIA"s most elite warrior, you must train hard and go through the rankings in order to proceed. Come back when you are properly ranked. Find and speak to Vigoss to obtain a ranking."
quests.completionMessage: "Congratulations.  I am Oian, the trainer of the Diliriums.  My specialty is with the adults of this species so you will find this match much more challenging than with their infant counterparts."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and speak to Vigoss first

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 8 of 15
quests.description: "Before you can proceed though you must bring me the Fight Ticket for Yi from among the many Adult Diliriums active in the world. They most likely will kill you and shame you into giving up this quest. But if you find the pass, bring it to me and I will feed you to Yi."
quests.completionMessage: "I see that you have completed your task.  You actually performed this in a shorter time than I had thought you would.  Well this is not the time for compliments, it is time to see how you match up to Yi... on your mark."  [More]
quests.hint: Kill Adult Diliriums for the ticket

quests.title: Champion Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Yi!"
quests.completionMessage: "You have defeated Yi!  Not many have been able to do such a thing.  Here is Yi"s championship belt, it is yours now.  If you would like to move to the next opponent, seek out Blin the trainer to the Bibid race."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 8 Complete
quests.description: "Go see Blin along the shores of the Black Market Island."
quests.hint: Locate Blin on the shores of Black Market

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I train P how to fight like a champion. No, P is his name. No, I mean the letter P!! Listen, I"m not going to stand and take abuse from some unranked flob-fearing stubfoot! Get yourself ranked and then we"ll see who gets made fun of. See Vigoss for your ranking."
quests.completionMessage: "You want to take the next step towards becoming the ultimate champion, do you?.  Well, you will have difficulty fighting P. I warn you, P is so dangerous that he doesn"t even need a full name to strike fear into his opponents."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and speak to Vigoss first

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 12 of 15
quests.description: "Bring me the P Fight Ticket which is held by one of the many Negliks throughout this world, and then we will talk about the grand master accepting your challenge."
quests.completionMessage: "Very well. But I still think P will be way too much for you to handle. He"s one handful of fierce Neglik nightmare, I"ll tell you what! But why just talk about greatness when you can show it?"  [More]
quests.hint: Kill Negliks to find the ticket

quests.title: Champion Quest: Fight!
quests.completionMessage: "Oh no, Pansycakes!  Ulp... I mean, P! Listen, just because you defeated P doesn"t mean you have what it takes to be the ultimate champion.  Your journey is far from over."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 12 Complete
quests.description: "Your next challenge will be from Gaspial the trainer of the Clonsans.  He is located on the second Bloblic Colony Island. Now shoo."
quests.hint: Locate Gaspial on the Colonies near Oracle

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "There is an order to things.  I am only to be bothered by those at this stage of the Champion Quest. Seek out Vigoss to become a ranked opponent before you can challenge us."
quests.completionMessage: "I see that you are a pretty eager warrior.  Let us not waste any time at all.  You should be familiar with our format by now."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and speak to Vigoss first

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 3 of 15
quests.description: "You must obtain the Fight Ticket for Misci from among the Clegurks. We have hidden it well so you must kill many before you will find it. Maybe they will kill you instead, eh? Bring me the pass and I will introduce you to Misci who will be so excited she will lick you to death."
quests.completionMessage: "Now you are ready to take on Misci. Misci! It is time to come out and say hello to your new friend."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Misci!"
quests.completionMessage: "So you defeated Misci our champion, what else do you want from us?  Here, take her belt; I know this is why you are here anyway."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 3 Complete
quests.description: "The next highest ranked opponent is somewhere in the Solothic Caves. Find Sensei Ablis and you"ll find your next champion.  Go now, little destructor."
quests.hint: Ablis is inside the Solothic Caves

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I represent a ranked Champion of IIA. We only deal with other ranked opponents who can officially challenge us. Seek out Vigoss to become ranked."
quests.completionMessage: "Welcome to the next stage of the championship tournament for IIA"s elite.  I am the trainer and master of the Natons, cousins to the Flobs.  If you are ready to proceed with your challenge, I will give you your requirements."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and speak to Vigoss first

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 10 of 15
quests.description: "Retrieve for me the Niz Fight Ticket from our Naton brothers and sisters. They will die with honor, and once you find the ticket, so will you at the claws of Niz."
quests.completionMessage: "This is most exciting and I can"t wait to see how bad you are going to get stomped.  Prepare for your match with Niz."  [More]
quests.hint: Kill Natons to find the ticket

quests.title: Champion Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Meet Niz."
quests.completionMessage: "You defeated Niz!  I am shocked... you must leave now, I must attend to Niz.  Here, take his belt, and begone."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 10 Complete
quests.description: "If you want to proceed with your mean and cruel behavior, you should seek out Tennia inside the old Black Market structure. Say, why don’t you leave all of your weapons and armor here if you are so brave? That"s what I thought."
quests.hint: Locate Tennia inside the Black Market facility

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Careful, you shouldn"t get ahead of yourself. I am Sacoi, the sensei behind the Infant Stount Champion. If you are interested in fighting the Champions of IIA, you must go up the ranks like everyone else. Go find Vigoss and challenge the Champion of the Flobs."
quests.completionMessage: "On your way to becoming Champion I see.  Well if you want to take on my Champion you are going to have to first prove to us that you are even capable of such a task."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and speak to Vigoss first

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 2 of 15
quests.description: "If you really want to challenge Lybyan you must show me the Infant Stount Pass which members of our race are hiding amongst themselves. If you cannot find that, you don"t deserve to meet our champion Lybyan. If you do find the pass it will be a short meeting, hahaha!"
quests.completionMessage: "Time for me to announce the fight I see. In this corner we have a chump that thinks he can beat Lybyan, and in the winner"s corner we have Lybyan the Fearless!"  [More]
quests.hint: Kill Infant Stounts to find the pass

quests.title: Champion Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Lybyan! Peck his eyes out."
quests.completionMessage: "Who"s in the mood for chicken?  So you are out to make a name for yourself.  Well then if that is what you want I suggest that you continue down the championship path."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 2 Complete
quests.description: "If you would like to challenge the next champion, seek out Qi the trainer to the Midion race.  You can find him near the Black Market structure."
quests.hint: Locate Qi near the Black Market area

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "The Didons rarely migrate. In fact we rarely do anything except daydream and blast the bejeezus out of anything that comes near us. But I represent the Didon Champion, and we only fight ranked opponents. Find and talk to Vigoss to become ranked."
quests.completionMessage: "My name is Tennia, Aspirant trainer to Ziffian the Champion of the Didons.  I see that you have defeated Ziffian"s kin in a preceding match."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and speak to Vigoss first

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 11 of 15
quests.description: "If you truly desire to meet Ziffian you will find the Fight Ticket for Ziffian from among the Didons of this world. This is the test for you to ensure us that you are worthy of fighting Ziffian. Hurry back, you look like a bleeder."
quests.completionMessage: "So I see that you managed to defeat our friends and find the ticket.  That is not good at all.  That was a test to see if you would kill our own and you did.  Now it is time for you to get what is coming to you."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Ziffian!"
quests.completionMessage: "Ziffian has been defeated?  I cannot believe this.  You disgust me!! Why can"t you just stand and fight like everyone else! Here, take Ziffian"s championship belt and choke on it!"  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 11 Complete
quests.description: "Papcaca! No, I"m not swearing at you, he is the trainer of your next opponent. He has trained the most talented Neglik in the realms. If you are serious about your championship journey go and seek out Papcaca near the entrance to the Arilous Mining Cave."
quests.hint: Locate Papcaca near the Arilous Mining Cave

quests.title: Champions Of IIA
quests.completionMessage: "To become the Champion of IIA, you will need to track down the champion for each type of creature and defeat them in single combat, climbing up through the rankings from bottom to top. The prize for such an accomplishment is unlimited fame and secret treasures. You will find the trainer for the lowest ranked champion near Trendor City. His name is Vigoss. Good luck!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Blods are not known for their speed, but our champion doesn"t need to be fast to defeat the likes of you. However, you don"t show up on the ranking sheet, so we can"t fight you. So sorry. Find and speak to Vigoss to become a ranked champion."
quests.completionMessage: "I am Varon, master trainer of the Blods.  So I see that you are true champion, but every champion must pay their dues before being able to experience the true joys of life... or the afterlife for that matter."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and speak to Vigoss first

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 5 of 15
quests.description: "We have sent the Fight Ticket for Nia out among our members. They will keep it from you unless you can kill enough of them to find the ticket. This will test how serious you are about your challenge."
quests.completionMessage: "So you have eliminated my poor Faduns...  Now is not the time for you to run on at the mouth, now is the time for you to put your money where the sun don"t shine... or something like that. Nia! Your next victim awaits your wrath!"  [More]
quests.hint: Kill Faduns to find the ticket

quests.title: Champion Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Nia! Show this worm that speed is over-rated."
quests.completionMessage: "Nia has been defeated and you were the one that did it.  This is a sad day for us, because you have taken away our championship belt and dropped us to the status of unranked. Here, take the belt!  It was getting too small for Nia anyhow."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 5 Complete
quests.description: "Since you think that you are so tough, why don"t you go see if you can defeat Lacran?  He is the Klondon champion.  If you really want to fight Lacran, travel towards Death Valley and seek out Dapcen.  Keep your eyes out for a very large rock."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: -There will never be anything read from here-
quests.completionMessage: "You are here to challenge the champion of the Flobs?!  Well before I allow you to take on our champion, you must first prove that you can even handle the Flob creatures.  You gotta prove it to me, you see"  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 1 of 15
quests.description: "We have hidden the Fight Pass for Grak among our people. You must kill Flobs in order to uncover the pass, and you must show me the pass before I will allow you to fight Grak. Such crimes against his people will really tick Grak off for your fight."
quests.completionMessage: "Oh the carnage.  Prepare to get what you asked for."  [More]
quests.hint: Kill Flobs to uncover the pass

quests.title: Champion Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Grak!"
quests.completionMessage: "Completely horrifying, that"s what you are! You have earned the Championship belt of Grak. You are probably proud of yourself, but I"ll let you in on a secret. You just defeated the weakest champion of them all! Plus he"s got those little arms that aren"t good for much. The other champions will not be so easy."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 1 Complete
quests.description: "If you are ready to take the next step, seek out Sacoi in the Solothic Caves. Sacoi is the sensei of the Infant Stount Champion Lybyan. Good luck and train hard!"
quests.hint: Next round, Sacoi in the Solothic Caves

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "You"re not one of those To)(ic members are you? Just between you and me....they should learn how to lead a target. But why am I talking with you? I only deal with ranked opponents. Seek out Vigoss in order to get a ranking."
quests.completionMessage: "We both know why you are here, so let"s get down to it. Champion Jel will devour you whole then spit out your gall bladder. I suspect he just doesn"t like the way they taste. But there will be no collecting of creatures from us, we itch for action!"  [More]
quests.hint: Find and speak to Vigoss first

quests.title: Champion Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Jel! Dinner time!"
quests.completionMessage: "I thought that you would be more of a wussy than all of clan [To)(ic] together.  Apparently they still hold the wussy belt.  However you deserve something much better.  Here is the Championship Belt of Jel."  [More]

quests.title: Champion Quest: Round 13 Complete
quests.description: "Well it looks like you are on your way to becoming a champion of IIA, but know that there is much that lies before you still.  If you are ready to continue on your championship journey seek out Hilip on Unity Outpost.  He is the trainer of your next opponent."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Why do you want to control the Power? In the wrong hands it can do great harm. Bring me the Signet of Overking and I will know what side you are on. You can find this item in the ancient crypt near this place."
quests.completionMessage: "Yes you are wiser than I had at first perceived. This is good news for you. I will now assist you in obaining a power core. Ask and you shall receive..."  [More]
quests.hint: Bring me the Signet of Overking

quests.title: Neronicle Quest: Part 5 of 13
quests.description: "So you need a power core suitable for a NeronicleLazer Gun? Then you must go and seek out the 4 base elements of this realm, in the form of prizes held by beings of power. Bring me these relics and I can tap their energy to forge a power core. Seek the runes, young quester. You will also need a power mission from Sotannalk."
quests.completionMessage: "By the power of these elements and through ancient dweomercraeft I shall forge these runes into a power core, HAHAHAHAHA! [cough, cough] [gasp]  I am getting too old for this. Here is your power core. Try not to blow yourself up."  [More]
quests.hint: Runes of Earth, Air, Fire, and Water

quests.title: Neronicle Quest: Part 6 of 13
quests.description: "You may now return to Sotannalk and tell him that you are not a loser. He will probably not believe you."
quests.completionMessage: "You need a Channel Crystal now? Can"t you do anything on your own? Well, in this case you are right. I am the only one who can forge such a crystal, but you must seek out the items that I need. First, I will need the matching Blue and Grey rune stones. Next I will need you to locate and bring back to me the Stone of Spirits."  [More]

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 17 of 19
quests.description: "Now, about the Stone of Spirits: some say that this magical stone has lain dormant in the sand on the bottom of the Dark Sea, while others swear that the stone was actually consumed by a great beast. Find all three of these stones and bring them back to me."
quests.completionMessage: "All three stones! You have done a magnificent job my young adventurer. As promised, here is your Channel Crystal. If you happen to bump into any of the Forge brothers, give them my blessings. Oh, one more thing..."  [More]

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 18 of 19
quests.description: "I recall that you will need another Fire Rune before you are finished, so take this knowledge and do something with it. If you are truly constructing a Chalis Focali Gun, you will need to take the Channel Crystal to K-Forge in order to put everything together. Farewell."
quests.hint: K-Forge must assemble this for you

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Hello, I"m working with my brother T-Forge over there. He"s showing me the ropes on Bloblic weaponry. I"m working on part of the Chalis Focali right now. If you get to the point where you need pieces of that weapon, don"t forget where I am."
quests.completionMessage: "Ahh, I see my brother finally got around to returning my tools. Ugh! Smells like he"s been using my bonder to tap kegs! News, unlike tools, travels fast. I heard you were seeking the Chalis Focali. I may be of some assistance to your quest. But I have learned from my brothers never do anything for anyone without requiring a fun task!"  [More]

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 7 of 19
quests.description: "Well, fun for me anyway! First, I would like you to battle my pet Pooky.  If you can defeat him, return to me with his collar.  He is somewhere in this tunnel. Probably one of the greatest hints ever."
quests.completionMessage: "I see you found and gave Pooky a good workout.  He"s always been a scrapper.  I"ve been looking for a warrior to seek revenge for my friend Kodo, and you appear to be just the Blob to do it."  [More]

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 8 of 19
quests.description: "Venture into the Stone Maze and find Arkaz, the leader of the monsters that took over Kodo"s shop. Kill him and deliver his heart to Kodo... hopefully that will help to lift his spirits."
quests.completionMessage: "It is great to hear that Kodo is well.  You have restored some life to him and he may recover his full strength yet.  Shhhhh, do you hear that?  The Dark Lord is once again mounting his forces for an attack on Black Market."  [More]

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 10 of 19
quests.description: "The Dark Lord"s forces seem to enter through a vortex in the bridge room just down this tunnel.  I need you to destroy them and hopefully put a stop to their attacks. Stay nearby and be ready because their raids are about once every hour. Bring me something from the Dark Lord as proof of your success."
quests.completionMessage: "Good riddance. You have done well and I will send word of your accomplishments to my brothers. You know, Sotannalk has been asking about you lately. He was most impressed by your performance against Bozer."  [More]
quests.hint: Stay nearby until Dark Lord"s raid

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 11 of 19
quests.description: "I think you should go have a talk with him. Sotannalk, not Bozer! Give him my best along with this note, and good luck in all the rest of your adventures."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Hey there! You bring any brew with ya? No??!?! Well, what are ya waitin" for!?!? Go find something drinkable and bring it here! The night is still young. My brother K-Forge, now THERE"S someone who knows how to keep the brew flowing!"
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent, K-Forge comes through with a keg!! Just in time, too. I only get one of these when someone wants a NeronicleLazer Gun. You got the right guy to build it for ya, but you will have to bring me what I need. You will need the aid of two master craftsmen to obtain these. Kodo the engineer and Sotannalk the metalsmith."  [More]

quests.title: Neronicle Quest: Part 3 of 13
quests.description: "This is what I am going to need in order to construct this bad boy: a NeronicleLazer Gun Casing, a NeronicleLazer Gun Drive, a NeronicleLazer Gun Power Supply, and a NeronicleLazer Gun Barrel. Take this letter to Sotannalk to get some help with these things. Check around the Bloblic colonies for his forge."
quests.completionMessage: "Hey, now that"s an accomplishment. You done good! Let me just prepare myself for work [gulp, gulp] Aaahh! Okay, just a little elbow grease [creak] and my trusty molecular bonder [zzzzzt] and a good swift kick [BANG!] Hey, it worked!"  [More]

quests.title: Neronicle Quest: Complete 13 of 13
quests.description: "I mean... of course it worked. Now listen up, this is a Rune Channel weapon with an instantaneous projectile. There is a delay before firing you will have to get used to. And make sure you point the end with the hole in it towards the target. Okay, that"s all the instruction you need. Back to the party! Save this note I"m giving you and take it to K-Forge with your NeronicleLazer if you want to get an even better gun."
quests.completionMessage: "What?  You gotta be kidding me! I just sent you to see K-Forge like... yesterday. Why is he sending you back here? I don"t think I"ve even finished my last beer. Oh, wait a minute... what day is it? Okay, I"m fine. Sure, I can help you with your quest for the Chalis Focali."  [More]
quests.hint: Take the note and gun to K-Forge

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 3 of 19
quests.description: "Okay what I"m gonna need is 3 Lemon Quartz gems, 3 Moon Stones and 3 Iolites. The Lemon Quartz drops from a flying creature that leaves blood when it dies. The Iolites drop from a similar bird that is not quite as tough. The Moon Stones come from a mechanical death machine that walks on two legs and is an improvement over the original model. Get moving!"
quests.completionMessage: "Great job on the gems! You are becoming a very useful person to have around. My ladies will look even more beautiful wearing some of these. But I have suffered a setback. While you were gone a thief broke in here and stole the keg my brother sent me. I don"t think he"s gotten very far with it yet."  [More]

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 4 of 19
quests.description: "Shendo is more of a pain in the butt than a real threat, but my party is starting to lag without my keg. Keep your eyes peeled for a shady, ugly looking guy nearby with the name Shendo plastered across his face. Retrieve the keg and bring it back and we can discuss the Chalis Focali again. And hurry up. Did I mention that I was thirsty?"
quests.completionMessage: "Hey, thanks. I really appreciate that and so do my ladies. You know, a keg is one of the modern marvels of mechanical engineering. Proper keg design is essential to keeping the natural carbonation of the beer locked in and stable. Let me tell you how it works..." [More]

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 5 of 19
quests.description: "You see -- LOOK OUT! Shendo is back again!!"
quests.completionMessage: "Hey, thank you soooo much! That Shendo is a sneaky one. But thanks to you, he will stay away for good. Now, where were we? Oh, yes... the Chalis Focali. Well, what we need is someone with lots of weaponry skill who doesn"t mind working for free and who is sober. That rules me out!" [More]

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 6 of 19
quests.description: "But don"t despair, I have a brother who hasn"t yet discovered the lure of fine brew. Take these tools I borrowed to my other brother J-Forge in the Black Market caves. He can help you with the pieces of the Chalis Focali."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "The NeronicleLazer Gun  is a Bloblic Rune damage weapon. Only those capable of handling the power may obtain one. Check with K-Forge if you are interested in it."
quests.completionMessage: "So, good old Q-Forge has sent you to enlist my help, has he? Sure, I will help you. We Bloblics stick together. Your task is simple. All I require for the NeronicleLazer Gun Power Supply is a Power Core. And you are in luck, sinceI know a master of power source development."  [More]

quests.title: Neronicle Quest: Part 4 of 13
quests.description: "There is an old hermit Amphibian that resides deep in the Sun Dial dungeon. He goes by the name of Euhim. He is not a very trusting individual so you may have to earn his favor, but he will be able to supply you with a Power Core."
quests.completionMessage: "How is that old hermit? I"ll bet he is still just as crabby as ever. Anyhow, while you were gone I took the liberty of beginning the construction of the power supply. All I need to do is add the Power Core and viola... Here you go! You know I also make the barrels for the Neronicle, right? Do you need one?"  [More]
quests.hint: Find Euhim in Sun Dial Ruins

quests.title: Neronicle Quest: Part 7 of 13
quests.description: "Whoah! Did you see that? STOP THIEF! I can"t believe this... My shop was just raided by Bozer! Look, there he goes! He must have snuck in and been listening to our conversation. He just stole the blueprints to the Neronicle Barrel!! I can"t believe you didn"t stop him! What are you, some kind of traitor? You had better prove otherwise by going and getting my blueprints back. He will head towards his hideout on Moon"s Rift."
quests.completionMessage: "For crying out loud, if I knew it was going to take you this long, I would have closed my shop and went after Bozer myself. But you deserve thanks for helping me. Now back to business... There you are, a Neronicle Barrel."  [More]

quests.title: Neronicle Quest: Part 8 of 13
quests.description: "Kodo should be able to get the remaining components on your list. His forge is right around here too. Just look around."
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, glad you"re back. Just the Blob I was looking for. I have been having some trouble with the Dark Lord. He"s been amassing his force of Eyezora Seekers on the Root of the Oracle for days and I fear he will soon raid the Bloblic Colonies."  [More]

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 12 of 19
quests.description: "Of course this will disrupt all my work, and he plays that awful booming music that grates on my ears. Please, knock out 6 of his Seekers and return their remains to me. That should set back his invasion plans for a while."
quests.completionMessage: "Impressive, you have a knack for foiling the plans of the Dark Lord. That talent should serve you well in the future. Oh hey, before you go... an old friend of mine dropped by the shop today. His name is Onizuka and he"s the last surviving member of a clan of Ninja Blobs."  [More]
quests.hint: Kill 6 Seekers on the Root of the Oracle

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Fight! 13 of 19
quests.description: "Onizuka"s been looking to test his aged skills against a great warrior. It would mean a lot to me if you would find him on the hill at the edge of the Root of Oracle and duel him. Come back and tell me of your success, or lack thereof."
quests.completionMessage: "Hmm... from the looks of what you brought back, it looks like he"s  been drinking. No wonder you beat him. As you know, dying and rebirthing washes all the effects of alcohol from your body. Now he is calling you out once more."  [More]

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Fight!! 14 of 19
quests.description: "Onizuka says, "Same place, different outcome." Good luck. See you when you return."
quests.completionMessage: "Nice style you have there. You"re so slow that your opponents either give up and go to sleep or start drinking. Nevertheless, the great Onizuka is impressed with your fighting style and ability to keep making him buy more liquor. But now, remember Bozer? I am sure you do. Well he is on the loose again. Word is that he has been seen wandering around Cave of Ancients in search of the key that will allow him to pass through into the Spirit realm."  [More]

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 15 of 19
quests.description: "Bozer cannot be allowed to do this. You must hunt him down and stop him. Be careful on this mission. I hear that he does not travel alone these days after what you did to him. Bring me his badge once you have defeated him... Good Luck!!"
quests.completionMessage: "You have stopped him again! What he is trying to do is not good. He may return again at any time and you may be called to drive him away once more. You had better be ready for the call. Here is your Reinforced Focali Casing."  [More]
quests.hint: "Fight Bozer in the Cave of Ancients."

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 16 of 19
quests.description: "Since you have repeatedly proven your strength to me, I will send word of your progress to K-Forge. Have you found the Channel Crystal yet? Go talk to Euhim, he can give you one. Good luck on this mission, we will not talk again."
quests.hint: Find Euhim for a Channel Crystal

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: -There will never be anything read from here-
quests.completionMessage: "Hello friend, I am T-Forge. I can build and design many things for a price. For my services I will require a favor and some materials. Dark Jousters have been showing up in greater numbers in this cave."  [More]

quests.title: WaveSnipe Quest: Part 1 of 4
quests.description: "Kill and bring me the hearts of 20 Dark Jousters to help make it a bit safer in here. I will also need 20 Moolstones from the mines to constuct the first part of a Wave Snipe for you."
quests.completionMessage: "Great, you"re back. Ok, just give me a minute and I"ll have the barrel done for you.  There we are, finished.  Here"s your barrel."  [More]

quests.title: WaveSnipe Quest: Part 2 of 4
quests.description: -There will never be anything read from here-
quests.completionMessage: "While you were out I caught word that Toolpole is out looking for me and he wants vengeance.  He thinks I"m at fault because he has been killed so many times by a Wave Snipe.  Like it"s my fault that he doesn"t know how to stick and move."  [More]

quests.title: WaveSnipe Quest: Part 2 of 4 (cont"d)
quests.description: "How about you kill Toolpole before he gets to me and I"ll make it worth your while. And... hey! There he is now!"
quests.completionMessage: "What"s this?  A letter that toolpole was carrying. Cheapskate didn"t even put a stamp on it. Well, you"ve helped me out, and in return here is your payment. The second of three components of the Wave Snipe, the Wave Snipe Casing. Exciting, isn"t it? Of course it is! This is all I do all day."  [More]

quests.title: WaveSnipe Quest: Part 3 of 4
quests.description: "Okay, let"s make a deal here. Before I make you the final and most important component to the Wave Snipe, I need you to kill the Kidion Lord for his diamond-hard nails and 20 Kidion Bats for their eyes. You will find my cousin outside on Black Market, give him my chrest and he will tell you where to find the Kidion Lord.
quests.completionMessage: "I see you have returned with my eyes and nails. I brew the eyes with a few rare materials and then soak the firing chamber in the mixture, it"s what gives the firing chamber it"s extra strength. Otherwise the firing chamber would just explode on its first use. The Kidion Lord Nails are used to make the firing pin."  [More]
quests.hint: "The Kidion Lord is outside Black Market!"

quests.title: WaveSnipe Quest: Part 4 of 4
quests.description: "Once you bring me the Wave Snipe Barrel, Wave-snipe casing and the Internal Firing Chamber all at the same time I can then assemble your Wave-Snipe."
quests.completionMessage: "Ok it looks like you have the other two pieces I made for you, so let"s put this whole thing together. This should only take a second.  [clang!] [BIZZZANG!] Alright, done! And a fine piece of work if I do say so myself. Here you go. Don"t kill anyone I know."  [More]

quests.title: WaveSnipe Quest: Complete
quests.description: "The Wavesnipe should serve you faithfully for a long time. But when you get up a few more levels in Weapon Tech, don"t hesitate to talk to K-Forge again about newer and more powerful weapons. My brothers and I always have the best stuff available. Take care."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Kiston and I have a long history of friendship."
quests.completionMessage: "Kiston is on the wrong side in this war. No one can withstand Cain. You would not last a minute against his elite warriors. Unless... perhaps you are willing to test yourself against some of them?"  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Here is your first test. Crousha will defeat you."
quests.completionMessage: "One down... impressive. Juspon is waiting and she will not be so easy."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!!

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!!!

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!!!!

quests.completionMessage: "You are indeed powerful, but I do not think Kiston understands how strong Cain will be once he has come into his own. It will take more than luck to defeat him."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 14 of 20
quests.description: "Take this letter to Kiston, I must plead with him to change his mind and join the side of Cain."
quests.completionMessage: "What is this... Kiston sends you back with a drink? A suicide potion no doubt. That would just suit you fine, wouldn"t it? I have been strengthened by Cain"s will and reinforcements have arrived."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!!!!!
quests.description: "I will drink your elixir, but only if you defeat my new batch of warriors! If you manage that, I will welcome poison.  Bring on Cas!"
quests.completionMessage: "I suppose Cas looked tougher than he was."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!!!!!!

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!!!!!!!

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Cain is the most feared being on IIA. I have yet to see anyone fight him and live to tell about it."
quests.completionMessage: "My Scepter! Oh, but its power has been drained by Cain"s filthy agents. I know of only one way to recharge the spirit magic that powers it, and that is to wrap it in the Sash of the Overking. A word of warning about his domain..."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 13 of 20

quests.completionMessage: "Now that I have the tool to restore the power of my scep..."  [More]
quests.hint: Overking on Root of the Oracle

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 13 of 20
quests.description: "I want you to take this letter to one of Cain"s key contacts in the underworld cave of fire. Perhaps you can persuade him to join our cause. His name is Nostok."
quests.completionMessage: "I think Nostok wants to believe in you, but Cain has poisoned his mind. Take this elixir to him."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 15 of 20
quests.description: "If you can get Nostok to drink it he will be free from Cain"s influence and should join our cause."
quests.completionMessage: "Great work! You are really something. With you on our side, we cannot help but win!"  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Part 17 of 20

quests.title: Welcome
quests.completionMessage: "Welcome to Bloblic City! I am Brout, the Regent appointed by Bo to keep the peace here. I recently un-retired from my hobby of gardening to take this post -- which is a good thing because I was going crazy with boredom! Do not cause any trouble and enjoy your stay."

quests.title: Flight of the Free Peoples
quests.completionMessage: "Twas not long ago by any measure of time that the inhabitants of IIA were absorbed in their own frivolity. Eating, drinking, fighting and laughing, their world was a place where the cares of the day were laid to rest each night, and each morning brought new challenges. How often do the minds of the self-absorbed dismiss the possibilities that are most damaging to them? For you see, they were not alone. They considered themselves the masters of their planet because they knew no comparable beings other than the semi-intelligent creatures they used for sport. They said to themselves, "Who on this world have we not tamed? What forces exist that are not subject to our rule?" Alas, they were soon to be made aware of their error.

quests.title: Chapter 2
quests.completionMessage: For a new realm lay undiscovered beneath their feet. It is now known that down beneath even the deepest, darkest dungeons of the underworld exists the Spirit World. A place devoid of natural light, inhabited by amazing creatures whose form and appearance is only half material. They call themselves the Shadowflesh and are both spirit and substance, neither living nor dead. They are the true natives of IIA. And unlike the surface inhabitants who were so oblivious to their presence they have always been aware of overworld life. It cavorted and flitted above and beyond their reach. They could sense it, smell it and almost taste it and yet it was forever beyond their grasp. So they grew to hate the teasing life forces dancing before their senses. And they waited for some way to escape the bonds of their world and enter another.

quests.title: Chapter 3
quests.completionMessage: Their wait ended when a leader arose from without. He was not one of them, yet he shared with them a common hate of the surface-dwellers. He was cunning in the way he crept into their ranks. He was firm in the demonstration of his power. He planted his boot firmly on the necks of all Shadowflesh, squeezing them to within an inch of extermination before letting them live in order to gratefully serve him. He boosted their spirit by teaching them the strength that exists in common purpose. He taught them to obey without question. He did away with their petty individual power struggles by showing them that none could challenge his rule and live, and none would challenge his will and succeed. He broke them and utterly shattered them, then he rebuilt them in his image. They are a driven, focused mass of vile hatred under the command of a cunning, ruthless leader who has but one purpose - the destruction of all overworld life.

quests.title: Chapter 4
quests.completionMessage: The dark purpose of the Lord of Spirits, as he began to call himself, was discovered much too late by his quarry. Far too long the overworld inhabitants looked at one another or at the changing sky. Seldom did they direct their senses beneath them. So it was that the Spirit Lord was able to work and scheme in secret. Being so close to the planet core he studied the swirling energies that set this planet apart and found a way to harness them in a limited fashion. Using power gained from a mysterious artifact, he channeled a tiny amount of the planet"s energy through himself and opened gates from the Spirit World to the overworld. His well-prepared forces streamed through the portals in strategic places and quickly overcame the startled and disorganized resistance. However, his plan to overthrow all surface life was thwarted unexpectedly by the combined efforts of the four surface-world rulers. Unaware of the full magnitude of the threat, they discovered enough of the impending danger in time to jointly prepare a hidden valley of refuge should the worst befall them. So it was that the remnants of the free peoples of IIA staggered into their new home frightened, battered and angry. Whatever hope remains for their survival will depend on whether they can build upon the alliance forged by their leaders. Will they galvanize and unite against their common enemy? Or will they fragment and dissolve, becoming a mere footnote in the history of the planet which called them here. Only time will tell.

quests.title: Chapter 5
quests.completionMessage: One cold, crisp morning a horn sounded clear, ringing across the land bringing the hope of a new freedom as it carried. A well-organized force of Bloblics, Amphibians and Humans poured through the portal on Uoc Penn. They separated into three groups and made their way to Trendor, Amphibious Island and the Bloblic City. Fierce fighting occurred but the difference was made by an assortment of new weapons which all the free peoples now carried. They were tuned to different channels of reality and worked devastation on the spirit-creatures. The Overkings were driven off and the shadowflesh routed completely. Those that weren"t killed slunk back through an escape portal, and when the last enemies had left the portal was forcibly closed by Strife and Celeste. There were celebrations in the streets and sobering remembrance of those who were lost in the first invasion. All the free peoples vowed to never be reticent about the security of their world again. But who can tell where the next threat will come from, and whether or not it can be predicted? Yet for now, the land settles down for a long time of peace.

quests.title: About the Author
quests.completionMessage: Brout is a highly regarded Bloblic in the service of Lord Bo. He gave an excellent account of himself in the defense of Trendor city during the invasion, and if it were not for his valor many more lives would have been lost. He pieced together his account of the Battle of Bloblic City by interviewing soldiers who were present.

quests.title: The Fall of Bloblic City, as told by Brout
quests.completionMessage: Long will the Bloblic people mark the day they were deposed from their lands. It is said that the red sun of that morning dawned cold as any other day during the changing of the guard. Most of the city"s forces were out on assignment in the Black Market to put down an uprising of Shockions. In interviews, none that were there that day have ever admitted to being less than watchful. But Malian historians generally agree that years of being the dominant force on IIA had eased their sense of vigilance. Not that it would have mattered. The stillness of the day was shattered by a thunderclap as a portal rift opened over the city. Hordes of creatures began to stream out, attacking as they came. The Bloblic guards quickly formed a battle line and began to engage the invaders, dropping them one by one. They held their own and began to wait for the numbers of their attackers to decrease when something very strong came floating through the portal. It caught the defenders by surprise and quickly felled several of them. At that point Bo, the leader of the Bloblic people, launched himself at the new threat. In a brief but heated exchange Bo threw the creature to the ground and was about to finish him. The tide had begun to turn and the spirits of the defenders were rising. Yet the call came and was relayed to Bo at that instant - their alliance with the other free peoples of IIA was being invoked, for the other races were not faring as well in their battles. The order was given reluctantly to retreat. Bo was the last to withdraw, vowing that the invaders stay would be short-lived. They honored their agreement and oversaw the migration of all of IIA to a protected valley, and there they impatiently await the call to reclaim their lands.

quests.title: The Retaking of Bloblic City, as told by Brout
quests.completionMessage: The call finally came, and it was masterfully done. The leaders of the races met together and developed a new weapon design enabling different channels of damage to be done. They tuned these weapons to cause maximum destruction to the shadowflesh. Then they struck on exactly the kind of morning that they were first invaded. The battle was short and the spirit creatures were overcome and massacred. Most of the Overkings were banished, except the Overking that had taken Bloblic City. Bo called him out personally, and the fiend tried to flee at the sight of his old foe. But Bloblics can be swift when they need to be and Bo caught the spectre on the Root of the Oracle. With Lord Eyezions minions looking on and afraid to interfere, Bo crushed the essence of the spirit creature in his hands and against his body. With a hideous wail, the Overking Spectre melted into its component essences and drained into pure energy and was dissipated. The rest fled to an escape portal near Trendor which was forcibly closed by the other leaders. Thus ended the occupation of Bloblic City. A new era has begun, one which all Bloblics have taken a vow never to abandon our lands again. It is a wonderful time to be alive!

quests.title: Multiple Listing Service
quests.completionMessage: For use by licensed real estate agents only.

quests.title: Four Falls
quests.completionMessage: Lovely castle newly built with five rooms, stone staircase, stone ramp, stone furniture, stone fireplace, stone beds and stone lavatory. Stone framed windows give it that "lived-in" look. Owner relocating to alternate server, must sell.

quests.title: Trendor
quests.completionMessage: Cheap shops available! Trendor City opening up for business again. Flats for Alchemy, Smithing and Engineering at competitive rates. Act quickly, they will go fast!

quests.title: Intro
quests.completionMessage: "Ho ho, welcome! If you are looking for the Elemental Wavesnipe, I have handed that business over completely to my brother T-Forge in the Black Market Caves. If, on the other hand, you are interested in the NeronicleLazer Gun, well you"ve come to the right place! But you will have to be well known enough amongst the blobs before I will give you that information."

quests.title: Neronicle Quest: Part 1 of 13
quests.description: "I"m fairly sure that I have nothing to do with any of your quests. You don"t even have the 14th Bo Badge!"
quests.completionMessage: "Well, I guess this means you want the NeronicleLazer Gun! Excellent! Your first task will be to pay a visit to my brother Q-Forge."  [More]

quests.title: Neronicle Quest: Part 2 of 13
quests.description: "When you meet Q-Forge, he is only interested in one thing. Beer! Well, maybe two things... but anyway, take him this keg of my special brew. That will let him know you came from me and he will tell you what you need to do to get your NeronicleLazer Gun. Q-Forge is in the top level of Trendor City in a secret room. Don"t return to speak with me again until you have your NeronicleLazer."
quests.completionMessage: "Welcome back! So, you are looking for an even better weapon than the NeronicleLazer Gun, eh? How about a gun with a real kick to it? I may be able to build a Chalis Focali for you. It will depend on how good you are at supplying me with the pieces I need to make it. First, you must retrieve the contents of some chests for me." [More]

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 1 of 19
quests.description: "Here are three keys and three hints to the locations of 3 chests. Each one contains a part I need to build the Chalis Focali. One chest is buried at the foot of Cain, another is on a platform overlooking the unknown, and the last sits regally on a throne of stone. Open the chests and bring me the Nuclear Contrivance, the Centriole Power Generator, and the Thermantidote Arm."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent! This is enough for me to start building the weapon. But there are other pieces I need, and for them you must go talk to my brother. He will set you on the proper path." [More]

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 2 of 19
quests.description: "Which brother? Oh, I mean Q-Forge, of course! Go and see him now and return to me when he has helped you retrieve these items: a Channel Crystal and a Reinforced Focali Casing. Also, bring me a Fire Rune, only its fury can provide the heat to forge this weapon."
quests.completionMessage: "Amazing. I never thought you could find all of them!  You are truly an elite adventurer. Only the most persistent warriors have been able to complete this.  It will take some time to assemble your gun... Here we go."  [More]
quests.hint: Talk to Q-Forge; gather Focali items

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Complete 19 of 19
quests.description: "The mighty Chalis Focali just as you requested. I lost the manual for it, so let me give you some pointers. It has a 2.5 second delay before firing. It launches a powerful death damage projectile, and hits with a splash effect that can cover many targets in a small area. Don"t kill anyone I know."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Everything I worked for is lost in Black Market.  My shop, my home, my equipment... all overrun by vicious creatures and thieves."
quests.completionMessage: "It pleases me to craft Neronicle components. However all my equipment is stored in security chests in the Black Market Maze of Stone. If you feel that you can somehow help me, take my key ring with you. At least one of these keys will fit each chest you can find that belongs to me."  [More]

quests.title: Neronicle Quest: Part 9 of 13
quests.description: "Also, you should look for anyone suspicious and waste them! They probably have some of the stolen goods from my shop right on their bodies. Recover the following items and I will help you: I need the Gear Box, Drive Train, Recoil Springs, Firing Pin, Cocking Mechanism and my Tool Kit. Oh, and keep an eye out for my Welder as well. If you"re wondering why I can"t give you the fifth key, it"s because Executor took it."
quests.completionMessage: "My tools! Thank you so much!  You are a great Bloblic warrior. Let me get right to work on this for you... [cluzzang!] Here it is. Now is there anything else I can do for you? Or maybe even something that you can do for me?"  [More]
quests.hint: Find the chests in Black market

quests.title: Neronicle Quest: Part 10 of 13
quests.description: "Well, if you are going for the NeronicleLazer Gun, I can make you a casing for it. Unfortunately, I will need my welder and I"m not sure where it has gotten off to. I think it should have been in one of my chests. Are you sure you looted them all? Well, I can"t do much without my welder."
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, wonderful!  You have found my father"s welder. I was wondering where I had left it.  In order to build the NeronicleLazer Gun Casing I will require a chunk of Servunty metal and 10 pieces of Titanium Carbide. I hope you kept my ring of keys."  [More]

quests.title: Neronicle Quest: Part 11 of 13
quests.description: "I had a chunk of Servunty Metal in one of my chests, however during my escape from Black Market I was startled by a huge eye that suddenly appeared in front of me and I dropped the chest. If you could retrieve the metal from that chest, I will make you a Neronicle Casing. You will need one of my keys from my key ring to open the chest."
quests.completionMessage: "Ahhh, I love the smell of metal in the morning! Great work, let me throw this together for you real quick... [ching! ching!] Here it is, fresh from my hands and my welder. Well, you should have enough pieces to get this thing completed. Is there anything else?"  [More]

quests.title: Neronicle Quest: Part 12 of 13
quests.description: "Well, to be honest I"ve been depressed lately. My shop and old stomping grounds is overrun by gangs of creatures that I can"t overcome. I could use a good cheering up sometime soon. Take the pieces I made for you back to Q-Forge. Good travels to you."
quests.completionMessage: "The Dark Heart of Arkaz. Yes, he had a dark heart. He was responsible for the destruction of my shop and dreams. I see there may be hope for my career yet. Thank you for giving me this hope. Maybe I can return the favor in the future."  [More]

quests.title: Chalis Focali Quest: Part 9 of 19
quests.description: "But for now, return to J-Forge and give him my thanks as well."
quests.hint: Return to J-Forge with my thanks

quests.title: What happened?
quests.completionMessage: "Yes, what happened. That is what I would like to know. We have lost contact with our invasion force and our leader. We remain here wondering what has happened to our conquest of the overworld?"

quests.title: Welcome
quests.completionMessage: "Welcome to Club Karma in Trendor City. I am Drake, the new Regent here. I was appointed by Darius to make sure that Trendor stays free and her inhabitants stay safe. Enjoy your stay."

quests.completionMessage: "Even the best hydromechanical engineer in the universe needs to make a little money sometime. Press F1 and click STORE, or type :BUY in the chat line to view our inventory."

quests.title: Engineering
quests.completionMessage: "You have no idea how superior my intelligence and skill is to yours. I put all other engineers to shame. I do however, have to eat. Press F1 and click STORE or type :BUY in the chat line to access our inventory."

quests.title: Alchemy
quests.completionMessage: "Press F1 and click STORE or type :BUY to see my collection of Alchemical supplies."

quests.title: Armor and Jetpacks
quests.completionMessage: "I make armor and jetpacks. Press F1 and click STORE or type :BUY in the chat line to see what I have to sell."

quests.title: Melee Weapons
quests.completionMessage: "I specialize in the subtle art of melee. Believe me, there is more to that skill than just swinging the biggest hammer. Press F1 and click STORE or type :BUY in the chat line to see my rack of weapons."

quests.title: Range Weapons
quests.completionMessage: "Hit things from a distance and you won"t get your clothes dirty. Press F1 and click STORE or type :BUY in the chat line to see my line of ranged weapons."

quests.description: "You are not sure what you quest for in this journey refered to as life... search your Shial and you will find the answers, for to seek Andradance is to seek wisdom..."
quests.completionMessage: "Andradance looks favorably upon you...   you begin to feel a sense of enlightenment... seek the inside of your mind next for you will find your next destination there..."
