quests.description: "You are not sure what you quest for in this journey refered to as life... search your Shial and you will find the answers, for to seek Andradance is to seek wisdom..."
quests.completionMessage: "Andradance looks favorably upon you...   you begin to feel a sense of enlightenment... seek the inside of your mind next for you will find your next destination there..."

quests.title: Andradance...
quests.description: "You have found wisdom, now seek out intellect."

quests.title: For joy is one of the keys to life...
quests.description: "You seem to posses some type of anger within you... become calm within and you shall find your answers..."
quests.completionMessage: "You become radiant with emotions as your become stronger...  Happiness is one of the keys to life... for your final test, seek out the giver of life in life..."

quests.title: Happiness...
quests.description: "You have found happiness, now seek out the giver of life."

quests.title: Do you seek out intellect?
quests.description: "To expand ones mind and understanding is to begin to know life as it is and not as it appears. You do not posses the intellect within to pass this..."
quests.completionMessage: "You become vibrant with emotion and understanding...   You posses the intellect of the elders... for your Shial guides you correctly through your journeys... remain in touch with this and happiness and you shall reach your ultimate destination..."

quests.title: Intellect...
quests.description: "You have found intellect, now seek out happiness."
quests.completionMessage: "You have found intellect, now seek out happiness."

quests.title: I seek the one with longevity...
quests.description: "For you do not posses the strength of the inner Shial... be on your way to seek it, or not...  Seek the eye..."
quests.completionMessage: "You have become overwhelmed with calm... You posses the spirt of the ancient warriors of Kanasta... To further prove your longevity, seek out Andradance. There you will find your answers.

quests.title: Longevity...
quests.description: "You have found longevity, now seek out wisdom."

quests.title: For those whom posses the Light...
quests.description: "You do not seem to have an appreciation for the giver of life... return once you do..."
quests.completionMessage: "You have harnessed the power of your inner Shial... for you carry the Light of Sol... I provide to you the key of the power you posses within... that this to continue your journey, but beware of what lurks ahead..."

quests.title: Giver of life...
quests.description: "You have found the giver of life, now seek out Shial."
quests.hint: You possess the giver of life...

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I am studying Pidions for the betterment of Amphibious kind."
quests.completionMessage: "So I guess you are the new guy. Let me see the egg... hmm, yes this is a very nice sample. Now I will need some samples from the Pidions in this cavern. They provide more potent DNA samples than the surface Pidions. I need you to collect me 10 Pidion embryos."  [More]

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 4 of 20
quests.description: "Not all of the Pidions in here are pregnant so it may take a little search and destroy to collect them all. When you have all 10, bring them back to me... and watch out for the Dark Jousters!"
quests.completionMessage: "I know that you are not very happy with having to perform such a task, but remember that this is for the greater good, plus don"t forget the Jouster family slaughtered many of our brothers and sisters just for a snack. Ok now let me do some quick tests. This is not good, my test results are inconclusive."  [More]

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 5 of 20
quests.description: "I will need you to take these samples in the incubator to Natur deep in the Catacombs. Some of these results are puzzling to me and Natur will be able to fill in the missing pieces. Please be quick and be very careful with these samples."
quests.completionMessage: "A new incubator, with a new egg? It is going to take a few days for this to hatch and I don"t want to wait that long. We can speed up the process if you can find a lava stone from the Rift Fire Cavern. Take this extractor and look throughout the cavern for the lava stones. Do you want to know how many I need?"  [More]
quests.hint: Find Natur deep in the Catacombs

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 11 of 20
quests.description: "I will need you to bring me back 3 of them so I can create the optimal environment. While you are gone I need to look into this spy thing he mentioned in his letter. It seems that there are some Bloblics that know about our experiments and don"t want us to be successful."
quests.completionMessage: "It took you long enough, the egg is pretty close to hatching already. Let me see the stones... wait, who is that over there? Did you bring someone with you?"  [More]

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "Oh no! It"s a Bloblic Spy! Get him while I protect the egg!"
quests.completionMessage: "Man, Natur wasn"t kidding! Those damn rogue Bloblics!! They can never just leave us alone. See, this is why we need to develop such things like this new breed that we are working on. If it wasn"t for that ilk we wouldn"t need to waste our time making weapons."  [More]

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 12 of 20
quests.description: "The eggs hatched prematurely in the chaos and the Blobs are sure to be near by now that they have located me. Here you must take the creature and I must go and hide. This will be the best thing for everyone. Take it to Kance in the Cave of Ancients. Search for our shroom hut in the depths of that evil place."
quests.hint: Find Kance in the Cave of Ancients

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "You must have obtained the Amphibious quest weapon called the Oafinster to be included in our research.  I apologize, but those are our conditions."
quests.completionMessage: "We are on the verge of creating a new breed of creature through embryo fusion. This research requires the study of the rarest eggs in all of IIA. By assisting us in our experiments you will reap the benefits of our research."  [More]

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 1 of 20
quests.description: "Bring us the following eggs for study; 10 different breeds of Dark eggs, 9 different breeds of Dominion eggs, and 1 Trisk Elite egg. Only then will we be able to continue with our research and development."
quests.completionMessage: "The new breed that we are working on is a cousin of the Oafinster. One of our bio-engineers has figured out how to mix the DNA of a Dilirium and a Pidion! Yes, I know that is very weird, but it will bring our people a new way to protect ourselves.  For your next task you must seek out Jojo."  [More]
quests.hint: Bring the 20 rare eggs to me

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 2 of 20
quests.description: "Jojo is over in the Solothic Caverns doing some research on the Diliriums. I want you to go and see how he is progressing in his research. Show him my special Gidion so he knows that I have sent you."
quests.completionMessage: "I think you"ve managed to deter the Bloblics for a while at least. You have put a stop to some of their most elite squads and I am sure that they are both baffled and amazed at what a single Amphibian such as you has been able to accomplish. I am afraid that there is still some tension in the air, though."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Jojo in the Solothic Caverens

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 17 of 20
quests.description: "Until the Oafronack is completely grown, we will not be able to turn our backs on the Bloblics. I just hope that we can all exist in harmony one day. You must now take the Infant Oafronack back to Jojo. He must see it through the next stages. Don"t worry, you will see me again very soon."
quests.completionMessage: "At last!! You have done very well my young warrior. If it wasn"t for you we would have not been able to introduce the Oafronack into our community. Let me see it... ok I have taken a DNA sample. This will go to Jojo, and this Oafronack is for you. It will be with you till the end... if there is ever an end."  [More]
quests.hint: Return to Jojo in the Solothic Caverens

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 20 of 20
quests.completionMessage: "Just make sure that you treat your Oafronack as it was a spawn of your own. Go on now and be on the look out for the Bloblics. I am sure that they will be after you. " [More]

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Complete
quests.description: "Remember that you can always come home for safety." [Complete]

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I am doing research on Diliriums here.  My studies should provide the Amphibious race with a new weapon. Maybe? Possibly? I still have a long ways to go before I will know for sure."
quests.completionMessage: "So Fulis has sent you to help with the research of the Oafronack? Let me take a look at you... hmmm ok. Yes I think you will do nicely. You will be my personal tracker and battle agent for the research that must be done. Before I send you on your first run, I want to test your battle skills."  [More]

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "I have just released a special Adult Dilirium in the Overking Geist lair. Go and bring me back the egg from this Adult Dilirium."
quests.completionMessage: "Very good! You passed the test. My Dilirium is pretty easy to deal with, but when you throw the Overking into the mix, things can get a little hairy. Ok, this is what I need you to do now; My partner Ciben is assisting in the research of the breeding of the Oafronack. I am dealing with the Diliriums and he is dealing with the Pidions."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat the Dilirium in Geist"s lair

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 3 of 20
quests.description: "Here is the first test egg for him. Ciben will need this for the first DNA mixture test with the Pidion. He is waiting for you in the Rift Fire Cave. That is just inside the entrance to the underworld. Do not lose this egg whatever you do."
quests.completionMessage: "It is so good to see you again! And look at the Oafronack. This is very good. The Oafronack is progressing nicely! It will soon be mature enough to be put into action. What we need to do now is ensure that the Oafronack has the right nutrients so that its madseno glands develop to a prime state."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Ciben in the Rift Fire Cave

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 18 of 20
quests.description: "A rare crosp is roaming Moon"s Rift as we speak. You must hurry and bring me the glands from this great creature. Beware though for this creature is one of immense power. Go now before Siinon disappears once again."
quests.completionMessage: "Let me see the glands. Yes this is very good...perfect. Yes yes, the Oafronack is just about ready now."  [More]
quests.hint: The Siinon can be found on Moon"s Rift

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 19 of 20
quests.description: "Take the Oafronack back to Fulis in this incubator. We have done it!! We now have a new member of our family that will protect us to the death, as we do for them. Send Fulis my regards."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Diliriums of all stages have no protection from water damage.  Amphibians, fortunately, have many weapons that do water damage."
quests.completionMessage: "What is wrong?  The Bloblics attacked you?  Don"t worry, you will be safe here. So let me see this creature that you carry...hmm... very interesting indeed. I have never seen a creature like this before... it looks very sick. If you are willing to hurry and pick up some items for me, I believe I can save the creature."  [More]

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 13 of 20
quests.description: "Quickly, this is what I need in order to save the creature; 5 Hyssop herbs, 10 Slingthrex twigs, and 5 Uenos roots. You can find these items at any reputable Magic store. I will also need one very special item - the Aether Gem. This is a very special but rare item that is carried by Datro, the most powerful foe I know of. It will not be an easy task. You must go beyond the end of the Catacombs and retrieve this gem.  Good luck!"
quests.completionMessage: "Great! Just in time too... Give me some time to doctor the creature up a bit. It is hurt pretty bad. While you were gone, some of my scounts warned me of a shadow squad roaming the area of Sluggith Island. I am afraid that it may be the Bloblics gathering for an all out attack."  [More]
quests.hint: Buy the herbs/hunt Datro for Aether Gem

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 14 of 20
quests.description: "They really want to stop the development of this creature. We Amphibians must stand together! Here take these to protect you while you hunt down the raiding Bloblics, who knows when they may strike next. May Crom be by your side!"
quests.completionMessage: "Your spirit burns bright right now. You have not only helped the creature and myself, but also the whole Amphibian community. I hope they did not give you too much trouble. What is this?...A Force Energizer? I must conduct some experiments on this."  [More]
quests.hint: Hunt down the raiding Bloblics on Sluggith

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 15 of 20
quests.description: "I am sure that they will be tracking you here after your success on Sluggith. I have some final ministrations to give to our "little one". While I am busy with this you must partol this area just in case any Bloblics managed to track you here. I should be ready in about 1 hour. May Crom bless our efforts!"
quests.completionMessage: "Those damn Bloblics!  Why can"t they just leave us in peace?!?  I am finished.  You must leave quickly now for your protection and for the survival of our most recent family member. If the Bloblics were to get a hold of this it would be a terrible disaster for us."  [More]
quests.hint: Patrol the area for Bloblic intruders

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 16 of 20
quests.description: "You must go back to Fulis. You will be safe there.  Tell him we must be swift with our progress for the barbarians lurk even closer now.  Go with the speed of Crom at your back."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "It is nice to meet you, but I am waiting for word from my friend Natur. Good day."
quests.completionMessage: "I knew that Natur would come through for me. He always does. Quickly, I need you to help rid this area of the beasts that have been haunting me! They are creatures much too powerful for me to handle on my own."  [More]

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 8 of 20
quests.description: "Skarshar raids are unpredictable, but when the next one happens I need to you to stop it! Bring me 6 arms and 6 heads as proof of your success. I am a very paranoid individual but will repay you greatly. Be careful now!"
quests.completionMessage: "You have done me a great favor! As I promised here is your reward for helping me make my life much better. It is not much, but I think they will help you along your path. They are protection against the Lagion race, better known to you as the Sarins."  [More]

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 9 of 20
quests.description: "I feel that there may soon be an uprising among the Sarin species. There are more sightings of them each day. Take this note back to Natur, and thank him for me. He is such a great friend."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Are you planning on growing something?"
quests.completionMessage: "Hmm an incubator... Ciben sent this?  The Oafinster was the first new breed that I created for our kind. We can make the Oafronack that much better utilizing portions of Pridion DNA. They possess great firepower."  [More]

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 6 of 20
quests.description: "Pridion is the mother of the Rune keepers. She possess some of the most concentrated power known to us.  Bring back the Air Rune and the Pridion Embryo from Pridion."
quests.completionMessage: "The incubator is running out of power. Let me see the items. I will use the Air Rune first to re-power the incubator. Done. Now let"s examine what else you brought. Excellent, this is a very potent sample, perfect for this experiment."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat Pridion, the Air Rune keeper

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 7 of 20
quests.description: "While I perform some more tests, I need you to go help out a friend of mine. His name is Lilist, and he can be found in the Amphibious Four Falls Village. Take my Gidion so he knows that I have sent you to help him."
quests.completionMessage: "So you return... was it as bad as he made it sound? Wow, yeah those Skarshars can be pretty nasty. Well while you were gone, I have progressed with the experiments on the samples. I am very close to completing the tests. Right now I will need you for the next stage of tests."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Lilist in Amphibious Four Falls Village

quests.title: Oafronack Quest: Part 10 of 20
quests.description: "I need you to take this incubator with new egg sample back to Ciben. It is very close to hatching and I need him to take a look at it in the beginning stages of its life."

quests.title: (BL) Polycycle - Normal
quests.description: "Ok, if you would like to upgrade to the Polycycle you will have to bring me the Hovercraft Schematic from Amblik. Please note that I cannot make use of a schematic once it has been entered into your Vehicle Warp Device. See you around."
quests.completionMessage: "Hey, you brought the Hovercraft Schematic! Alright, here is your new Normal channel Polycycle. I have to say that you are going to love this thing.  It is equipped with a jet booster and has 50% protection in all channel except for the Rune and Death channels, which has no protection in this model. This puppy is also equipped with a fusion beam weapon that requires no ammo. Have fun!!"

quests.title: (BL) Polycycle - Fire
quests.description: "Ok, if you would like to upgrade to the Fire Polycycle you will have to bring me the Normal Polycycle along with the Fire Rune."
quests.completionMessage: "Hey you found all of the items!  Alright, here is your new Fire Polycycle.  I have to say that you are going to love this thing.  It is equipped with a jet booster that will enable this puppy to fly, and the fusion beam does Fire damage. It also has 50% protection in Normal, Relic, Earth, and Air, and has 90% in the Fire channel. Unfortunately it has no Water, Rune, or Death protection."

quests.title: (BL) Polycycle - Water
quests.description: "Ok, if you would like to upgrade to the Water Polycycle you will have to bring me the Normal Polycycle along with the Water Rune."
quests.completionMessage: "Hey you found all of the items!  Alright, here is your new Water Polycycle.  I have to say that you are going to love this thing.  It is equipped with a jet booster, a fusion beam that does Water channel damage, and armor.  It has 50% protection in Normal, Fire, Earth, and Air, and has 90% in the Water channel.  Unfortunately it has no Relic, Rune, or Death protection."

quests.title: (BL) Polycycle - Earth
quests.description: "Ok, if you would like to upgrade to the Earth Polycycle you will have to bring me the Normal Polycycle along with the Earth Rune."
quests.completionMessage: "Hey you found all of the items!  Alright, here is your new Earth Polycycle.  I have to say that you are going to love this thing. It is equipped with a jet booster, a fusion beam that does Earth channel damage, and armor.  It has 50% protection in Normal, Fire, Water, and Relic, and has 90% in the Earth channel.  Unfortunately it has no Air, Rune, or Death protection."

quests.title: (BL) Polycycle - Air
quests.description: "Ok, if you would like to upgrade to the Air Polycycle you will have to bring me the Normal Polycycle along with the Air Rune."
quests.completionMessage: "Hey you found all of the items!  Alright, here is your new Air Polycycle.  I have to say that you are going to love this thing.  It is equipped with a jet booster that will allow you to fly, and fusion beam that does Air channel damage.  It also has 50% protection in Normal, Water, Earth, and Relic, and has 90% in the Air channel.  Unfortunately it has no Fire, Rune, or Death protection."

quests.title: (BL) Polycycle - Relic
quests.description: "Ok, if you would like to upgrade to the Relic Polycycle you will have to bring me the Normal Polycycle along with the blue stone rune and grey stone rune."
quests.completionMessage: "Hey you found all of the items!  Alright, here is your new Relic Polycycle.  I have to say that you are going to love this thing.  It is equipped with a jet booster that will give you a turbo boost, and fusion beam that does Relic channel damage.  It also has 50% protection in Normal, Fire, Water, and Air, along with 90% in Relic.  Unfortunately it has no Earth, Rune, or Death protection."

quests.title: (BL) Polycycle - Rune
quests.description: "Ok, if you would like to upgrade to the Rune Polycycle you will have to bring me the Normal Polycycle along with the Future, Living, and Tech Runes."
quests.completionMessage: "Hey you found all of the items!  Alright, here is your new Rune Polycycle.  I have to say that you are going to love this thing.  It is equipped with a jet booster, a fusion beam that does Rune damage, and armor.  It has 50% protection in Normal, Fire, Water, Relic, Earth, Air, and 100% in Rune. There is no Death protection though."

quests.completionMessage: "Hey, you brought the Hovercraft Schematic! Alright, here is your new Normal channel Polycycle. I have to say that you are going to love this thing.  It is equipped with a jet booster and has 50% protection in all channel except for the Rune and Death channels, which has no protection in this model. This puppy is also equipped with a fusion beam weapon that requires no ammo. Have fun!!"

It is equipped with a jet booster that will enable this puppy to fly, and the fusion beam does Fire damage. It also has 50% protection in Normal, Relic, Earth, and Air, and has 90% in the Fire channel. Unfortunately it has no Water, Rune, or Death protection."

quests.description: You do not have the proper extractor for this process. Please use Extractor 6 for Plants and Roots in order to complete this task.
quests.completionMessage: You have successfully extracted.

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Hello, how are you?  To hear any more than that, you"ll have to be a Bloblic."
quests.completionMessage: "If you want the Shrakken Blade, you must go through me.  Only I can grant you the key to obtain it, so my trials you must endure.  To complete each trial you must obtain a proving marble from the summoned creature.  When you complete all my trials, I will relinquish the location of the Shrakken Blade to you."  [More]

quests.title: Shrakken Blade: Part 1 of 7
quests.description: "First you must face the Insane Shockion.  You have 1 minute to defeat him."
quests.completionMessage: "The first is always the easiest."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat the Insane Shockion in 1 minute

quests.title: Shrakken Blade: Part 2 of 7
quests.description: "You have 2 minutes to defeat the Insane Jouster."
quests.completionMessage: "Not too bad so far, huh?"  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat the Insane Jouster in 2 minutes

quests.title: Shrakken Blade: Part 3 of 7
quests.description: "Have you ever played with an Insane Trisk?  You"ve got 2 minutes."
quests.completionMessage: "Hah! I"m just getting warmed up."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat the Insane Trisk in 2 minutes

quests.title: Shrakken Blade: Part 4 of 7
quests.description: "You have 2 minutes to defeat the Insane Elite Ascherion."
quests.completionMessage: "Looks like you"re working up a sweat."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat the Insane Elite Ascherion in 2 minutes

quests.title: Shrakken Blade: Part 5 of 7
quests.description: Run for your life! Otherwise you have 3 minutes to defeat the Insane Deathbot!"
quests.completionMessage: "Don"t quit now, it"s just getting interesting!"  [More]

quests.title: Shrakken Blade: Part 6 of 7
quests.description: "You have 8 minutes to defeat the Insane Agron."
quests.completionMessage: "I could go all day!"  [More]

quests.title: Shrakken Blade: Part 7 of 7
quests.description: "You have 10 minutes to defeat the Skarshar of the Underworld."
quests.completionMessage: "Well, pooh. That"s all I had. Here"s your key to the chest that holds the blade."  [More]
quests.hint: "Defeat the Skarshar of the Underworld in 10 minutes."

quests.title: Shrakken Blade: Complete
quests.description: "The legendary Shrakken Blade is located deep within the Black Market caves, in a maze of stone bricks. Many chests are there, but only one will open to this key. Now go, I wish you well."

quests.title: Trinster Quest: Swami Intro
quests.description: "I assist young tadpoles on their journies.  Those who"ve obtained the (AP) Stontrile -W."
quests.completionMessage: "If you seek the location of the lost Trinster, Swami B"ll can help you. Swami B"ll is all about helping little tadpoles. But you must prove your worth by defeating my creatures. Before you begin Swami B"ll will put upon you a whammy to make Swami B"ll"s creatures more challenging."  [More]

quests.title: Trinster Quest: Trial 1 of 7
quests.description: "Wooohhaaaaa Ooomlawampa, wickawampa, shoo poo poo! You will now fail because of the whammy I put on you. Wooohhaaaaa!  You are now ready tadpole. Defeat an Insane Shockion in 1 minute or Swami Bill will not let you move on."
quests.completionMessage: "Swami B"ll"s Opal marble.  I suspected that Insane Shockion had swallowed that."  [More]

quests.title: Trinster Quest: Trial 2 of 7
quests.description: "Next you must defeat the Insane Jouster within 2 minutes or YOU DIE.  Well, not die.  Swammi B"ll means... try again."
quests.completionMessage: "Swami B"ll"s Opaque Marble.  It"s not my favorite but it"s mine." [More]

quests.title: Trinster Quest: Trial 3 of 7
quests.description: "Now go and defeat the Insane Trisk within 2 minutes or else Swami B"ll will put another whammy on you."
quests.completionMessage: "Green, green, green like the blood of a Kidion Bat."  [More]

quests.title: Trinster Quest: Trial 4 of 7
quests.description: "Now stand up and face Swami B"ll"s Insane Elite Ascherion. You have 2 minutes."
quests.completionMessage: "Blood not like a Kidion Bat. It is pretty to B"ll."  [More]
quests.hint: "Defeat the Insane Elite Ascherion in 2 minutes."

quests.title: Trinster Quest: Trial 5 of 7
quests.description: "You have 3 minutes to defeat the Insane Deathbot or speak to Swami B"ll no more."
quests.completionMessage: "This one was crafted for B"ll from Clegurk droppings.  Smell that aroma."  [More]

quests.title: Trinster Quest: Trial 6 of 7
quests.description: "Arrghh... 8 minutes, Insane Agron. Now go before Swami B"ll gets angry with your success."
quests.completionMessage: "B"ll shouldn"t give you more time.  You should get less, but B"ll"s marbles must be returned."  [More]

quests.title: Trinster Quest: Trial 7 of 7
quests.description: "Defeat the Skarshar of the Underworld in 10 minutes or else begin from scratch."
quests.completionMessage: "Swami B"ll forgets why he is so angry with you, for all his marble are returned."  [More]
quests.hint: "Defeat the Skarshar of the Underworld in 10 minutes."

quests.title: End
quests.description: "Instead of more enemies Swami B"ll now Gives you a key to the chest of the lost Trinster."

quests.title: Extracting Minerals
quests.completionMessage: "Mineral extraction is a specialty of mine. Get it? MINE?? Heh heh... sorry. Mining minerals is accomplished by the use of high-tech extractors. No more of that pounding rock with picks and shovels! Simply examine the mineral with the extractor in your inventory and you will obtain a sample of the mineral. That is, IF you have the proper extractor. Minerals are an essential part of industry in this realm. They are usually found in tunnels and caves with the occasional stray variety on higher ground. I will give you your first Extractor for free. But if you want to obtain more advanced extractors, you will need to do something for me." [More]

quests.title: 1. Extractor 1
quests.description: "To obtain your next extractor you must bring me 10 samples each from the following minerals: Talpite, Golan Crystal, Varlenite, Orgate, Azagate and Fripe Shale. This is really pretty simple, I"m sure even YOU can do it."
quests.completionMessage: "Well done! Here is your next extractor which will allow you to extract even more valuable minerals. If you would like to have an even better extractor, listen to what I am about to say." [More]
quests.hint: Find and extract the correct minerals

quests.title: 2. Extractor 2
quests.description: "To obtain the next model extractor you will need to bring back 20 samples of the following minerals: Odion Gem, Evangosilt, Puron, Lafe Stone, Zin Clad, Wisnox, and Orthonite. You will not find these nearby, they are scattered throughout the world, some in dangerous places. Be careful."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent! I knew you would find everything. You are doing well. If you are ready to do a little more work for the next extractor, prepare yourself and listen carefully." [More]

quests.title: 3. Extractor 3
quests.description: "To obtain your next extractor, you must collect 30 samples of each of the following rare minerals: Mool Stone, Quartz, Lyzantate, Naggite, Rocap Ore, and Zancon. You should find them scattered about the world in dangerous places."
quests.completionMessage: "You have done very well! You should now consider yourself an accomplished miner. Here is the most advanced mineral extractor I have. There are other minerals I have not mentioned to you that have value. Your complete extractor collection should allow you to mine them all. All that is, except for some very rare ores..." [More]

quests.title: 4. Lava Stone Extractor
quests.description: "I have a special extractor that will only extract Lava Stones, a rare volcanic ore that can be used for specialized items. I can give this extractor to you, but in exchange you will have to collect some rare stones for me. I require 5 Water Stones, an Elder Meeting Stone, and the Blue Stone Rune."
quests.completionMessage: "You have proven to be a most excellent resource for me! As a reward for bringing me these fine stones, I will give you the Lava Stone Extractor. I hear these stones are only found in the Underworld, so take care when you seek them." [More]

quests.title: Complete
quests.description: "You have completed all of the extractor quests known to Iia." [Complete]

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I"m on the look out for a Plasma Net Compressor."
quests.completionMessage: "The Plasma Net Compressor!!  That is the missing component!!  Where did you get that!?  Never mind that, hand it to me before I mop the floor with your corpse!  I have been looking for this for a very long time."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest:
quests.description: "I find Eans attractive."
quests.completionMessage: "Now that you have given it to me it is mine... unless you can beat me at my game, which you won"t.  You must find my four boys and take them out. You will soon learn that my boys are nothing to be laughed at.  Wanna hint on where to start?"  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 6 of 22
quests.description: "Ok here it is. You know where Shaderix is, right? Well right now my lead man Kutt is there paying him a visit, but he won"t be there for long. The other three of my boys also hang out there sometimes. If you"re lucky, you will see all of them there at the same time -- just before they kill you! Take out all four of my boys and bring me everything they carry if you want my respect. Good luck to you... you"re gonna need it! Muhuhahaha!!"
quests.completionMessage: "How could my boys let me down? How could this happen? I"m very sorry... I didn"t mean anything of it! I swear! Please don’t kill me... I"ll do anything... just don"t hurt me. Here! Take this, just spare my life, Please! I swear it won"t happen again!  What do you want from me?"  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Hint
quests.completionMessage: "Oh, I guess I can tell you where the chests are hidden.  You got a pencil.  I"m only going to say each clue once."  [More]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Hint #1
quests.completionMessage: "The 1st chest is located near Bloblic Island around shores in water."  [More when ready]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Hint #2
quests.completionMessage: "The 2nd chest is in the Cave of Ancients, seek the passage behind a skull."  [More when ready]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Hint #3
quests.completionMessage: "The 3rd is inside the Black Market.  Locate the Dark Ilias egg and you shall find the chest."  [More when ready]

quests.title: Netlauncher Quest: Part 7 of 22
quests.description: "That"s all I know.  Blame DarkDeathRAP if I"m lying.  Now all you have to do is just go and get them all.  So there"s no need to kill me.  Good luck, I hope you get ambushed trying to find them."

quests.title: Intro
quests.completionMessage: "Who disturbs my meditation, as a pebble disturbs the still water of a pond? I am Strife, the leader of Amphibians on this world. We try to live a peaceful life in communion with nature and to ensure this I must maintain a group of peace keepers skilled in the art of combat, magic and stealth in order to protect our interests."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "As you complete each task I give you, I will reward you by replacing your Gidion with a new one. A Gidion is a status symbol within the Amphibious community, and you may display them honorably.  An armed Gidion will enhance your Strength and Dexterity but hinder the gaining of these attributes while it is armed. The first task will require that you kill flobs."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 1 of 23
quests.description: "The Flob is a small creature that curls itself up and rolls on the ground. They will defend themselves by drawing close to their attacker and using their sharp shell edges as a weapon. Please retrieve for me 10 Flob shells. While you are out, try typing in :REBIRTH. I will explain what it does later, if you don"t figure it out."
quests.completionMessage: "Did you pay close attention to them, young learner? Did you notice their pattern of movement, and the range at which they were able to harm you?  Here is your first Gidion. To make things easier on yourself you should train to be able to wear level 2 armor (Sondron) before you attempt my next task."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 2 of 23
quests.description: "You must work toward mastering Mind Control.  For your next task young one, you must go and train with the Clegurks.  You can find them in the caverns in this island.  Go now and make sure you bring back 10 Clegurk tongues."
quests.completionMessage: "You have mastered the creatures I sent you against. I am granting you a boon of 1000 credits to help you stay equipped, as well as your second Gidion."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 3 of 23
quests.description: "It is written that through patience a ruler can be persuaded, and a gentle tongue can break a bone. Learn this lesson of patience well, for I require you to bring me 10 Infant Stount tails in order to advance. These creatures can be found here on this island."
quests.completionMessage: "You return successful young one.  I must say that I am most pleased with your progression. Did you know that if you consume (USE) the tail of the infant stount, or any other meat from a creature, that it will replenish a portion of your health?  Here is your next Gidion, plus a ration of credits for your efforts."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 4 of 23
quests.description: "Now for your next task young one.  To continue your training I desire that you seek out the larger rollers of the realm - the Vigons.  Gather 10 of their shells for me.  Oh, and in regards to the :REBIRTH - you can perform a :REBIRTH while in a safe zone to bind your re-spawn point to the exact location where you stand. Good luck."
quests.completionMessage: "Welcome back young one.  The teacher opens the door, but you must enter by yourself. I am pleased with the initiative you have shown thus far, and I will reward you with your next Gidion as well as a cache of credits to help keep you supplied. You are worth my investment, young learner."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 5 of 23
quests.description: "The living oozes of Blods are easy to manuever around, for they move not at all. The Plasmas are what you are seeking.  Bring me 10 plasmas from both the Faduns and Didons.  Find them in the Solothic Caves or the Trendor Sewers.  Make sure you make use of the ":REBIRTH" command before trecking out too far."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent work! Here is your next Gidion. Continue on this path, and you will be one of my most accomplished students.  At this time you may want to consider upgrading your weapons and armors from the store.  Make sure to check the level and stat requirements before purchasing."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 6 of 23
quests.description: "A dual lesson, this one is.  You must seek out your next adversaries in both the water and the air.  Gather 10 shells from the Stontriles.  I also require that you hunt the Malia Bat and bring me back 10 of their wings. Good luck."
quests.completionMessage: "You have done very well young one.  You have earned your next Gidion. I am also blessing you with some of my Mind Control knowledge.  Go and rest now, but before you return for your next mission I will require you to have reached level 5 of Mind Control skill. And remember that extra training will never hurt."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "If you happen to reach level 6 of your Mind Control skill, this will enable you to make use of the Clawjous - one of the more effective Amphibious weapons.  Also remember that as you advance you will want to obtain more protection.  Seek out blacksmiths for new protections.  If need be, arm your Gidion to give yourself a stat boost."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 7 of 23
quests.description: "I hope that you are well rested young one.  You next mission is to venture forth into the Solothic Caves.  Go and hunt the poisonous Ascherion spiders.  They will be our bane if left unchecked.  Hunt down 10 of these beasts and bring me back their venomous sacks.
quests.completionMessage: "You return, and unscathed - this is a very good sign of your continued excellent skill growth.  Here is your next Gidion, plus a large sum of bonus credits.  Use them prudently.  A wise being once said, that it is better to save for a rainy day then to waste everything on the here and now."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 8 of 23
quests.description: "Go hunt down Shockions and Adult Shockions on Sluggith Island and bring back 10 Shockion Claws and 10 Adult Shockion Claws. Like the Ascherions, the Shockions are becoming a bane to our existence.  Beware of these creatures.  Be swift on your feet and in the air."
quests.completionMessage: "Welcome back young one.  I hope these creatures did not heat up your temper or your skin.  You have done very well.  Here is your next Gidion and an additional credit ration."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 9 of 23
quests.description: "Back to Moons Rift where the Shockions can be found.  You must bring me 10 Elite Shockion Heads, and 5 Elder Shockion Heads.
quests.completionMessage: "Again, you have done very welll young one.  Here is your next Gidion. You should go and see Swami Bill on Sluggith Island about your Trinster Weapon sometime soon. It will be of great help in completing your training. Also, search this valley for the hut of the Shape Shifter and speak to him about his art."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "Now is the time for you to consider embarking upon the ancient Rune quest.  This is a quest that will not only test your might, perseverance, and wit, but it will also end in my rewarding you with one of our peoples" most prized possessions - the Tristnarak.  This is the ancient Rune weapon of our ancestors."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 10 of 23
quests.description: "I have a somewhat different task for you. Our people prize the old Tanzanite gems, which we use to train different creatures into weapons of ours through Mind Control.  Lately the large Clegorns have been devouring all of these crystals.  I need you to hunt down the Clegorns until you retrieve 5 Tanzanite gems.  Beware of their mighty tongues."
quests.completionMessage: "Your people thank you for this!  Altogether we must continue to replenish our stockpile of these gems.  Well I hope that you have been training hard young one, for my tasks are going to be much more difficult from this point on.  Before we move on I suggest that you become equipped with Langdrion armor."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 11 of 23
quests.description: "Now for a truely tough mission - You are to defeat one of the great Braun beasts that goes by the name of Jouster. Go to Death Vally and you will find a small group of Jousters.  These Braun creatures have stolen a great artifact of our people - the Sphere of Akries.  Hunt them down until you locate this."
quests.completionMessage: "Wonderful!  You have done your people another great justice.  They will one day croak songs in your name.  Here is your next Gidion.  I just received word from a scout of mine in the field.  I believe that for your next mission I will be sending you after one of our own."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 12 of 23
quests.description: "Brother Crea has rebelled against us and is carrying vital information about our forces to sell to the highest bidder. He must be relieved of this information which he carries on his person in the form of a memory gem. You will find him on Sluggith Island. He keeps ugly company.  Go quickly before he rids himself of this valuable object."
quests.completionMessage: "There is a lesson to be learned from Crea. No one can serve two masters.  Here is your next Gidion. I will require you to have achieved at least the tenth level of Mind Control to continue.  Times are turbulent young one."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 13 of 23
quests.description: "You must obtain your Morgion Emblem from Oscylop in Fire Town. Once you have it, venture into the Catacombs and locate the Rancons.  Our people are attempting to learn more of these ancient beings and obtaining a Rancon emblem will help us immensely in this venture.  Good luck and remember to :REBIRTH in Fire Town."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you. You have done exceedingly well.  This will help our people in learning more of these ancient ones.  Here is your next Gidion, and a little bonus for your service to your people."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 14 of 23
quests.description: "This task will be very difficult. You must get me a sample of Eyezora DNA. It is very rare and you will need to kill many Eyezoras to find the ones who carry it.  As a part of our constant drive to learn more about the beings in these realms we must continue our research.  Search the Catacombs and CoA for these ghostly creatures."
quests.completionMessage: "Again you triumph. You are my most dependable warrior. Here is your next Gidion. Now would be a good time to work towards your Tristnarak if you haven"t already."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 15 of 23
quests.description: "Quickly, there is no time to lose. You must find my friend Silian who is lost in the Cave of the Ancients. You must have your Hudion Emblem to enter that dark place. Find him and assist him, and bring me back his Gidion to prove yourself."
quests.completionMessage: "It is good to hear that you were able to assist Silian. I"m sure he will be able to find his way out now. Here is your next Gidion.  Next will be your final task.  Take a breath and soak it in."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 19 of 23
quests.description: "Find my Commander in Chief, General Jin, in the Four Falls Temple. He will give you your final assignment. May your success be complete.  On completion of his tasks, bring me back his badge of approval and I will reward you with your final Gidion.  Good luck."
quests.completionMessage: "This is indeed a day of good tidings. You have completed all my tasks.  In return for your selfless actions on the behalf of your fellow amphibians, I am pleased to bestow upon you our highest honor, Gidion 16."  [More]
quests.hint: "Find General Jin and complete his tasks."

quests.title: Strife Quest: Complete
quests.description: "You have been very valuable to me. Go now, and represent me well in your journeys."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Only those who possess the 14th Gidion can help me..."
quests.completionMessage: "Help! I am caught between all these Grisions and Wrights! Please help me escape by scaring them. Of course they can be scared!! I will tell you how to do it if you listen for a moment."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 16 of 23
quests.description: "Now pay attention. Kill the Grisions until you obtain three Grision Badges. These grisions won"t be bothered by you killing them, but killing the ones in the level 14 dungeon will give these ones something else to think about than eating me. After you get three badges, bring them to me."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent! Now for the Wrights.  That"s right, the Wrights!"  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 17 of 23
quests.description: "The same holds true for the Wrights, except you only need to get one of their badges before they will stop coming after me. Kill the Wrights around me until you get one of their badges. After you get it, please return it to me and you can go."
quests.completionMessage: "Take this back to Strife, and thank you for helping me!"

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 18 of 23
quests.description: "Get back to Strife asap!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I am sorry but I only speak to those Amphibians that carry the 15th Gidion."
quests.completionMessage: "This is your final test for Strife, and I am not going to make it easy just because it has been a long time coming.  You will need this Gidion if you want to start your Oafronack Quest, as well as some other new Quests.  Anyway, here is what I need."  [More]

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 20 of 23
quests.description: "I need the Elder Eye. Don"t ask me where to find it, all I know is that the Elder Shockions have been passing it amongst themselves after stealing it from Celeste. We need it for research - and then we will return it. Good luck."
quests.completionMessage: "Very good!  Strife has trained you well.  There"s more that I need. No time to rest."  [More]
quests.hint: Hunt Elder Shockions for the Elder Eye

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 21 of 23
quests.description: "Again the Eyezora creatures have come under our scrutiny. This time you will need to hunt them for a lost item.  I recieved word from one of our scouts that the Eyezoras have found one of our precious stones. Hunt them down to find the stone.  If they will not give it to you, you will have to take it."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent!  Strife will be most pleased with this. This Stone has been lost for quite some time and we began to lose hope that we would ever find it again.  Well at least I did. Strife knew that someone would recover it one day. What an optimist."  [More]
quests.hint: Eyezoras have recovered the Lost Stone

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 22 of 23
quests.description: "For your last mission I require that you recover a gem that belongs to Strife.  It was stolen at a birthday party that we were holding for him eons ago.  I know that he does not speak of it these days, but at the same time I know that his heart still longs for it.  Word is that the Wrights are the culprits, but you will have to find that out for sure."
quests.completionMessage: "I do not know what to say other than excellent work.  You are the most resourceful Amphibian that I have encountered in a very long time.  Now I see what Strife has seen in you from the beginning.  Take this back to Strife.  He will know that you have done well."

quests.title: Strife Quest: Part 23 of 23
quests.description: "Go now and finally complete what you have been striving towards."

quests.title: Tigon Armor
quests.description: "If I am to Smith this level armor, you will need to bring me several special items. I require 5 Infant Diliriums and 2 Vigon Shells. When you have these, I will reward you with a piece of Tigon Armor. It will be random - whatever I have available at the moment - so you may have to do the quest more than 4 times to get the full set."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent, here is a piece from my inventory at the moment."
quests.hint: You will get one of four pieces each time

quests.title: Cadon Armor
quests.description: "If I am to Smith this level armor, you will need to bring me several special items. I require 5 Adult Dilirium Tails and 5 Vigon Shells.  When you have these, I will reward you with a piece of Cadon Armor. It will be random - whatever I have available at the moment - so you may have to do the quest more than 4 times to get the full set."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent, here is a piece from my inventory at the moment."
quests.hint: You will get one of four pieces each time

quests.title: Soulton Armor
quests.description: "If I am to Smith this level armor, you will need to bring me several special items. I require 5 Shockion Claws and 3 Adult Shockion Claws.  When you have these, I will reward you with a piece of Soulton Armor. It will be random - whatever I have available at the moment - so you may have to do the quest more than 4 times to get the full set."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent, here is a piece from my inventory at the moment."
quests.hint: You will get one of four pieces each time

quests.title: Langdrion Armor
quests.description: "If I am to Smith this level armor, you will need to bring me several special items. I require 7 Kidion Bats.  When you have these, I will reward you with a piece of Langdrion Armor. It will be random - whatever I have available at the moment - so you may have to do the quest more than 4 times to get the full set."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent, here is a piece from my inventory at the moment."
quests.hint: You will get one of four pieces each time

quests.title: Rampion Armor
quests.description: "If I am to Smith this level armor, you will need to bring me several special items. I require 1 Mad Kidion Heart.  When you have this, I will reward you with a piece of Rampion Armor. It will be random - whatever I have available at the moment - so you may have to do the quest more than 4 times to get the full set.".
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent, here is a piece from my inventory at the moment."
quests.hint: You will get one of four pieces each time

quests.title: Puron Armor
quests.completionMessage: "You will have to see the mischievous Glagrog. He is located in the Arilious Mining Caves near the Trisk Hive. Consult your map if you are unsure. This level of armor will be your first non-drop set -- it is beyond my skill to make. Good luck!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "If you have not gone through Strife"s trials, believe me, you are nowhere near ready to attempt this."
quests.completionMessage: "I am Strod, your guide to the runes of IIA. The keepers of the runes are unique creatures unlike any other on IIA.  Most of them are trapped in their own realms seperate from the main world and the only way to reach them is through a Crystal Portal. In this manner the main world is protected from their wrath."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "A key is required to enter each portal.  I will be giving them to you one at a time.  Here is an Amulet of Rune Protection that will give you added protection against each of there Rune Bosses. Arm it when you are in their presence."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 1 of 10
quests.description: "Your first assignment will not involve keys or portals, for Lord Shraderix has been trapped not in his own realm but in the Black Market Cavern. You must bring me the Living Rune that Lord Shraderix carries."
quests.completionMessage: "You defeated Lord Shraderix?  You may very well be cut out for this sort of quest.  The key you hold is to Lord Shipron"s crystal and will let you enter his lair. The Crystal portal is located on the south end of Sluggith Island."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat Shraderix in the Black Market Cavern

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 2 of 10
quests.description: "Remember to arm your amulet when you are in his presence. If you do not return with the Earth Rune from Lord Shipron, you won"t get to move on. It"s just that simple."
quests.completionMessage: "I see that you"ve managed to defeat Lord Shipron. His realm is only the first you must conquor. Here is your next rune key.  It will give you access to Frube"s realm."  [More]
quests.hint: Shipron"s portal is on Sluggith Island

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 3 of 10
quests.description: "Frube"s lair is on the Root of Oracle. Just remember...She"s just a big puppy dog.  Go easy on him.  He will drop the Bio Rune."
quests.completionMessage: "Like I said, big puppy dog. Here is your next rune key."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat Frube in the Root of Oracle

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 4 of 10
quests.description: "Now you must seek the Water Rune and return with it.  Zorphion resides in the ocean west of the Arilious Mines near the Trisk Hive."
quests.completionMessage: "You"re always guaranteed to get wet with Zorphion.  Here is your next rune key."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat Zorphion in Western most Ocean

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 5 of 10
quests.description: "You will need to find the keeper of the Fire Rune next, and bring your objective back to me. Skelcy is on the highest hill on the southern part of Black Market Island."
quests.completionMessage: "You are wiping the floor with these so-called Rune "Bosses". Here is your next rune key."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat Skelcy on Black Market Island

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 6 of 10
quests.description: "Find the keeper of the Tech Rune, and tear the rune from his feeble grasp. Then step over his lifeless corpse as you leave.  You will find the Destroyer"s portal in the Petrified Forest."
quests.completionMessage: "Very good.  You are doing quite well."  [More]
quests.hint: Destroyer"s portal is on Petrified Island

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 7 of 10
quests.description: "You must now find the Grey Stone Rune and dispose of its keeper. Slate. You will find his crystal on top a high peak of Sail Island. There are two crystals on that island, each one leading to a different Rune Boss.  This key will only grant you entrance into Slate"s lair."
quests.completionMessage: "Again, you are doing wonderfully."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Slate"s portal on Sial Island

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 8 of 10
quests.description: "You now must seek the Blue Stone Rune.  This key will give you entrance to the other Peak on Sial Island, the entrance to Brike"s lair."
quests.completionMessage: "You should know that Brike and Slate were both once peaceful brothers who were cursed by the Supreme High Priest of Crom."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Brike"s portal on Sial Island

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 9 of 10
quests.description: "The entrance to Zeth"s domain is on Unity Outpost. What makes him difficult is his lair. You"ll need to figure out a way to kill him while he"s over a solid surface, or else you will lose his body and the Future Rune."
quests.completionMessage: "Here is the next and final rune key."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 10 of 10
quests.description: "This is it! The final rune boss, Pridion. I almost wish there were a few more just so I could watch your dominance continue. Pridion"s Portal Crystal is on the south tip of Moon"s Rift Island."
quests.completionMessage: "You make me wish I was still training."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Complete
quests.description: "I am glad to have been your guide. You have earned our rune weapon, the Tristnarak."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I"m sure that your race leader would be more than happy to talk with you."
quests.completionMessage: "All Hail Ataeus! I am your great leader Bo, and you will become a fierce warrior under my instruction. Only the strongest Bloblic warriors will be permitted to fight in the Great War beside the fearsome Ataeus -- the strongest Bloblic ever to draw breath. This realm will challenge you, young master."  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "Make no mistake about it, we are at war, and we are a warrior race. I will teach you to become a master of ranged and melee weaponry, among other things.  General Thorsan is my Commander at Arms.  You will become very familiar with him.  He is tasked with the distribution of armor.  See him when necessary."  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "I will give you a series of tasks to complete for me with the reward being 1 of 16 badges. Arming badges will enhance your strength and dexterity in combat but will hinder the raising of these same attributes through training.  Only wear them when neccessary in battle, not during training."  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 1 of 20
quests.description: "For your first badge, I need you to get me 10 Flob Shells and 1 Agate.  Agates periodically drop off Flobs.  Look outside these colonies for them.  While you are out try typing in :REBIRTH.  Perfoming this command in a safe zone will rebind your re-spawn point to that exact point that you executed the command.  Use this wisely."
quests.completionMessage: "Wonderful! I love these, they are so crunchy!! They go great with a good pale ale!  Here is your first badge. You should know that you can arm any of my badges for a small stat boost which will give you greater health and may enable you to wear the next level armor."  [More]
quests.hint: Hunt for 10 Flobs Shells and 1 Agate

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 2 of 20
quests.description: "Your second task is to bring me 10 Clegurk tongues. Hunt them down and bring me back their remains.  You can find them inside the cave just outside these buildings. Ignore the warning sign outside, you will be fine.  Remember, we are a warrior race, so train hard.  I will have no slackers in my army!"
quests.completionMessage: "Good work.  Here is Badge 2.  Remain steadfast if you want to progress.  Soon every creature in this valley will run for cover when you leave a building.  Here are some credits for you to assist in your training."  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 3 of 20
quests.description: "Your third task is to bring me 10 Infant Stount tails. This is the first creature that you will encounter that will fire back upon you.  I expect a slaughter of epic proportions, so don"t give me any less.  Find these creatures near a tree northeast of here."
quests.completionMessage: "Nice tails.  Here is your next badge and some additional credits for your effort.  There is something that you should know of these creatures and some others.  You can consume the meats of certain beings or health.  Just use it like a health potion.  The stronger the beast the better the heal.  Learn this well!"  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 4 of 20
quests.description: "Do not train with your badge armed! This time I am going to need 10 Vigon Shells. You heard me right!  10 Vigon Shells. I"m sure you have seen them wandering around, they look like gigantic flobs!"
quests.completionMessage: "Here is your next badge and some credits for your training."  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 5 of 20
quests.description: "Your next mission is to hunt down some semi-intelligent goop - Faduns and Didons. Finding these creatures will require you get your hands dirty. You need to travel to trendor city, and enter the filth that is their sewers. The best way to get there may be to take a traveler, but it would be costly. Any way you take, just bring me 10 of each of their plasmas. Now GO!!"
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent! I understand plasmas are good for the heart! But they taste terrible! Here is your next badge and bonus credits. You better be at least Weapon Tech level 4 when you get back from the next task. If you"re not there yet, try training on the clegorn in the cave near here."  [More]
quests.hint: Seek out Faduns and Didons in the sewers

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 6 of 20
quests.description: "Your next opponents will be Stontriles and Malia Bats.  The Malia Bats are the great green beasts that circle the colonies, while the Stontrile can be found in the cave waters.  Be careful not to get yourself stuck in the waters fighting.  We Blobs are not the swiftest of swimmers.  I want 10 Stontrile shells and 10 Malia Bat wings."
quests.completionMessage: "Here is your next badge and some credits. Here"s a little insight for the future - Familiars are as useful as useful gets. Find time to look into them later."  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "Others adept in the skill of smithing and can make most of the armors beyond what the store sells. So if you have the stats to wear better armor than you have now, try to find someone who can make them. Remember that you can arm your Crests to gain extra stat bonuses."  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 7 of 20
quests.description: "Alright, I hope you are suited up well.  Your next mission is to venture forth to the east to Root of Oracle and hunt down the Ascherions.  I recieved word from the others that they are spawning in great numbers and need to be put in their place.  No one better than a Blob to do that.  Eliminate 10 of them and bring me back their sacks!"
quests.completionMessage: "Ahh very good!  I hope you kicked some major butt in there.  You know, you don"t have to just kill the ones I need.  You should get extras so you can sell their loot back to the store for credits.  Anyhow, good work!  Here is your next Badge and some credits.  We"ll make a warrior out of you yet!!"  [More]
quests.hint: Hunt 10 Ascherions on Root of Oracle beach

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 8 of 20
quests.description: "Again, others are in need of some big guns.  These slimy little Shockions seem to be getting out of hand again.  They have tried to take over the town before, but we put them in check in the past.  I guess they didn"t learn their lesson.  You need to kill me 10 Shockions and 10 Adult Shockions.  Search Root of Oracle for these pests."
quests.completionMessage: "I could hear your blasts from here!  It almost brought a tear to my eye... NOT!!  HAHA!!  Here is your next badge. Return when you are ready for your next challenge.  If you are not going to continue immediately, I suggest you go train!!  Bloblics must always be training!!"  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 9 of 20
quests.description: "I need you to bring me 10 Elite and 5 Elder Shockions heads. These little buggers obviously didn"t learn their lesson when you took out their young. You can find them on the Moons Rift island, Black Market Island, or inside Black Market. I seriously suggest that you arm your latest badge for this mission."
quests.completionMessage: "Very good!  I would have liked to see the look on their faces when you went flying in there.  Here is your next badge. I strongly suggest you do the quest for your Nordic Armor.  Seek out Glagrog in the Arilous Mining caves.  Your strength is vital for wearing armor, so get to training.  Here is 7,000 credits. Make sure you equip yourself."  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "There is a wise Bloblic Warrior, his name is Crod.  He can teach you about the Rune Bosses of this planet.  He will also train you and let you start the quest for your Rune Gun, the Pulse Master.  He should be around here somewhere, look for him."  [More]
quests.hint: When you are ready, talk to Crod

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 10 of 20
quests.description: "Time for your first really tough mission from home.  For our research I need you to hunt down Dark Jousters.  You can find them in Black Market.  I need you to go collect 5 of their RNA.  Since you are going to be so far from home, make sure to :REBIRTH before leaving protected areas., and make good use of your vault."
quests.completionMessage: "You have come a long way from the noob that you were. Here is your next badge and a hefty credit bonus. I am also letting you keep your Bo Badge 9. It has use beyond my training, so do not lose it."  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 11 of 20
quests.description: "Sarins, by the brow of Ataeus... we have Sarin infestations sometimes. They are everywhere. Ruins my whole morning just thinking about how I can"t hunt them anymore, but you are a different story. Bring me 10 of their hearts. You will find them in the Black Market caves."
quests.completionMessage: "Thump, thump... Very nice!  I like it when they do that.  Do you have your Rune Gun yet?  Keep working on it.  You will need it soon.  Here is your next badge.  You must have heard by now about the underworld.  It is a savage, violent place only accessible by those with their Nordic Emblem.  You will be going there very soon."   [More]
quests.hint: Hunt Sarins in the Black Market cave

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 12 of 20
quests.description: "I just recieved word that the Amphibians are having trouble with one of their own.  Apparently this little spy named Crea has gone rogue and stolen some special artifact.  I want to know what it is.  Track him down on Sluggith Island and bring what he has to me.  Don"t go lightly on him.  Now go, before he disappears for good!!"
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent! He paid the price for attacking you, and that is as it should be. Here is your next badge. Next you will need to obtain the Cyclopean Emblem.  Only those with the Cyclopean Emblem may enter the Catacombs of the Underworld."  [More]
quests.hint: Track down Crea on Sluggith Island

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 13 of 20
quests.description: "You must seek out Ocsylop in the Underworld and complete his Armor Quest to obtain the Cyclopean Emblem.  From there you must enter the Catacombs and hunt Rancons until you receive the Rancon Emblem.  I want to have this Emblem.  It may help us in our future ventures."
quests.completionMessage: "Ahhh, the Rancon Emblem.  Our ancestors say that it harnesses a great ancient power.  Now, where is the darn power switch?!? Hmph. Well, I will find it later.  Here"s your next badge.  You can keep the previous one like you did with Badge 9."  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 14 of 20
quests.description: "Back into the Catacombs for you. This time you are hunting for a total of 10 Eyezora DNA.  Be careful around Eyezoras, for they can see you through walls, and they do Rune damage.  That means their only true weakness is in the Death and Rune channels."
quests.completionMessage: "Well done. That"s enough DNA.  Here is the badge you have earned.  The next two badges will be your toughest challenges yet. But let"s not get ahead of ourselves. First we must test your resourcefulness.  You will have to travel to the Cave of Ancients for this next task."  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 15 of 20
quests.description: "Ego is lost in the Cave of the Ancients in the Underworld, most likely somewhere deep in a tunnel.  He is usually guarding one of the portals.  That boy gets lost more than my hoverbike keys.  Find his dumbass and help him out.  Beware of what lurks in the dark in CoA.  There are many ancient evils that hunger for your soul."
quests.completionMessage: "Great, you found him!  No respect for the cause although he is very loyal.  Loyal as long as he is very liquored up.  Not a good trait.  Your training is nearly complete. Only two steps remain."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Ego in the Cave of Ancients

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 18 of 20
quests.description: "A Bloblic by the name of Manic waits for you in a set of Ancient Ruins with an underground tunnel system somewhere in the region of Four Falls. You will know you are in the right place by the various statues. The only way to reach him is by use of the Bo Emblem.  That is all I can tell you.  He will provide you with your last task from me."
quests.completionMessage: "The Flob Token!  You are finished!  Made you nervous didn"t it?  Here"s your last Badge."  [More]
quests.hint: Most ruins require certain emblems to enter

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Complete
quests.description: "Yep that"s all I have. Wasn"t it fun?"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I will not speak to you without proof from Bo. I am not lost. I am not."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you, O most triumphant messenger of Bloblic kind! Maybe you can help me.  I see you carry the 14th Badge which only comes from the hand of Bo.  What a great hero he is. He told me so himself. Over and over and over and..."  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 16 of 20
quests.description: "Anyway, I need help to get away from these High Priests, they are keeping me from leaving...and I may be a bit...uh... too inebriated to fly straight right now... It doesn"t help with them shooting at me. Please kill these High Priests until you get me a High Priest Robe, By then I should be okay enough to leave."
quests.completionMessage: "You rock! I so needed this. Here, let me give you something to prove you helped me. Got some old gum... here"s a movie stub... what"s this wadded up piece of paper?" [More]
quests.hint: Find a High Priest Robe for Ego

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 17 of 20
quests.description: "Ah, this will do. Take this old piece of paper with Bo"s handwriting on it back to him and he should reward you. Drink and be merry... then once you"re merry, drink some more! Tell Bo thanks for sending you. Now, where did I put that map?"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Oh, great!  You came just in time.  I"m out of ammo.  Defeat these Wrights, and get me three of their Badges... and I will help you obtain your final Badge from Bo."
quests.completionMessage: "Haha, I"m not done with you yet. I"m here to make plans for a Blob party in the caves! Gonna get some dancers, some beer, and a lot of pizza!!"  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 19 of 20
quests.description: "One of the common creatures in this dungeon has taken a document from me while I was sleeping off a hangover.  I"m not sure which one took it... they all look alike to me anyway. I dimly remember something small floating away from me.  But if you retrieve it for me, I"ll be done with you."
quests.completionMessage: "Thanks... I"ll get you word about the party when I get it finalized, but now to help you with Bo"s training.  I know what final thing you need for Bo, and I can tell you how to get it."  [More]

quests.title: Bo Crest Quest: Part 20 of 21
quests.description: "The Flob Token is the single most Rare drop in the world.  Even more rare then the Bo Emblem. Find this rarest of the rare items and bring it to Bo, then your training will be complete. Honor requires me to warn you -- you may have to kill over a million Flobs just to obtain one.  It might take you years.  Good luck."
quests.hint: Find a Flob Token for Bo

quests.title: Core Armor
quests.description: "I make Core Armor for our warriors all the time. I will give you a piece from my overflow bin, if you will do something for me. Bring me 2 Clegorn Tongues and 4 Vigon Shells. Yes, they are difficult, but if you keep your distance, you will be successful."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you for helping me out. Here is a piece of Core Armor. If it is not to your liking, I can always get you another... that is, IF you will get me another 2 Clegorn Tongues and another 4 Vigon Shells!"

quests.title: Cytomic Armor
quests.description: "Yes, Cytomic Armor is in great demand among our fighters. I will give you an extra piece I have left over if you will do something for me. Bring me 4 Clegorn Tongues and 6 Vigon Shells. You should have experience fighting these creatures from Bo"s training,"
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you for helping me out. Here is a piece of Core Armor. If it is not to your liking, I can always get you another... that is, IF you will get me another 4 Clegorn Tongues and another 6 Vigon Shells!"

quests.title: Magnix Armor
quests.description: "Magnix Armor, eh? Moving up in the world! As you know, I make a lot of armor. I have a pile of extra pieces, and I will give you a piece of Magnix from that pile if you will do something for me. Bring me 5 Clegorn Tongues and 10 Malia Bat Wings."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you for helping me out. Here is a piece of Magnix Armor. If it is not to your liking, I can always get you another... that is, IF you will get me another 5 Clegorn Tongues and another 10 Malia Bat Wings"

quests.title: Coalazine Armor
quests.description: "So you have graduated to Coalazine, have you? Good for you! I have a few extra pieces lying around, I think. Tell you what... if you will bring me 5 Clegorn Tongues and 15 Malia Bat Wings, I will give you a piece of Coalazine Armor from my stash."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you for helping me out. Here is a piece of Coalazine Armor. If it is not to your liking, I can always get you another... that is, IF you will get me another 5 Clegorn Tongues and another 15 Malia Bat Wings!"

quests.title: Tetra Armor
quests.description: "You are pushing the limits of my ability, son. Tetra is the best I can do. And, as usual, I have a few spare pieces lying around that I would be willing to part with. I will give you a spare piece of Tetra Armor from my inventory if you will bring me 10 Clegorn Tongues and 15 Malia Bat Wings."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you for helping me out. Here is a piece of Tetra Armor. If it is not to your liking, I can always get you another... that is, IF you will get me another 10 Clegorn Tongues and another 15 Malia Bat Wings!"

quests.title: Nordic Armor
quests.completionMessage: "Well, you"ve reached the limit of my ability. The only person that can make you a set of Nordic Armor is Glagrog the smith in the Arilous Mining Caves of the old world. Good luck."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "If you have not gone through Bo"s trials, believe me, you are nowhere near ready to attempt this."
quests.completionMessage: "Bo has condemned you to fight the Rune Bosses! Quick! No one"s looking... run away now! Hide in the sea and live on seaweed and small crustaceans.  I was brave at one time too, as you are now."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "But, that was before I met Frube. You must seek out and defeat the Rune Bosses of IIA. Here is the Amulet of the Ancients - you will need it to protect you from their power. Arm it when you are in the presence of a Rune Boss. I"ll close my eyes for a few seconds to give you one last chance to run away."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 1 of 10
quests.description: "Your first assignment is to bring me the Living Rune that Lord Shraderix carries. You can find Lord Shaderix in the Black Market Cavern. Be wary traveling there. Well, you knew the job was dangerous when you took it, so get going."
quests.completionMessage: "You defeated Lord Shraderix? That is an incredible task.  No one should be forced to fight them, they are ruthless and relentless. But I have to give you your first Rune Key, so here it is."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat Shraderix in the Black Market Cavern

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 2 of 10
quests.description: "The key you hold is to Lord Shipron"s crystal and will let you enter his lair on Sluggith Island. Remember to arm your amulet when you are in his presence. If you do not return with the Earth Rune from Lord Shipron, you won"t get to move on. It"s just that simple."
quests.completionMessage: "I see that you"ve managed to defeat Lord Shipron. I made it that far myself, long ago. And then the nameless, maddening fear took me... and I have never recovered.  You are at that point in your quest right now. Here is your next rune key."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 3 of 10
quests.description: "Now you get to meet Frube. The entrance to his lair in on the Root of Oracle. Please reconsider, you could run away! You could hide in the trees and eat bark and become a fugitive. Or maybe if you"re lucky, you"ll get a cushy job like me! There"s still time! I suppose I"ll never see you again, but good luck anyway."
quests.completionMessage: "I don"t believe it... the Bio Rune... I"m holding one in my hand. I was never able to defeat Frube, yet you have done so. You have given me some hope that maybe someday I too might triumph over him. Thank you for your example, brave warrior! Here is your next rune key."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat Frube on the Root of Oracle

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 4 of 10
quests.description: "You beat Frube, and he"s the toughest of the tough. Now you must seek the Water Rune and return with it. Zorphion resides in the ocean west of the Arilious Mines near the Trisk Hive."
quests.completionMessage: "Yes! You beat Zorphion, didn"t you? I knew you could. I"ll bet he jumped right up out of the water when he saw you. Here is your next rune key, and I"m looking forward to giving you your next assignment."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 5 of 10
quests.description: "You will need to find the keeper of the Fire Rune next, and bring your objective back to me. Skelcy is on the highest hill on the southern part of Black Market Island."
quests.completionMessage: "You are wiping the floor with these so-called Rune "Bosses". here is your next rune key."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat Skelcy on Black Market Island

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 6 of 10
quests.description: "Find the keeper of the Tech Rune, and tear the rune from his feeble grasp. Then step over his lifeless corpse as you leave.  You will find the Destroyer"s portal in the Petrified Forest."
quests.completionMessage: "Oh yeah. You came, you saw you kicked some Destroyer mechanical hindquarters! It"s a wonder they don"t drop dead from fear the moment they see you striding into their lairs. I"ll bet that happens with the next one. I expect to see you here in a short time ready to mop the floor with another one."
quests.hint: Defeat Destroyer in the Petrified Forest

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 7 of 10
quests.description: "You must now find the Grey Stone Rune and dispose of its keeper. Slate, you will find on top a high peak of Sail Island.  There are two crystals on that island, each one leading to a different Rune Boss. This key will only grant you entrance into Slate"s lair."
quests.completionMessage: "Woohoo!! One smacked-down rock boss bites the dust. You are blowing them away so fast they are absolutely reeling! If you want to take a nap or something before the next one, I understand. But don"t keep them waiting too long!"  [More]
quests.hint: Find Slate"s portal on Sial Island

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 8 of 10
quests.description: "You now must seek the Blue Stone Rune.  This key will give you entrance to the other crystal on Sial Island.  The entrance to Brike."
