quests.completionMessage: "You should know that Brike and Slate were both once peaceful brothers who were cursed by the Supreme High Priest of Crom."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Brike"s portal on Sial Island

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 9 of 10
quests.description: "So the next victim - I mean, Rune Boss, is the keeper of the Future Rune, who"s entrance is on Unity Outpost. Zeth may give you some problems because of his lair. You"ll need to figure out a way to kill him while he"s over solid ground, else you will lose his body and the Future Rune."
quests.completionMessage: "You knocked him right out of the sky with a shot between the eyes, that"s what I heard. You have got to be the baddest Blob I know. Here is the next and final rune key. Come back when you are ready to show us the way home, brother!"  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 10 of 10
quests.description: "This is it! The final rune boss, Pridion. I almost wish there were a few more just so I could watch your dominance continue. Pridion"s crystal is on the south tip of Moon"s Rift Island."
quests.completionMessage: "Bloblic power. The crimson crash, the azure assassin, those are some of the things people are calling you. You gave new meaning to the term "dominate". You"ve inspired me to take up my training again."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Complete
quests.description: "I have you to thank for my newly found courage. You have earned our standard-issue rune gun, the Pulsemaster. Use it with pride against all who would rise up against us!!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.completionMessage: "Welcome, my boy. Are you feeling a little out of place here? That"s understandable. This planet was new to all of us at one time. My name is Darius and I lead the human male sect of IIA. As you grow through my training I will give you a Crest as a symbol of your achievement."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "The crests I give you are not only keys to your development but are also a source of extra bonus.  Arming a Crest will give you a boost to your Strength and Dexterity.  This could be very helpful for armor/weapon requirements.  However, an armed Crest will hinder your gain in those very stats while you train, so only arm them when you absolutely need them."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 1 of 22
quests.description: "I want you to scout out a group of creatures that we call Flobs. Everytime you kill a Flob you can loot the carcass for its shell and any other valuables it may be carrying.  I need you to take out 10 Flobs and bring me back their shells. Also while out try typing in ":REBIRTH". Make sure you use the colon and all caps."
quests.completionMessage: "Hey, how about that! You did good, son! I am a man of my word... here is your first Crest and some credits. Come back to me when you are ready for your next mission, and always bring the last Crest I gave you.  Oh, did you try the :REBIRTH? Performing a :REBIRTH in a safe zone binds your re-spawn point to that location."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 2 of 22
quests.description: "Your next mission is going to be against the Clegurks. When you defeat one it will drop a Clegurk Tongue. Bring me back 10 Clegurk Tongues and the crest from your previous task to advance to your next mission."
quests.completionMessage: "Say, that"s a nice collection of tongues there! Here is some more spending cash.  Clegurks, you may have noticed, are melee creatures with a long reach.  They all are catogorized as "Normal" creatures, which mean they have the strengths and weakenesses of all other creatures that share that "channel" classification."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 3 of 22
quests.description: "The Infant Stount is the first creature you"ll be hunting that can shoot back from a distance. Go and hunt Infant Stounts, and bring me back 10 of their tails. You are right on schedule with your progress. Keep up the good work."
quests.completionMessage: "You did very good young one! Did you know that if you consume (USE) one of these tails, it will restore a portion of your health? Many of the meats that you get from your kills can be consumed for health, just like a health potion. Here is your next crest ands some credits."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 4 of 22
quests.description: "Vigons are essentially just larger versions of Flobs, so they"ll be good practice for you. Hunt down 10 Vigons and bring me their shells. Also, remember to utilize your :REBIRTH command to reduce travel time if you find yourself dying a lot."
quests.completionMessage: "You are advancing very quickly! Here is your next Crest and a credit bonus. Make sure that you make use of your vault to store valuables that you are not using at the moment. You may want to check with Sudate, the guard Captain, to see if he has any work for you. Soldiers like you don"t come along often. Believe me, I know."  [More]
quests.hint: "Hunt 10 Vigons/Search the condemned area or outside."

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 5 of 22
quests.description: "I want you to prove your skill against 10 Faduns and 10 Didons, you can find them in the sewers of this city. Bring me back their plasmas as proof of your success and I will advance you. Let me remind you to upgrade your weapons and armor at the store whenever you have advanced in skill and stat gains. Make sure to check the skill and stat requirements before buying."
quests.completionMessage: "Ahh, you return with the plasmas! Here is your next Crest and some additional credits. As you complete these training tasks you will raise your Weapon Tech, which is good because I will always require that you continue to advance in skill. Go and train until you reach level 4 Weapon Tech, and then you will get your next mission."

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 6 of 22
quests.description: "I see that you are training hard. This pleases me greatly! I do not take likely to slackers in my army!! Now for your next mission - search the rivers and air for your next two adversaries; Stontriles and Malia Bats.  Bring me back 10 Stontrile shells and 10 Malia Bat wings. You can find Stontriles in the Slotholic Caves water."
quests.completionMessage: "So you return - a little battered but I see not defeated! Stontriles and Malia Bats are both very different from each other. I hope that you learned to utilize the terrain to your advantage while hunting these creatures. Congratulations, you have earned your next crest and another credit bonus."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "Many others in this world are adept in the skill of smithing, and can make you armors not sold in stores. These armors are often better than those from the store as well. So if you have the stats to wear better armor than you have now, go see one pronto. Remember that you can arm your Crests to gain extra stat bonuses."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 7 of 22
quests.description: "For your next mission need you to hunt down 10 Ascherions spiders, these can be found in the slotholic caves, near the dangerous Ashadra. Beware of these creatures for they are quick in movement and in stealth. Good luck!"
quests.completionMessage: "So you return victorious with the venom sacks! I must say that I am very impressed at the growth of your skill.  You have earned your next Crest, plus another credit bonus. Make sure you bank those credits so you don"t lose them.  Since you are advancing so quickly I will have to give you more difficult missions from now on."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 8 of 22
quests.description: "There has been an increasing number of Shockions in the south-east caverns. You will have to explore deeper into these caves than you have done before to bring back 10 Shockion and Adult Shockion Claws to me."
quests.completionMessage: "So I see that you defeated those slimy snakes! They are little pests, that is for sure!  Here"s your next Crest and some credits. I require you to reach level 7 Weapon Tech before completing the next task. Listen to me now, if you thought these last Shockions were hard, you"re going to have a harder time with the next task."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 9 of 22
quests.description: "I need you to become experienced with the higher order of Shockions. The Elite and Elder Shockions should be found on Moons Rift or inside the Black Market  I want their heads!  Bring me back 10 Elite and 5 Elder heads!!  You may want to upgrade armor before embarking on this mission.  Good luck!"
quests.completionMessage: "Oh yes! These heads will look great on these walls!.  These pesky Shockions just don"t know their place in this realm.  They continue to spread out like a virus to lands that don"t belong to them.  Well, I must say that I am very impressed with you. If you continue like this you may just become one of my elite."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "Upon reaching your 9th Crest, great things open up for you. You can seek your Pridio Armor from Glagrog in the Arilous Mining caves. You can also begin your rune quests with my agent Zarwen, which will end in your obtaining your Power Rifle Crom. This is a very powerful weapon which delivers damage in the mystical Rune channel."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 10 of 22
quests.description: "Ok, now for your first true mission.  This will test truly test your skill and wit.  There is a rogue bandit that has been posing as an agent of mine.  He goes by the name Regen.  You are to hunt him down near Destroyer"s portal in death valley, and retrieve his badge. Go quickly!"
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent!  I wish I could have seen the look on that imposter"s face when you took him down.  See, this is what happens when you try to double cross me.  I am sure I will never have to deal with you in this fashion.  Well, warrior, you have earned your next Crest, and here is another credit bonus."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 11 of 22
quests.description: "Listen closely. I have a ring... no, I had a ring. I lost it during my last walk through the Slotholic Caves. My sources tell me that the dreaded Ashadra has stumbled upon it and has grafted it to her body. She flaunts it for all to see. You must kill her to retrieve it for me."
quests.completionMessage: "Ah! My ring!! I thank you so much. Let me put it on... whew, that"s funny... I"m a little dizzy... say, who did you say you are? Wow, it has been so long...  No matter, here take this Crest someone left here on my desk."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 12 of 22
quests.description: "Ok, listen up.  It is time to pay some personal dues.  I need you to go and retrieve my staff from Clike. He has been working on it for quite some time and should have it completed by now.  He went to visit the Amphibious Island"
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, my staff. Good work, let"s see it... What? This is wrong, all wrong! You take this back to Clike and tell him the gem in the shaft is supposed to be blue, not green. Ugh, let me show you what I think about Clike"s work... [SNAP!] Return these pieces to him."  [More]
quests.hint: "Clike is in a shroom hut on the back of the island."

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 14 of 22
quests.description: "I told you not to accept any excuses from Clike. Bring me back a new staff and it had better be the way I want it."
quests.completionMessage: "See how the blue glimmers in the light? Thank you so much. Say, would you mind taking hold of this and scratching my back? Right under the armor plating there... yeah... no, a little lower... Aahhhhhhh... That"s wonderful. You have proven yourself to be a very valuable asset to my entourage. Here is your next Crest."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "You should be thinking about your Poldas Armor around now.  Not only does it provide good protection, but its pieces are enchanted to never leave your body, even if you die. Seek Ocyslop in the underworld for some of the pieces."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 19 of 22
quests.description: "This is a time-critical situation! A band of thieves lead by Rogar are hiding in the death valley area. Enter into "negotiations" with his men, and retrieve the Solis Power, Darkness, Storm and Vision stones. Go now!!"
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, finally I lay my hands on you, lovely sun stones... What"s that? Oh yes, they were definitely mine to begin with, I meant to say "finally I lay my hands on you again". Here is your reward."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 20 of 22
quests.description: "Jousters are menacing monsters who are quite intelligent despite their appearance, which is all mouth. I believe one of them is protecting the Mirror of Perception. Hunt them down in the Death Valley.  Kill them until you retrieve the mirror, then bring it to me."
quests.completionMessage: "You are a very resourceful warrior; now give me the mirror!  Oh, mirror mirror on the...  Oh sorry.  Here is your next Crest.  If you haven"t already spoken to Zarwen or Glagrog, I order you to do that now. Without the rewards they give, you won"t be able to accomplish the remaining missions I have for you."  [More]
quests.hint: "Hunt Jousters in Death Valley for the mirror."

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 21 of 22
quests.description: "Wrights are elusive and dangerous.  Bring back 5 of their Essences, and one Wright Badge.  The Wright Badge can eventually be obtained by killing enough of them.  I believe there are a few in the Cave of Ancients as well as in the ancient temples of Four Falls."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent work, soldier. Here is your next crest. I"ve only got one more assignment for you. Think Grisions. These invaders from the spirit world are similar to our native Jouster in a lot of ways, and if we want to send them back where they came from, here"s where we start. "  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 22 of 22
quests.description: "You need to have your Endlon Emblem and enter the Four Falls Temple. Find and kill Grisions until you have 10 of their Plasmas and one Grision Badge which you will eventually find by killing enough of them. Move fast and you will stay alive, soldier."
quests.completionMessage: "Well, I don"t know what to say. Congratulations of the highest degree! You have accomplished all of the tasks I have. I now consider you one of my top men in all of IIA. Here is your last crest. Wear it proudly!"  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Complete
quests.description: "There is nothing more I can do for someone of your talents.  Start a clan or something."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Hallo! Zees zpecial staff eez only for za Lord Darius. Zo... haff you come to pick it up? No? Zen do not ask about it!"
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, finally Lord Darius zends zomeone to pick up my verk of art! Observe za fine craftsmanship and hand-polished white oak. Now, pay attention, I haff zum zpecific instructions for you."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 13 of 22
quests.description: "Now, I vant you to go oont deliver zees to za Lord Darius oont harry up; he has been vaiting for zees for qvite zum time now. Do not dawdle along za vay, zees ees important business!! And if you don"t mind... maybe you could come back aftervards and tell me what he think of eet, no?"
quests.completionMessage: "Ach... VUT? But I haff za vork order right here Zee? It spezifically states, oont I qvote, "and I want a Sapphire as big as my nose set in the middle of the staff". Do you zee vat he eez trying to do? He eez trying to ruin me! Zat eez a Bi Color Sapphire zat just happens to be green."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 15 of 22
quests.description: "You must help me! Please, you must go oont plead vis my gem zupplier for a blue sapphire. Heez name eez Galothien. Take heem zees lettair, unt... Vut is dat? Vair eez he? Um... zat is a good qvestion... he alvays comes to me... Vait! I teenk I hear dat he leeves een za sewers, ya?"
quests.completionMessage: "Ah... zees eez za one. Look how perfect she eez, vut form, vut lines. You haff done vell. Just vait zair for a moment vile I mount zees in za new staff...  Vunderbar! Zair, take zat back to "Hees Majesty". Ach... I teenk we bose needs a holiday."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 18 of 22
quests.description: "Zat man eez one picky sunz of beetch."
quests.hint: "Return to Darius with the new Staff."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Who are you? Whaddya want? Hey, I ain"t seen nothin"! Everything around here is on the up and square, see? Yeah. Keep moving, pal."
quests.completionMessage: "You know Clike? Yeah, he buys my gems sometimes, but he"s lax on his payments, see? I ain"t givin" him any more credit.  But hey, I feel sorry for ya, so this is what I"ll do.  Godions stink like these sewers, plus they sneak up and stab you in the hindquarters with doze smirkin" little gurgling mugs... Ugh!! I hates "em! "  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 16 of 22
quests.description: "One thing I do like about"em is their tasty little ears.  Ya bring me a load of Godion ears and I"ll wipe out Clike"s debt and give you the gem he"s lookin" for.  You can find those little buggers in the Solothic Caves."
quests.completionMessage: "Hey, looky there! Ya did it! That"s quite a pile of ears ya got. Worth enough to keep my end of the bargain. A Blue Sapphire."  [More]

quests.title: Darius Quest: Part 17 of 22
quests.description: "Clike will appreciate its quality. Now beat it."
quests.hint: "Return to Clike with the Blue Sapphire."

quests.title: Tryklan Armor
quests.description: "Well hello there, friend!! Let me introduce myself, my name is Ethan Takkerd, and I am the Master of the Armory. Darius has instructed me to proclaim that only those of you who prove themselves worthy will be found deserving of the armor which I forge. Bring me 2 Vigon Shells and 5 Infant Dilirium Eyes and I will reward you with something appropriate from the armory."
quests.completionMessage: "Wow, well done... these are some fine specimens. Here, close your eyes and grab something out of my box. Ahh, there you are! I am sure you can make some use out of that piece."

quests.title: Tiberius Armor
quests.description: "Hmm... you want Tiberius pieces, huh? Alright, I think I can make something for you... but I am not sure which molds I have back at the shop. While you are waiting for me to fashion your armor, why don"t you go and grab me 4 Clegorn Tongues and 5 Vigon Shells. I am sure I will have it done by the time you return."
quests.completionMessage: "Great, you returned just in time. I just pulled this piece from the cooler. It should surpass all standards for this level of armor. Of course, if you wish to have a different peice, I will have to send out for a new mold. By the time you bring me my ingredients again it should be in."

quests.title: Fision Armor
quests.description: "Greetins! You wish to acquire some Fision Armor, hmm? That armor seems to be in great demand of late. I suppose I can fit you into my schedule if you bring me 6 Clegorn Tongues and 7 Malia Bat Wings. I can guarantee you a fine piece of Fision Armor by the time you return."
quests.completionMessage: "Well well well, just what I needed! Here, hand me those ingredients... and here is your piece of armor. Say, you are a fine hunter, friend! Come and barter for my armor any day!"

quests.title: GI Armor
quests.description: "Well, you are approaching my limit in armor crafting. Forging this intricate of a piece is no laughing matter, and not many can do it except high level Smiths and Armorers like myself. I will tell you what... you bring me 5 Clegorn Tongues and 13 Malia Bat Wings and I will hook you up with something worthwhile, but I am only giving you this deal because I like you."
quests.completionMessage: "Here ya are pal, you deserve it. These ingrediants will surely help me with my hobby. If you need any more pieces of armor I will be glad to help you for the proper supplies."

quests.title: Ligon Armor
quests.description: "Wow, you sure are in need of some heavy protection! I must tell you this armor is worth very much, and if you are strong enough to bear its weight it will save your life many times over. This time I am in need of a few different creatures, i require 4 Ascherion Venom Sacs, 5 Adult Shockion Claws and 8 Malia Bat Wings. With those supplies I will surely serve the finest feast in all of the land!"
quests.completionMessage: "Wonderful! Here is your armor. I have only one complaint... I need more ingredients. So if you can muster up another batch of what you just brought me, I am sure I can forge the exact piece you need!"

quests.title: Pridio Armor
quests.completionMessage: "Wow, I sure wish I could help you, but that armor is beyond my skill to make. You see, I cut short my training at that point to pursue my greatest passion... COOKING!! Mmmm, all those ingredients you brought me have helped me create some of the finest dishes  you could imagine!! You must see Glagrog the smith in the Arilous Mining Caves of the old world for higher level armor."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "If you have not gone through Darius"s trials, believe me, you are nowhere near ready to attempt this.  The Rune Quests are far too dangerous."
quests.completionMessage: "I am Zarwen, your guide to the runes of IIA. The keepers of the runes are unique creatures unlike any other on IIA.  Most are trapped in their own realms separate from the main world and the only way to reach each boss is through a Crystal Portal."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "A key is required to enter each portal.  I will be giving them to you one at a time.  Here is an Amulet of Rune Protection that will give you the added protection against each of the Rune Bosses."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 1 of 10
quests.description: "Your first assignment will not involve keys or portals, for Lord Shraderix has been trapped not in his own realm, but in the Black Market caves. You must bring me the Living Rune that Lord Shraderix carries."
quests.completionMessage: "You defeated Lord Shraderix?  You may very well be cut out for this sort of quest.  The key you hold is to Lord Shipron"s crystal and will let you enter his lair. The Crystal portal is located on the south end of Sluggith Island."  [More]
quests.hint: "Defeat Shraderix in the Black Market Cavern."

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 2 of 10
quests.description: "Remember to arm your amulet when you are in his presence. If you do not return with the Earth Rune from Lord Shipron, you won"t get to move on. It"s just that simple."
quests.completionMessage: "I see that you"ve managed to defeat Lord Shipron. His realm is only the first you must conquer. Here is your next rune key.  It will give you access to Frube"s lair."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 3 of 10
quests.description: "Frube"s lair is on the Root of the Oracle. Just remember...She"s just a big puppy dog.  Go easy on him.  He will drop the Bio Rune."
quests.completionMessage: "Like I said, big puppy dog. Here is your next rune key."  [More]
quests.hint: "Frube"s portal is on the Root of the Oracle."

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 4 of 10
quests.description: "Now you must seek the Water Rune and return with it.  Zorphion resides in the ocean west of the Arilious Mines near the Trisk Hive."
quests.completionMessage: "You"re always guaranteed to get wet with Zorphion.  Here is your next rune key."  [More]
quests.hint: "Zorphion"s portal is in western-most part of the sea."

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 5 of 10
quests.description: "You will need to find the keeper of the Fire Rune next, and bring your objective back to me. Skelcy is on the highest hill on the southern part of Black Market Island."
quests.completionMessage: "You are wiping the floor with these so-called Rune "Bosses". Here is your next rune key."  [More]
quests.hint: "Skelcy"s portal is on Black Market Island."

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 6 of 10
quests.description: "Find the keeper of the Tech Rune, and tear the rune from his feeble grasp. Then step over his lifeless corpse as you leave.  You will find the Destroyer"s portal in the Petrified Forrest."
quests.completionMessage: "Very good.  You are doing quite well."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 7 of 10
quests.description: "You must now find the Grey Stone Rune and dispose of its keeper, Slate.  You will find his entrance on top a high peak of Sail Island.  There are two crystals on that island, each one leading to a different Rune Boss.  The key will only grant you entrance into Slate"s lair."
quests.completionMessage: "Again, you are doing wonderfully."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 8 of 10
quests.description: "You now must seek the Blue Stone Rune.  This key will give you entrance to the other Peak on Sial Island.  The entrance to Brike."
quests.completionMessage: "You should know that Brike and Slate were both once peaceful brothers who were cursed by the Supreme High Priest of Crom."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 9 of 10
quests.description: "Zeth"s entrance is on Unity Outpost. What makes him difficult is his lair. You"ll need to figure out a way to kill him while he"s over a solid surface, else you will lose his body and the Future Rune."
quests.completionMessage: "Here is the next and final rune key."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 10 of 10
quests.description: "This is it! The final rune boss, Pridion. I almost wish there were a few more just so I could watch your dominance continue. Pridion"s crystal is on the south tip of Moon"s Rift Island."
quests.completionMessage: "You make me wish I was still training."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Complete
quests.description: "I am glad to have been your guide. You have earned our standard rune weapon, the PowerRifle Crom."

quests.title: Intro
quests.completionMessage: "Yes, I can teach you magic. Okay, pick a card... oh, you"ve seen that one? Well look, REAL magery is a long and difficult journey. It is a skill of the mind, but I cannot train you in it until you have your first scroll. You may purchase this items from my colleague in the dark arts."

quests.title: Quest for Knowledge: Part 1 of 4
quests.description: "Purchase an Acid Missile Scroll. Then return to me with it."
quests.completionMessage: "Now that you are ready. Here are some poison herbs - the reagents required to cast this spell."  [More]

quests.title: Quest for Knowledge: How to
quests.completionMessage: "To cast a spell, You can add the scroll to your quick bar and it will cast if you press the key its bound to.  Whatever that means."  [More]

quests.title: Quest for Knowledge: How to
quests.completionMessage: "Reagents are the ingredients from which each spell derives its power. Most of these reagents can be obtained from the Magic Shops around this world for a reasonable price.  I was going to give you a Scroll of Weak Heal, but it blew out the doorway and a Flob swallowed it."  [More]

quests.title: Quest for Knowledge: Part 2 of 4
quests.description: "I believe you will recover the scroll if you kill enough of them.  When you return the scroll to me I will provide the reagents for the spell.  If not....good luck on your journies."
quests.completionMessage: "I don"t understand why those roly-poly Flobs think magic scrolls are food. Well, the scroll looks to be intact. Here is some Bone, the reagent necessary for this spell."  [More]
quests.hint: "Retrieve my scroll from that thieving Flob."

quests.title: Quest for Knowledge: Part 3 of 4
quests.description: Your skill in the arts is not good enough for your next task.
quests.completionMessage: "Check the Shop for other spells that you can purchase and try out. When you are ready I will tell you more about where to locate magic.  There are many other scrolls to be found in the realm. Scrolls for attacking, healing, illuminating your surroundings and many other uses."  [More]

quests.title: Quest for Knowledge: Part 4 of 4
quests.description: Your skill in the arts is not good enough for your next task.
quests.completionMessage: "You can find my friends Naila near the Solothic caves, Drodar near the mining caves, and Detinu near  the Crypts. Drodar can teach you the ways of healing, Naila can teach you the art of fire magic, and Detinu is a specialist in illuminating magic." [More]

quests.title: Quest for Knowledge: Complete
quests.completionMessage: "You have learned all that you can from me. Continue to grow in knowledge and power, friend."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Gaining skill involves using what you"ve gained before you can gain more."
quests.completionMessage: "I create scrolls of magic;  scrolls that produce light. Something I find much more respectable than scrolls that hurt or heal.  I can scribe the Scroll of Illuminate for you, if you agree to a short apprenticeship with me."  [More]

quests.title: Quest for Illumination:  Part 1 of 4
quests.description: "Your first assignment is to increase my wealth by acting on a tip I just received. It is Vigon mating season, and the males of the species wear leafy underwear to attract mates. The plants they choose are valuable. So kill me a boatload of Vigons until you get me 5 of those plants."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent! I can"t say I think much of their mating habits, but hey... they"re big bugs.  For your next task I would like you to retrieve a lost key for me."
quests.hint: "Kill Vigons for the plants they will drop."

quests.title: Quest for Illumination:  Part 2 of 4
quests.description: "Well, last week I was fleeing for my life when I dropped a very important key. My associate Naila informed me she saw it in the beak of a Kidion Bat. So your assignment is to kill all the Kidion Bats you can find until you retrieve my key. Take note that Kidions usually inhabit high places."
quests.completionMessage: "Hey, way to go! And look... the key is still inside! Now you can go find my strongbox and bring me the contents."
quests.hint: "A Kidion Bat was seen with my key."

quests.title: Quest for Illumination:  Part 3 of 4
quests.description: "Enter the caves beyond me, you should find my strongbox somewhere in there. Recover whatever is in it and return. And don"t pocket anything for yourself, I know what"s in it."
quests.completionMessage: "That"s it, my flint! It is so archaic now that I can set fire to things with a flick of my fingers, but what can I say? I"m sentimental at heart. Here"s a little cash for your trouble. Sadly, we are down to your last task from me."

quests.title: Quest for Illumination:  Part 4 of 4
quests.description: "Retrieve for me a Mayzora Spine. I believe Mayzoras can be found on Moon"s Rift. I"ve also heard of some inside the Black Market. Good luck, and stay out of its reach."
quests.completionMessage: "You did great. Really. Can"t think of anyone who"s done better than you in a long time. Here is the scroll I promised you. If you want, you can seek out Naila and Drodar for additional training."
quests.hint: "Mayzoras are on Moon"s Rift and inside Black Market."

quests.title: Quest for Illumination: Complete
quests.description: "That was all, thank you for taking the time to help me."

quests.title: Flint
quests.description: You do not have the key for this chest.
quests.completionMessage: You get Detinu"s Flint.

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "A practicing mage is just that, a mage who practices."
quests.completionMessage: "Welcome, pilgrim of the Arcane Arts. Sit at my feet and I will instruct you in the honored tradition of healing. If you agree to study under my tutilage for a short time, I will give you a Scroll of Heal Missile, one of my newest creations.  The healing arts requires a sacrifice of some sort. "  [More]

quests.title: Quest for Healing Magic: Part 1 of 3
quests.description: "In this case, Infant Diliriums are going to make that sacrifice. This is the season where they give gifts to one another. The most desireable gift in their culture is a rare extract that I need. Kill as many Infant Diliriums as you must until you acquire that extract, then bring it to me."
quests.completionMessage: "Wonderful. This fluid is desireable in my research and it is also necessary to mix the ink that will one day be used to write your scroll.  As I"m creating this scroll for you, there is something you can do for me. I keep a strongbox just inside the caves but I have misplaced the key since I last visited it."  [More]
quests.hint: "Hunt Infant Diliriums for the rare extract."

quests.title: Quest for Healing Magic: Part 2 of 3
quests.description: "From my divinations, I discovered I dropped the key upon exiting the cave and a Gope swallowed it. Recover my key from that Gope, then bring me the contents of my strongbox."
quests.completionMessage: "This is good news. Appearently I was worried for no reason. My special salve is the only mixture I"ve found that is potent enough to be effective in the creation of healing scrolls. You"ve done well."  [More]

quests.title: Quest for Healing Magic: Part 3 of 3
quests.description: "For this last lesson, I will have you obtain the final item I need to complete your scroll. You must bring me the head of an Elite Shockion. You know they are fearsome beasts, but I will be needing some of its cerebral fluid."
quests.completionMessage: "I am proud to give you this Scroll of Heal Missile. Use it to the benefit of all, and may your power grow in proportion to your wisdom."  [More]

quests.title: Quest for Healing Magic: Complete
quests.completionMessage: "You have been a most attentive student, and have served me well. You should seek out Naila and Detinu for further training, if you haven"t already done so."

quests.description: You do not have the key for this chest!
quests.completionMessage: You get Drodar"s Salve!

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I can create magic scrolls. My specialty pertains to offensive spells that damage opponents.  But you must do more than just want...you must practice."
quests.completionMessage: "I can create magic scrolls. My specialty is with offensive spells that damage opponents. If you would like to own the Flame Missile Scroll, I can give it to you provided you enter into apprenticeship with me and do my bidding. Is that acceptable to you?" [More]

quests.title: Quest for Flame:  Part 1 of 4
quests.description: "Very well. My first task for you will be to bring me 10 Tanzin Bushes. Choose some nice ones, I am very particular about my reagents."
quests.completionMessage: "Here, let me see those. Good work, I can use them. I can already tell that you will be a good apprentice.  We mages don"t often lose things...such as, oh... keys, for instance. Ok, I tripped over my own feet and dropped an important key.  So I need you to retrieve it for me."  [More]
quests.hint: "Where would you buy - I mean - find reagents?"

quests.title: Quest for Flame:  Part 2 of 4
quests.description: "The only creatures I saw around at the time were Adult Diliriums. Well you know how they love to swallow bright things. Well I say they do! So I am positive my key is inside one of them. Gut a bunch and recover my key for me."
quests.completionMessage: "You"ve found it! Now, where were we? Oh, yes. You were serving my every whim.  I cannot remember what I put in my strongbox, and I want you to go retrieve the contents and return them to me. I warn you, do not attempt to fool me with items of your own."  [More]
quests.hint: "Kill Adult Diliriums until you recover the key."

quests.title: Quest for Flame:  Part 3 of 4
quests.description: "I will know the contents of my strongbox once I see the items. The Strongbox should be somewhere in the caves behind me.
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, yes! My comb! Now I remember. Well, that was an easy task for you. It wasn"t? Why not? The guard attacked you? Well that"s silly, if you would have just given him the password he wouldn"t have attacked you."  [More]
quests.hint: "Bring me the contents of my Strongbox."

quests.title: Quest for Flame:  Part 4 of 4
quests.description: "I didn"t mention any password? Oh well, no harm done but sadly the last step in our relationship has arrived. All I need is the Eyes from three Taldons to seal the ink and we will be finished. The magical qualities of Taldons are known throughout the land."
quests.completionMessage: "Magnificent eye specimens. These will do fine. And.... DONE. Here is your reward. As with any magic spell, the best results will be achieved by practicing and becoming familiar with the range and how best to cast it. You have been a most attentive student, if you haven"t already, you should seek out my fellow magicians, Drodar and Detinu."

quests.title: Quest for Flame: Completed
quests.completionMessage: "Good luck with your future adventures."

quests.description: You do not have the key for this chest!
quests.completionMessage: You get Naila"s Comb!

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "You should find the leader of your own people to begin training."
quests.completionMessage: "Hello, my young Amazon. Welcome to IIA. I am Celeste, the leader of Human Females in this realm. Do not speak -- I know you are here because you would like to learn more about my Crests. The Crests of Celeste are very important for two reasons. First, they are a symbol of status and respect."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "Second, my Crests are used as keys to greater experiences and they will allow you to access more advanced areas throughout this world. I must caution you... obtaining even a single Crest is not an easy task."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "I will give you a series of tasks to complete for me with the reward being one of sixteen crests or badges. Arming a crest will enhance your strength and dexterity in combat but will hinder your gain of those same stats while the crest is armed.  Only wear them when necessary in battle, not during training."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 1 of 23
quests.description: "Now, let"s get started with your training, shall we? Your first assignment will be to bring back 10 Flob Shells.  Hunting is the foundation of all training.  Always return with your most recent Crest when finished.  While you are out try typing in :REBIRTH.  This will rebind your re-spawn location to that point, but only while in a safe zone."
quests.completionMessage: "Wonderful.  If you haven"t noticed, different creatures have different types of behaviours, depending on whether they have ranged attacks or close ranged melee attacks you can use the environment for an advantage.  Paying attention to your surroundings is your best weapon against many enemies."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 2 of 23
quests.description: "Clegurks are small and shouldn"t give you much trouble if you attack from a distance. They are close combat creatures and while they can hit you at close range, they have no ranged attack. Return when you have 10 Tongues. You will find them Inside the condemned area on the first floor to the right."
quests.completionMessage: "Well done. I"m sorry for making you touch those slimy tongues, but sometimes a warrior maiden must get her hands dirty. "  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 3 of 23
quests.description: "Next I will need you to go find the infant stout. Be careful, because unlike the monsters you have fought so far, it will shoot back. You must learn to fire at a moving target, while you keep moving.  Evasion is a key skill in combat.  You will find Infant Stounts on the shore just outside the city to the south."
quests.completionMessage: "You are doing very well sister.  Did you know that consuming an Infant Stount tail will increase your health.  Many "meats" have this advantage.  Generally the stronger the creature you obtain the meat from, the more health it is worth."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 4 of 23
quests.description: "Vigons share much in common with Flobs.  Not only do they appear to just be larger versions of the Flobs, but Vigons also share the Flob"s weaknesses and strengths.  I need you to hunt 10 Vigons and bring their shells back to me."
quests.completionMessage: "These are very nice shells.  You have done very well.  Here is your new Crest and some credits to better equip yourself. "  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 5 of 23
quests.description: "I require that you bring me back 10 Fadun and Didon plasmas each. These slimy creatures are part of the blod race, which are completely immobile. But they like to stay in dark dangerous places. Search the sewers of this city for them. The entrance to the sewers is behind the waterfall."
quests.completionMessage: "You are doing excellent!  For the creatures you will be facing next you may want to get some help. They can be very challenging for someone as inexperienced as you."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 6 of 23
quests.description: "Stontriles will be your first adversary that actually lives in the water. The easiest place to fight them would be in the rivers of 4falls. I also want you to hunt down 10 Malia Bats.  They are the great green flying creatures that surround trendor.  Use what you learned from the last confrontation in this new situation."
quests.completionMessage: "Welcome back.  You completed that faster than I had expected.  Very good.  I hope you didn"t find the Stontriles or Malia Bats too complicated.  What am I saying?  I am sure that you had no problem with them.  Here are some credits."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "For the next creature you will definitely want to be wearing the best armor you can. Remember that you can arm your Crests to gain extra stat bonuses."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 7 of 23
quests.description: "Ascherions are giant spiders that reside in the Slotholic Caves. They seem to be breeding by the dozens lately.  We can not let them spread too much or they will eventually try to overrun the town. Be careful while fighting them not to go any further into the cave, or you risk running in to the lesser Spider Lord, Ashadra.  Bring me 10 of their venom sacks. Good luck."
quests.completionMessage: "You emerge from the dark caverns successful!  You are a true amazon warrior.  Here is your next Crest and a bonus to your Weapon Tech.  You can take a rest now if you want but if you are ready just let me know."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 8 of 23
quests.description: "Darius has sent word that they need assistance in taming the Shockion population in the caverns.  I want to you hunt down and retrieve 10 Shockion claws and 10 Adult Shockion claws.  Beware of these creatures, you will definitely want a friend. The best place to find them is on Sial Island.  Good luck!"
quests.completionMessage: "You have done very well.  Darius says that he is going to be keeping his eye on you.  You have to watch out for him.  Here is your next crest, I will see you again soon. Here is a gift to help you stay supplied. Make sure that you take some time just training your Weapon Tech. I know that you can be a great weapons master.  Good luck."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 9 of 23
quests.description: "The Shockions are grumbling about our most recent victory against them. They need to be taught to take their lumps without complaint. I want you to go after them and kill 10 Elite and 5 Elder Shockions. Bring me back their heads for your next crest. Good luck to you sister!"
quests.completionMessage: "Hooray!!  Down with the nasty Shockions!  You have now reached the Crest of options.  Crest 9 allows you to begin your search for your first Rune channel weapon with Emril.  By now you should also feel the need to wear better armor that Sindel may not be able to supply.  The main world of IIA holds many of these answers."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "There is a Master Smith named Glagrog, in the Arilous Mining Caves on the Main World of IIA. He is the only one who can make Phision Armor, a necessity for travel in the Underworld."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 10 of 23
quests.description: "A traitor has been seen retreating to the condemned area.  She has stolen from me and must not be allowed to succeed.  You have been given the honor of retrieving what she has stolen."
quests.completionMessage: "Good work, I knew she would not get far with you on the job. This Adian Scroll contains some of our plans to take out Cain. Here is your next Crest, and a little bonus for keeping our secrets safe."  [More]
quests.hint: "Hurry to the condemned area and stop the traitor."

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 11 of 23
quests.description: "I now need you to hunt the dangerous Mad Kidion Bat and bring me back 5 of their hearts. I will also require you to bring back the Lost Stone which has been taken by some cowardly Elite Shockions. You should already know where to find them, so kill them all until you find the stone."
quests.completionMessage: "Sweet success, I love that feeling. Here is your next crest. If you have not yet obtained your Rune Bow and your Phision Armor, now is a good time to go get it. The next few Crests will be near impossible to complete without them, and you will need your Phision Emblem to enter the underworld."  [More]
quests.hint: "Elite Shockions have stolen the Lost Stone."

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 12 of 23
quests.description: "On the Island of Sluggith in the Old World a two-faced Amphibian named Crea waits.  He is attempting to instigate both the Bloblics and the Amphibians against other and is carrying the material to do so with him. I want the sphere he carries."
quests.completionMessage: "You have performed admirably, my dear. Here is your next crest and a gift from me.  If you do not yet have your Phision and Mulsaki armors and emblems, you will need them to continue.  The emblems will grant you entrance into locked areas."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 13 of 23
quests.description: "Hunt down Eyezoras in the Catacombs or the Four Falls Temple.  I need you to obtain 10 samples of Eyezora DNA. We are trying to engineer weapons that will disrupt their form so we can use them on the spirit world. Return with the samples."
quests.completionMessage: "You have done very well my sister.  Here is your next crest. These DNA samples will assist us in learning more of these creatures, which in turn will help us combat them.  If you haven"t yet gotten your Mulsaki Armor, speak to Ocsylop in the cave of fire about the pieces he has."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 14 of 23
quests.description: "Have you seen any Rancons yet? You probably flew past them as you were on your way to the Eyezoras, but now you must face them head on, for I am in need of a Rancon Emblem. This item is occasionally carried by certain Rancons. Kill as many as it takes to get me my Emblem."
quests.completionMessage: "Again you succeed. Again I bestow your next crest upon you.  If you keep this up you will become one of the finest ladies to represent our group.  I am proud to say that you are with us."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 15 of 23
quests.description: "My lieutenant Nemacy has been detained inside the Cave of the Ancients in the Underworld. She is stuck and needs help to get out. Go to her and help her escape, there is not a moment to lose."
quests.completionMessage: "Glad to hear you were able to help her out. She is usually very resourceful. I believe she may have staged this whole thing to test you. I wouldn"t put that past her. Anyway, you were successful and have earned your next crest. Return when you are rested and ready for my final challenge."  [More]
quests.hint: "Find Nemacy in CoA and help her."

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 19 of 23
quests.description: "I have another warrior in distress, but this time I know it is serious. Please find Xelly. I only know she went to investigate and map the ruins in the Four Falls area. Find her and ensure her safety, then return and report to me."
quests.completionMessage: "I have read Xelly"s message. You have truly proven yourself to me. I reward you now with our highest decoration, the Sixteenth Crest. Stand up straight -- let me look at you. My little Amazon warrior all grown up... I"m so proud! Now, go and wreak havoc on the world in my name... the name of Celeste."
quests.hint: "Find Xelly in the Sun Dial dungeon."

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Complete
quests.description: "You have done all I can ask.  The world is yours to explore."

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 16 of 23
quests.description: "Oh! You are certainly a welcome sight!  These Grisions are giving me a hard time. So you must kill them all until you obtain one of their badges and then bring it to me. Doing that will serve as a sign of your dominance over them, and then they will leave me alone."
quests.completionMessage: "Yes! Great job! Whew... that"s one group down. Okay, now for the Wrights. Oh, didn"t you know I was also having trouble with them also? Let me explain..."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 17 of 23
quests.description: "There are also a group of Wrights that have been waiting to step in if the Grisions gave up. You need to do the same thing with them. Kill them all until you obtain a Wright Badge, then bring it to me."
quests.completionMessage: "Oh, that was great work. It was poetry in motion. Keep up the good work and you will be my superior officer before long. I can"t wait to try you out in the arena. Take this." [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 18 of 23
quests.description: "What I gave you is a letter for Celeste.  If she asks about me this will explain all she needs to know from me.  My name is Nemacy."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I do require help.  But the help I require is beyond what you can supply."
quests.completionMessage: "Please help me, O great warrior! I am on a terribly difficult mission."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 20 of 23
quests.description: "I have been tasked with the mission to find a High Priest Robe. I know there is one around here somewhere, but I can"t seem to find one where I"m standing.  Perhaps you could look around and find one for me."
quests.completionMessage: "Wonderful, you"ve found one! This is one half of what I still have left to do. The other part is for me to obtain the Elder Eye, an artifact lost in these ruins."  [More]

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 21 of 23
quests.description: "I have reason to believe that the Elder Eye has been found and picked up by the Wrights. You must kill all the Wrights you can and find the one that has the Elder Eye so we can recover it. Once you have it, bring it to me. I"ll guard this area, and you go that way."
quests.completionMessage: "You have done it! Wow, what a great job. Take this letter to Celeste. It will be a pleasant surprise for her. I"ll see you back at the treehouse!"
quests.hint: "Kill Wrights until you find the Elder Eye."

quests.title: Celeste Quest: Part 22 of 23
quests.description: "If Celeste asks, tell her I said hi.  Make sure you keep an eye out for Cain.  I have the feeling he is lurking again."

quests.title: Uato Armor
quests.description: "I make Uato Armor for our warriors often. I will give you an extra piece I have lying around if you will do something for me. Bring me 5 Infant Dilirium Eyes and 2 Vigon shells."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you for helping me out. Here is a piece of Uato Armor. If it is not to your liking, I can always get you another... that is, IF you will get me another 5 Infant Dilirium Eyes  and another 2 Vigon Shells!"

quests.title: Vigon Armor
quests.description: "Oh, yes. Vigon Armor is quite popular right now. I will give you an extra piece I have lying around if you will do something for me. Bring me 3 Clegorn Tongues and 8 Vigon Shells."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you for helping me out. Here is a piece of Vigon Armor. If it is not to your liking, I can always get you another... that is, IF you will get me another 3 Clegorn Tongues and another 8 Vigon Shells!"

quests.title: Maun Armor
quests.description: "Maun Armor is all the rage right now. Everybody is wearing it. I will give you an extra piece I have lying around if you will do something for me. Bring me 5 Clegorn Tongues and 5 Adult Shockion Claws."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you for helping me out. Here is a piece of Maun Armor. If it is not to your liking, I can always get you another... that is, IF you will get me another 5 Clegorn Tongues and another 5 Adult Shockion Claws!"

quests.title: Fision Armor
quests.description: "Fision Armor has become "the" style right now. Don"t you miss out on the fashion boom. I will give you an extra piece I have lying around if you will do something for me. Bring me 5 Malia Bats and 3 Elite Shockions."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you for helping me out. Here is a piece of Fision Armor. If it is not to your liking, I can always get you another... that is, IF you will get me another 5 Malia Bats and another 3 Elite Shockions"

quests.title: Poldas Armor
quests.description: "If you aren"t wearing Poldas right now, you might as well go naked. I will give you an extra piece I have lying around if you will do something for me. Bring me 5 Elite Shockions and 2 Elder Shockions."
quests.completionMessage: "Thank you for helping me out. Here is a piece of Poldas Armor. If it is not to your liking, I can always get you another... that is, IF you will get me another 5 Elite Shockions and 2 Elder Shockions!"

quests.title: Phision Armor
quests.completionMessage: "You have reached the limit of my ability, sister. The only person I know of that can make you a set of Phision Armor is Glagrog the smith in the Arilous Mining Caves of the old world. Good luck."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "If you have not gone through Celeste"s trials, believe me, you are nowhere near ready to attempt this."
quests.completionMessage: "I am Emril, your guide to the runes of IIA. The keepers of the runes are unique creatures unlike any other on IIA.  Most are trapped in their own realms separate from the main world and the only way to reach them is through a Crystal Portal."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Talk
quests.completionMessage: "A key is required to enter each portal.  I will be giving them to you one at a time.  Here is an Amulet of Rune Protection that will give you added protection against each of the Rune Bosses."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 1 of 10
quests.description: "Your first assignment will not involve keys or portals, for Lord Shraderix has been traped not in his own realm, but in the Black Market caves. You must bring me the Living Rune that Lord Shraderix carries."
quests.completionMessage: "You defeated Lord Shraderix?  You may very well be cut out for this sort of quest.  The key you hold is to Lord Shipron"s crystal and will let you enter his lair. The Crystal portal is located on the south end of Sluggith Island."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat Shraderix in the Black Market Cavern

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 2 of 10
quests.description: "Remember to arm your amulet when you are in his presence. If you do not return with the Earth Rune from Lord Shipron, you won"t get to move on. It"s just that simple."
quests.completionMessage: "I see that you"ve managed to defeat Lord Shipron. His realm is only the first you must conquor. Here is your next rune key.  It will give you access to Frube"s realm."  [More]
quests.hint: Shipron"s portal is on Sluggith Island

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 3 of 10
quests.description: "Frube"s lair is on the Root of the Oracle. Just remember...She"s just a big puppy dog.  Go easy on him.  He will drop the Bio Rune."
quests.completionMessage: "Like I said, big puppy dog. Here is your next rune key."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat Frube on the Root of the Oracle

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 4 of 10
quests.description: "Now you must seek the Water Rune and return with it.  Zorphion resides in the ocean west of the Arilious Mines near the Trisk Hive."
quests.completionMessage: "You"re always guaranteed to get wet with Zorphion.  Here is your next rune key."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 5 of 10
quests.description: "You will need to find the keeper of the Fire Rune next, and bring your objective back to me. Skelcy is on the highest hill on the southern part of Black Market Island."
quests.completionMessage: "You are wiping the floor with these so-called Rune "Bosses". Here is your next rune key."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat Skelcy on Black Market Island

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 6 of 10
quests.description: "Find the keeper of the Tech Rune, and tear the rune from his feeble grasp. Then step over his lifeless corpse as you leave.  You will find the Destroyer"s portal in the Petrified Forest."
quests.completionMessage: "Very good.  You are doing quite well."  [More]
quests.hint: Destroyer"s portal is in the Petrified Forest

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 7 of 10
quests.description: "You must now find the Grey Stone Rune and dispose of its keeper. Slate, you will find on top a high peak of Sail Island.  There are two crystals on that island, each one leading to a different Rune Boss.  The key will only grant you entrance into Slate"s lair."
quests.completionMessage: "Again, you are doing wonderfully."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Slate"s portal on Sial Island

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 8 of 10
quests.description: "You now must seek the Blue Stone Rune.  This key will give you entrance to the other crystal on Sial Island.  The entrance to Brike."
quests.completionMessage: "You should know that Brike and Slate were both once peaceful brothers who were cursed by the Supreme High Priest of Crom."  [More]
quests.hint: Find Brike"s portal on Sial Island

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 9 of 10
quests.description: "The entrance to Zeth is on Unity Outpost. What makes him difficult is his lair. You"ll need to figure out a way to kill him while he"s over a solid surface, else you will lose his body and the Future Rune."
quests.completionMessage: "Here is the next and final rune key."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Part 10 of 10
quests.description: "This is it! The final rune boss, Pridion. I almost wish there were a few more just so I could watch your dominance continue. Pridion"s Portal Crystal is on the south tip of Moon"s Rift Island."
quests.completionMessage: "You make me wish I was still training."  [More]

quests.title: Rune Quest: Complete
quests.description: "I am glad to have been your guide. You have earned our rune weapon, the Kv Runebow."

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Fernandez Intro
quests.description: "The Amphibious race sometimes needs to do difficult things that must not become common knowledge. I am Underworld Fernandez leader of the Underground Frog Movement. We protect our kind from all hidden threats."
quests.completionMessage: "The Amphibious race sometimes needs to do difficult things that must not become common knowledge. I am Underworld Fernandez leader of the Underground Frog Movement. We protect our kind from all hidden threats. I have heard of you and have a special assignment for you."  [More]

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Envelope
quests.completionMessage: "Our agent Olo Fisher has hidden a vital piece of intelligence that we need to recover. Search the Arilous Mining Caves for an envelope. It should be in a man-made section, not in the common caves. Agent Fisher is known for hiding things well, so you will need to examine the area."  [More]

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Envelope
quests.description: "Once you"ve found the envelope in the Arilous Mines, meet up with Sailor Toad on the large beach of the Bloblic Colonies. This is east of the building structure. Once you meet up with him, he will give further instruction."
quests.completionMessage: "So, Bo"s message was intercepted by the enemy. We will need to get word to him to change his plans. You know, we used to be enemies before this common threat made us allies, but not all members of either race have put aside our differences."  [More]
quests.hint: Take the envelope to Sailor Toad at Bloblic beach

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Rogue Bloblic and Partner
quests.description: "We have been informed that Aria managed to send her pet to kill Strife. The pet is suspected to be armed with explosives, this threat has to be stopped. Strife has given us permission to intercept the explosives however we can. The creature is on the run now from the Arilous Mining caves. We estimate you only have fifteen minutes before it leaves the area. Capture the explosives and incapacitate the creature at all costs."
quests.completionMessage: "Fabulous.  You retrieved the explosives. But wait, these are Grez-Orb"s explosives, this is bad news, I will have to meditate on this. Here"s a Token of Strife to recognize your efforts towards our cause...We just now received some more alarming news."  [More]
quests.hint: Quickly, find and stop the Visgate by Mining Caves

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: DNA
quests.description: "Darius has been experimenting on the Eyemba race. Even though he is our ally, he must not upset the delicate balance of nature that sustains life in IIA. I need you to retrieve 20 Eyemba Eye samples and bring them to Dr. Toad. He will test them against what we have on file to see if they have been genetically altered."
quests.completionMessage: "Good work. In matters such as this, diplomacy is the best solution. We will forward this to Strife and let him take up his concerns with Darius. Well done. In exchange for your valuable service, I have used Mind Control to fully mature your stontrile larva into a fully functioning weapon." [More]
quests.hint: Take 20 Eyemba Eyes to Dr. Toad

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Stontrile
quests.description: -Never used-
quests.completionMessage: "This weapon is a testimony of the amphibious mastery of Mind Control, it may not be the most powerful weapon avaliable, but it has an elegance few other weapons possess." [More]

quests.title: Stontrile Quest: Complete
quests.description: "Now, remember to use your newfound power for good, and not evil. Have fun!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "If you miss one, you must start over."
quests.completionMessage: "I am ready to spawn the next Gonlon. It will be on the beach in a cove on the east coast, right outside the back entrance to the Solothic Caves."  [Ready?]

quests.title: Termine Training: Lesson 2 Part 4 of 6
quests.description: "Spawned! Hurry, you only have 5 minutes to find and kill the Gonlon!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "You seem lost."
quests.completionMessage: "The Gonlon I spawn is toward the south-eastern side of the Main Island, just south of Death Valley. It will be under a square canopy."  [Ready?]

quests.title: Termine Training: Lesson 2 Part 2 of 6
quests.description: "You have 7 minutes to defeat the next Gonlon."
quests.hint: Under a canopy, S of DV, SE side of Island

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Those who have taken the first steps of flight can benefit from my teachings."
quests.completionMessage: "I see you have earned your Inceptor License. You must be ready to begin my Advanced Inceptor Training. My specialized training involves utilizing your jetpack for both transportation and combat maneuvers. When you finish with me you will be ready to take on any airborne foe."  [More]

quests.title: Advanced Inceptor Training: Lesson 1
quests.description: "Look sharp. For your first lesson you must complete some basic combat maneuvers with your jetpack. I have conjured a Gonlon at the top of the tallest pillar just to the southeast of where we stand. You have 30 minutes to locate it, destroy it, and bring me back the Orb it carries."
quests.completionMessage: "You completed that with the grace of someone who just learned how to walk. That was intended to be a compliment. Lesson 2 will involve air to air combat with a summoned Kidion Bat."  [More]
quests.hint: Kill the Gonlan SE of Samuan on the tall pillar

quests.title: Advanced Inceptor Training: Lesson 2
quests.description: "Now listen up recruit, Your next lesson will require you to locate a Kidion bat flying above the structure to the Northeast. Be careful as there may be two bats. Concentrate on the stationary one. You also have 30 minutes to locate and destroy it, Make sure to bring me back the Orb it carries."
quests.completionMessage: "That wasn"t so bad, was it? You have officially earned your next license; the Advanced Inceptor License."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat the bat NE of Samuan over the high platform

quests.title: Advanced Inceptor Training Complete
quests.description: "If you would like to find vehicles to pilot, you should go to Trendor and speak with Amblik. Show him your Advanced Inceptor License."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "It is a beautiful day to be driving."
quests.completionMessage: "Hello! As you doubtless have heard, I am the foremost authority in Vehicle Training. I can fly, drive or pilot anything that moves. I can also teach you to improve your skills in this area."  [More]

quests.title: Termine Training: Preparation
quests.description: "First you will need  at least 10 Warp Cells. These can be purchased at any reputable engineering shop."
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent, you are ready to begin. I"m going to let you keep your Warp Cells. Before you start my first lesson, use them to mount your Hoverbike, then vault the remaining cells. Also, make sure you have ammo and heals, for part of my training will consist of vehicle combat."  [More]

quests.title: Termine Training: Preparation
quests.completionMessage: "The purpose of my lessons will be to enable you to mount your hoverbike with little or no failure.  Your first obstacle will be mountainous terrain. I have placed four locked containers in the region of Four Falls. There is one at each waterfall."  [More]

quests.title: Termine Training: Lesson 1
quests.description: "Find each container and unlock all four in order. Return to me with the contents of the last container. Keep your eyes open, for while most of the containers are in the water, not all of them are."
quests.completionMessage: "I am pleased that you were successful. Your reward is a bonus in your piloting skill. You should be able to mount your Hoverbike with greater success, but you will probably still fail occasionally.  You should be in your vehicle before continuing."  [More]
quests.hint: One container near each waterfall in 4Falls

quests.title: Termine Training: Lesson 1 1/2
quests.completionMessage: "For Lesson 2, you are going to travel across the bridge and all the way to the end of the Uoc Penn Peninsula. During this trek, you must find and defeat five Gonlons. Nearby each Gonlon will be one of my helpers. After defeating each Gonlon, speak to the closest helper who will tell you where to find the next Gonlon."  [Ready?]

quests.title: Termine Training: Lesson 2 Part 1 of 6
quests.description: "I have just spawned the first Gonlon on the other side of the Bloblic Bridge. You have 8 minutes to find it and kill it. Go!!"
quests.completionMessage: "Well done indeed! You have successfully completed my Termine License training, and I hereby award you with your Termine License. You have also earned a boost in piloting skill. At this skill level you should be able to mount your Hoverbike with ease."  [More]

quests.title: Termine Training: Complete
quests.description: "And because you have been such a good student, I am also giving you 10 Warp Cells as a bonus.  With the Termine license you are qualified for your next vehicle.  Amblik can help you with that, now that you are ready."
quests.completionMessage: "Yes. the Acroamatic License is the latest measure of skill in vehicle handling. Plus, it is quite attractively laminated with a 3D holographic picture! Take a look at mine. Impressive, isn"t it? Unfortunately for you, they have not delivered the official training materials to this part of the galaxy yet, so I cannot certify anyone at this time. Too bad, so sad. Try back next week."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Greetings, ground-bound. Isn"t it time you got off your feet and into the sky? Glad to hear it! Now, unless you prove to me that you have the skills to be a safe pilot, I won"t license you. And if I don"t license you, nobody else will. First you will need a level 1 Jetpack which you can buy at the store."
quests.completionMessage: "Great! Press the ForceJet key to use your jetpack, I have armed it for you if you had not done so before. Alright, listen up! I have provided you with your first piloting lesson pass. Let me explain the first lesson to you."  [More]

quests.title: Introduction to Fly:  Lesson 1
quests.description: "Okay. For your first piloting lesson utilizing your jet pack, you must search for a canister on the largest hill outside of trendor, and return to me with the contents inside. When you have done this I will allow you to continue on to lesson 2. Good luck and remember, be a defensive flyer!!"
quests.completionMessage: "Here is the key for your second lesson.The next task will be more difficult. You need to exit the city, and find the next canister. Walk around trendor a few times, and you will find it. "  [More]

quests.title: Introduction to Fly:  Lesson 2
quests.description: "Report to me when you have the lesson orb."
quests.completionMessage: "Nice job, you did it! I trust you"ve made me proud and didn"t fall too many times. Alright! You have now earned your Inceptor License. This will allow you to legally utilize your Level 1 jetpack. Now then, if you want to be able to use more advanced methods of transportation you will have to complete additional training" [More]
quests.hint: I don"t want to walk around in circles....

quests.title: Introduction to Fly:  Complete
quests.description: "You must see Samuan on the west side of Black Market Island for this next training step . He resides in a bunker on the western side of the island. Show him your Inceptor License and tell him you are ready to start training for the Advanced Inceptor License. Good luck!"
quests.hint: "Find Samuan on the West side of Black Market Island."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I made a wish that somewhere in the world someone cares about you. Aren"t I nice?"
quests.completionMessage: "I will spawn the last of the Gonlons you must fight.  It will be on the northern beach on the Main Island, just outside of the northern water entrance to the Solothic Caves.  When you are completed, return to Rumula with the 5th orb."  [Ready?]
quests.hint: Beach outside north water exit of Solothic caves

quests.title: Termine Training: Lesson 2 Part 5 of 6
quests.description: "Spawned! Hurry, you only have 4 minutes to find and kill it."
quests.hint: "Beach outside north water exit of Solothic caves."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I could help but I"m choosing not to."
quests.completionMessage: "I am ready to spawn the next Gonlon. the location is the west side of the Main Island near the edge of the Petrified Forest. This is just north of the Destroyer Rune Crystal Portal. The Gonlon will be in a little gully."  [Ready?]

quests.title: Termine Training: Lesson 2 Part 3 of 6
quests.description: "Spawned! Hurry, you only have 6 minutes to find and kill it!"
quests.hint: North of Destroyer Crystal in forest gully

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "There are pilots for each race willing to train their own how to fly. Vehicles might seem completely different from jetpacks, but they still require a high level of pilot training to operate. If you want my help acquiring any vehicles, you need to show me your Advanced Inceptor License."
quests.completionMessage: "This scenario is real easy. I can"t sell you one of these vehicles, but I can make you one.  All you need to do is track down the parts I need and [CLAP] there"s your brand spanking new vehicle.  Here"s a list of the parts I need."  [More]

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 1 of 23
quests.completionMessage: "One bottle of cheap wine... whoops, wrong list! Ok here it is: 1 Hover Sonic Engine, 1 Plasma Screen, 1 Plasma Fuel Case, 1 Plasma Fuel Cell, 1 Plasma Fuel Injector, 1 Hover Xtx Hull, 1 set of Sonic Engine Mounts, and 1 Slider Attack Shield. Got all that?"  [More]

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 2 of 23
quests.description: "You"ll need to find my friends Huran the Smith, Yelvien the Alchemist and Lorut the Engineer to make these components for you. Fortunately, Lorut is in this city, he"ll be easy to find.  Give him this fuser I, uh... "borrowed" from him."
quests.completionMessage: "Great job. Let"s see how this is supposed to fit together now... this must go here...This piece doesn"t fit unless you twist it... [snap!] Oops. Well that probably wasn"t an important part anyway. Okay, here we go. All the necessary information is packed into this polyaluminum schema board."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and speak to Huran, Yelvien and Lorut

quests.title: Hoverbike: Part 23 of 23
quests.completionMessage: "To use the hoverbike just use the schematic. Adding it to your quick bar will make it easy to do. Mounting the hoverbike will use a Warp Cell. It"s that simple. "  [More]

quests.title: Hoverbike: Complete
quests.description: "As a final word of advice, go find my Bloblic buddy Rumula somewhere near the Bloblic City. He will help you get your next license.  Show me the Termine License and I"ll steer you in the right direction to obtain your next vehicle. Stay stoked, dude!"
quests.completionMessage: "Hey, welcome back! Sure, I can help you score a Hydrocraft, but it won"t be easy. You are gonna have to hunt down the Bubblesub Bandits. They ransacked the last cargo shipment with all of the necessary components for the next batch of Hydrocrafts. Word is that they also have some parts for the subs themselves." [More]
quests.hint: Locate Rumula near Bloblic Colony bridge

quests.title: Hydrocraft: Part 1 of 2
quests.description: "If you"re ready I am uploading a list of the components that I will need to your journal. The Bubblesub Bandits were last seen roaming the Dark Sea area and off the southern coast of the Main Island. Be careful, they are some tough cookies. If you can bring me all of the components the hydro is yours. Good luck!"
quests.completionMessage: "Way to go! Now, let me make your schema board. [uurrKK!!] Cheap rivet kits nowadays... [SKKTTCHHVVRRRRR!] Done! Hey, I have some pieces left over... oh well. Save those for next time. All the necessary information is now packed into this polyaluminum schema board." [More]
quests.hint: Hunt the Bandits for the Hydro components

quests.title: Hydrocraft: Complete
quests.completionMessage: "If you don"t already have one, buy a Vehicle Warp Device from the Engineering Shop and then USE this schematic. It will be stored in the memory of the Warp Device. Then you just USE the Warp Device to warp in your Hydrocraft. It"s that simple. Well, it"s been real and it"s been fun. But I"m not sure it"s been real fun. Hah! Later."  [More]

quests.title: Bubblesub: Part 1 of 2
quests.description: "Hey you know I can finally make Bubblesubs!  Yeah, yeah, but just like the Hydro Craft, those damned bandits ended up with most of the parts.  Some of the components can be gotten elsewhere by talking to other people like me. Anyhow, I am uploading a list of the components to your journal. Get them all if you want me to make a sub for you."
quests.completionMessage: "Way to go! Now, let me make your schema board. [uurrKK!!] Cheap rivet kits nowadays... [SKKTTCHHVVRRRRR!] Done! Hey, I have some pieces left over... oh well. Save those for next time. All the necessary information is now packed into this polyaluminum schema board." [More]
quests.hint: Hunt the Bandits for the Sub components

quests.title: Bubblesub: Complete
quests.description: "If you don"t already have one, buy a Vehicle Warp Device from the Engineering Shop and then USE this schematic. It will be stored in the memory of the Warp Device. Then you just USE the Warp Device to warp in your Hydrocraft. It"s that simple. Well, it"s been real and it"s been fun. But I"m not sure it"s been real fun. Hah! Later."

quests.title: Intro

quests.completionMessage: "Each of these three portals are labeled with a channel.  Which of these channels were not represented during this trial?  Choose correctly and your prize awaits."
