quests.hint: Get these items and the others listed in your journal.

quests.title: Mace Upgrade
quests.description: "Ah, so you have come to upgrade your Mace of Crushing Gale? I can help you, but I need a few parts to be able to do this. All these parts can be found on a Gauntlance Razor luckily. But I will also need a little something for my trouble. A stone hut should do nicely."
quests.completionMessage: "Ah, yes, there we go. Thank you very much, and here is your upgraded Mace. If you get the required items for me again, I might be able to do a better job."

quests.title: Information
quests.completionMessage: The west part of the limestone block base and lower part of the core of the temple"s north wall were probably completed during the ruler"s lifetime, while the remaining clay masonry would be attributable to his son, Shepseskaf. Just behind the portal to the temple there was a square antechamber adorned with four columns.

quests.title: Information 2
quests.completionMessage: This valley temple was part of the funerary complex including along with the pyramid (with its burial chamber) a mortuary temple (joining the pyramid on its east side), and a covered causeway leading to the valley temple. The purpose of these valley temples has been debated: they could have been used for the mummification process or perhaps for the "opening of the mouth" ceremony, when the "ka" entered the deceased person"s body

quests.title: Information
quests.completionMessage: Like Menkaure"s predecessors on the Giza Plateau, his mortuary temple was not built adjacent to his pyramid"s east wall. The original temple obviously remained partially uncompleted, we believe, as a result of Menkaure"s sudden death. Menkaure began this mortuary temple, as had Khafre, with core blocks of limestone that were locally quarried. The heaviest of these, found at the northwest corner of the temple, is the heaviest known at Giza, weighing some 200 tons.

quests.title: Information 2
quests.completionMessage: In this particular temple, this is Menkaure’s altar.  It consists of an entrance hall (a vestibule), a square-shaped courtyard, a porticus (a hall with columns) that leads to the sacrificial hall which was equipped with several chambers. These contained religious items and provisions which were sacrificed to the deceased king. The mortuary temple was for the funeral and the subsequent worship of the king.

quests.title: Information
quests.completionMessage: The causeway of this pyramid complex leading from the Valley temple to the Mortuary Temple was most likely completed by Shepseskaf.  It has floors made of limestone blocks and highly compressed clay mixed with limestone fragments. The mudbrick walls that were a little more than two meters thick supported a roof.

quests.title: Information 2
quests.completionMessage: Was originally created as a ramp to deliver stone. The causeway is bent slightly south, and almost 500 meters long.

quests.title: Information
quests.completionMessage:
The three queen"s pyramids to the east are the most noteworthy of several queen pyramids around Giza. The southern belongs to Hensutsen.  The northernmost belongs to Merites, the sister and wife of Cheops. The one in the middle is disputed, it might belong to the mother Redjedef. That would make her Cheops" wife.
The queen"s pyramids were used over and over again for tomb purposes. Shafts were dug next to them, and independent tombs (mastabas) were built as close to them as possible.

quests.title: Intro
quests.completionMessage: "ey you. Yeah, you! C"mere. I gots a big problem. I overbooked meself, and I gots all dis paypawoik to finish. If youse can help me wit me hit list - er... me ASSIGNMENTS, I"ll give ya some decent cash! Youse ain"t da squeamish type, is ya? Good! Now listen up..." [More]

quests.title: Intro 1
quests.completionMessage: "Like I was sayin, dis will be a cinch. All youse gotsta do is encourage a few local creatures to have a few unfoitchanit axi-dents, know what I mean? [wink wink] It"s all on the up and up, see? So no need to go tellin" anyone about it. When you is ready to take on da foist job, lemme know." [More]

quests.title: Spawn 1: Spawn
quests.completionMessage: "Awright, glad to have yaz aboard. Now, da foist victim - er, I mean target is dis nasty naton. He should be just inside dis cave a ways. Take "im out and bring me back his shell. I"ll give yez 200 credits and you can keep what he drops. Cappice?"

quests.title: Spawn 1
quests.description: "Whatcha doin" still talkin" to me?"
quests.completionMessage: "Excellent! Pleasure doin" business witcha! Here"s da cash, and 30 credits extra "cuz I like yez. Come back when you gots some more time, I still gots a few more entries on me list that need to be taught a lesson, know what I mean?"

quests.title: Spawn 2: Spawn
quests.completionMessage: "ey, good ta see ya again. Listen, just inside dis cave is dis really mean slabon dat owes some money to da wrong people. Get in there and show "im dat he"s made a bad decision. I"ll pay yez 300 credits if you bring me back his shell. You keep what he drops. Sound good?"

quests.title: Spawn 2
quests.description: "Whatcha doin" still talkin" to me?"
quests.completionMessage: "Good woik! You is fast makin" a name for yezself wit my backers. Keep it up and you"ll go places, see? Here"s da cash and a little bonus. Come back when you can help me out some more."

quests.title: Spawn 3: Spawn
quests.completionMessage: "Right on time, eh? I gots to tell yez, there"s a mean ol" lidion back in dis cave that needs a good thrashin". Youse go back there and show it who"s boss, okay? I"ll give yez 450 credits if yez brings me its shell. Youse can keep whatever cash it drops. Now get movin."

quests.title: Spawn 3
quests.description: "Whatcha doin" still talkin" to me?"
quests.completionMessage: "Great job again. Youse is one of da most dependable flunkies I"ve ever had! Here"s da cash, and a little something extra. Catch me again when you"ve got some time to kill. Heh. Heh heh heh!"

quests.title: Spawn 4: Spawn
quests.completionMessage: "Quick, good ta see ya and all dat. Get inside da cave and take care of dat pesky clegorn. I"d do it meself, but like I told yez before, I"m swamped wit paypawoik. I"ll give yez 500 credits if you bring me back his tongue. You keep whatever cash he drops. Hurry!"

quests.title: Spawn 4
quests.description: "Whatcha doin" still talkin" to me?"
quests.completionMessage: "Amazin", as usual! Here"s da cash and your bonus. I gots some bigger plans for youse when you are ready for some more woik. Make sure you gots plenty of supplies before we talk again."

quests.title: Intermission 1
quests.completionMessage: "It"s you! Good ta see ya again. Hey, listen. Up to now these targets have been small change, ya know? Stay away from "em and they can"t hurtcha. But now, the stakes are a little higher, eh? These next class of palookas will shoot yez from a distance, okay? Still interested? [More]

quests.title: Spawn 5: Spawn
quests.completionMessage: "Get ready, cuz there"s a rogue shockion inside da cave somewhere. Like usual, it owes me money. Get in there and show him some manners for me. Bring me back his claws and I"ll give ya the usual reward. Keep whatever else you find."

quests.title: Spawn 5
quests.description: "Whatcha doin" still talkin" to me?"
quests.completionMessage: "Say, you took care of that shockion pretty quick-like. I guess you are getting pretty tough. Hey, you keep woiking like dis, and you"ll start hornin" in on MY racket, hah! Heh heh, yeah. Heh heh... Hmmm, well you can come back when youse is ready for more woik."

quests.title: Spawn 6: Spawn
quests.completionMessage: "Youse again. Hmmph. Okay, here"s something that won"t be a cinch for ya. There"s a jouster loose in da cave, and as usual, it owes me money. Teach "im a lesson and bring me back his tongue. If it"s too hard fer ya, just let me know."

quests.title: Spawn 6
quests.description: "Whatcha doin" still talkin" to me?"
quests.completionMessage: "Lemme see that toungue. Harrumph... okay, I guess you wasted "im. Here"s yer cash. No bonus, though. That was, eh.. an easy mark. Don"t go away mad, though. I got more woik for ya, if ya have the guts, that is. Yes sir, heh."

quests.title: Spawn 7: Spawn
quests.completionMessage: "Whadda you want? Oh, still up for some of my woik, eh? Well it just so happens I got a job that needs doin". Inside da cave somewhere is an Elite Ascherion. Should be a piece o" cake for da big bad hit man. So get goin, already."

quests.title: Spawn 7
quests.description: "Whatcha doin" still talkin" to me?"
quests.completionMessage: "Yeah, yeah. You don"t surprise me anymore, here"s yer cash. Just keep yer hands where I can see "em, alright? My backers are saying youse are getting too strong fer me to keep woiking witcha. Dey say youse might try to put me outta business, eh? Don"t even think about it."

quests.title: Spawn 8: Spawn
quests.completionMessage: "Heh heh heh... what? Why am I laughing? Oh, nuttin". Never mind, now listen, I got another job fer ya. Look for little slim jim inside da cave here. He ain"t big, so just go squash him and come back for yer cash. Heh heh..."

quests.title: Spawn 8
quests.description: "Whatcha doin" still talkin" to me?"
quests.completionMessage: "What? Lemme see dem claws... pah! Youse is da most exasperatin" thug to woik wit I ever see"d. Now I don"t wanna see youse around here anymore, consider me and my business off limits, do ya hear?"

quests.title: Intermission 2
quests.completionMessage: "Okay, look buddy. I know youse ain"t no pushover, an" I do appreshee-ate all da help youse has given me. But listen, I got dis business and nothing else, and I ain"t layin" down for nobody. So you steer clear of me, unless you wanna deal wit my bodyguard."

quests.title: Spawn 9: Spawn
quests.completionMessage: "OKAY, SCUMBAG! YOUSE ASKED FOR IT!"

quests.title: Spawn 9
quests.description: "DIEEEE!!!"
quests.completionMessage: "Wait! Okay, uh... look. Take dis money. It"s all I got left after paying my backers. You and me go our separate ways and dats da end of it. If you wanna start your own business up, I"ll move out. Just stay away from me!"

quests.title: Complete
quests.description: "You"se heard what I said, Scram!"

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I have specific instructions not to talk to anyone unless my master Tinker sends them."
quests.completionMessage: "I"m so happy Tinker was able to find a guinea p.... I mean a volunt... Uh, I mean a pioneer... Yes, thats it, a pioneer. Remember, this baby is a might touchy. Your mileage may vary." [More]

quests.title: Find the material
quests.description: "Tinker has sent me the supplies you gathered for him, and I"m glad to see you still had the Plasma. This new version of the T-9000(tm) requires some additional "special" material in order to operate. We had the supplies readied for the experiment, but over the course of two nights the supplies were taken. I believe some of the material was taken by those damn Mayzoras. Please seek them out and try to find the one carrying the material."
quests.completionMessage: "I was right, it was the Mayzoras. Just wait till Tinker hears about this.. Thanks. But this is not enough, I need the other half of the material." [More]
quests.hint: Mayzoras can be found in Black Market and Moons Rift

quests.title: The other half
quests.description: "I"m fairly sure that the other half of the material was taken by a Slimdon spy. I"m not exactly sure why they took it, but we"re not going to get anywhere without it. Please retrieve it. Good luck finding the right Slimdon."
quests.completionMessage: "I am so pleased that you found it. Here, I still have the Plasma you brought to me. You"ll need it to use the machine. The remaining supplies have been loaded up and the T-9000 v. 2.0(tm) is ready to go. Just step in."

quests.title: Experiment Ready
quests.description: "What are you waiting for... hop on in. It won"t bite..."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "I require a referral for my consult. See my underling Gleebert."
quests.completionMessage: "I"ve not much time for nonsense. Gleebert referred you? ..and you have the items? OK listen up." [More]

quests.title: Mystic Material 1
quests.description: "That Tinker, with his silly gadgets, really thinks he has something there. But lets see him modify an Aqualaz. Well he can"t. My only problem is my minions have skipped out on me. Hunt Mayzoras until you find the two-faced one that took what is mine."
quests.completionMessage: "One down, one to go. My other agent was of the Slimdon race. Hunt Slimdons. Nothing wrong with a little bloodshed when it comes to them. They are wicked, and untrustworthy." [More]
quests.hint: Mayzoras can be found in Black Market Caves

quests.title: Mystic Material 2
quests.description: "Go now, get me the other half of the materials I need.. confounded Slimdons. A slippery race, they are."
quests.completionMessage: "Good. Now I just extract the eyes from this head...I use the mystical material to transfer the power of the Amberlaz to the Aqualaz, and seal and enhance the power with this extract I have made from the eyes...Here you go! A (potentially) upgraded Aqualaz." [More]
quests.hint: Slimdons are found on Black Market

quests.title: Complete
quests.description: "That weapon should prove most useful to you. Yes I know you may not be happy with the results, but you can always try again. But I"ve had enough of you for now. If you want to talk again, see my student Gleebert."

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: "Blapstion told me to expect someone bearing a communique from Vecapan. Apparently you are not this person."
quests.completionMessage: "Blapstion had told me to expect your arrival, though I did not expect this. "The Cross of Bane! You have done well. Cain"s power grows, as does his influence. He knows we are close to defeating him and he panics. He has taken over the mind of one of Blapstion"s brothers in an attempt to distract us. Yet in so doing he has spread his power too thin."  [More]

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!
quests.description: "I need you to find and defeat Blapstion"s brother on Sial Island. If you succeed, Cain"s power will be diminished enough to make him vulnerable. Go quickly."
quests.completionMessage: "Well done! Your defeat of Tispton has dealt a heavy blow to Cain. Now he is ripe for defeat."  [More]
quests.hint: Defeat Blapstion"s brother Tispton on Slal Island

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Fight!!
quests.description: "He has had to assume material form deep within these Catacombs in order to recover his strength.  Go now and defeat him."
quests.completionMessage: "You have done it! Cain has been defeated, and with the loss of his material form we have managed to imprison his spirit once more. We are in your debt. Take this token, and turn it in to Blapstion"s servant whenever you are ready for your reward."  [More]
quests.hint: Find and defeat Cain in the Catacombs

quests.title: Armor 13 Quest: Complete
quests.description: "Have you tried out the armor you earned?"
quests.hint: Redeem Blapstion"s token with his servant

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: Why are you here? This fortress is for the Clan that controls Su"sojka. Don"t look at me that way. My clan has controlled Su"Sojka for more years than you can count.
quests.completionMessage: Ah, so your mighty clan has taken over the Air Kingdom. Maybe you can help me then...

quests.title: Step 1 intro
quests.description: Take over the Air Kingdom already!
quests.completionMessage: You see, my clan is the last remaining combat clan of the Kziian race, and I fear that we are decaying. I need you to help me unite the clan again. I need you to go to each of my head clan members and get the item they have all been entrusted with.

quests.title: Legacy quest - Step 1
quests.description: The first person you have to seek out is Brill, you can find him somewhere close to a Mad Kidion nest. You will also have to keep control of the Air Kingdom.
quests.completionMessage: Ah, you got his item back, good work. I can sense that uniting the clan won"t take long with your help.

quests.title: Legacy Quest - Step 2
quests.description: The next clan head you have to seek out is named Qhef"r, he is located somewhere near an old arena. Remember to keep control of the Air Kingdom.
quests.completionMessage: So you got his item as well? I"m so glad that he agreed to join us again, I was almost thinking that he would never come back!

quests.title: Legacy Quest - Step 3
quests.description: The final clanmate you have to seek out is named Fen"mir, the last time anybody saw him, he was doing something near the Death Torik"s domain. You have to be in control of the Air Kingdom for both him and me to talk to you.
quests.completionMessage: Finally! The entire clan is back together! You will soon have your reward.

quests.title: Legacy Quest - Step 4
quests.description: I just need one last thing from you, I need you to kill the overking which recides in the Four Falls crypt and bring me the loot.
quests.completionMessage: Thank you. My assistant, Alvin, will take your Strength and Dexterety rings. Give him these items, you will also need one more item...now where did I put it? Oh yea... there"s an upstart clanmember named Theodore who I recommend avoiding. If he had is way, he"d take Alvin"s job.
quests.hint: Kill the Overking in the crypt

quests.title: Legacy Quest - End
quests.completionMessage: Here it is. Take this failed item and your rings of Strength and Dexterety to him, and he will reward you. Alvin is my trusted assistant. Theodore, if you can find him, is not to be trusted ;-)

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: Hello there? How are you? Good. Now SCRAM! I only talk to people who are sent by Darmbrin, and who own the Air Kingdom.
quests.completionMessage: Ah, so you were sent by Darmbrin to unite the clan, that is very noble.
quests.hint: Talk to Darmbrin, own the Air Kingdom

quests.title: Step 1
quests.description: First of all, I need to find out if this offer is genuine, kill 10 Gustlaz to gain my trust. And remember that you need to keep control of the Air Kingdom.
quests.completionMessage: Good work, but I"m afraid I have some bad news.

quests.title: Step 2
quests.description: I"ve lost my sacred clan item, and I don"t know where it is, to find out, I need to mix up a seer"s mix, to do that, I need you to get me these plants. And you also need to keep control of the Air Kingdom.
quests.completionMessage: Ah yes, now I just mix these together, add some special water...And down it goes! *gulp* *gulp*

quests.title: Step 3
quests.description: I see a rolling bug, rolling all alone on a hill...It"s close to a mighty structure...And a cave...This bug has the item. Get the item and give it to Darmbrin.
quests.hint: A lone rollerbug, then to Darmbrin

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: Unless you"re sent by Darmbrin, and your clan owns the Air Kingdom, I don"t want, or need, to talk to you.
quests.completionMessage: Hello! Ah, Darmbrin sent you. To unite the clan you say? I could really use some help first.
quests.hint: Take over Air Kingdom, talk to Darmbrin

quests.title: Brill - Step 1
quests.description: You see, Darmbrin exiled me, he made me an outcast. For me to come crawling back to him would take some good will. I need you to kill 10 Amberlaz to show this good will.
quests.completionMessage: Ah, this shows that the will behind this effort is strong. I need something else as well before I can give you my item, and come crawling back to Darmbrin.

quests.title: Brill - Step 2
quests.description: I need 10 of each of the following, Quadune Bud, Quadearth Bud, Quadoty bud.
quests.completionMessage: Ah, you have the buds? I"ll take those then, thank you.

quests.title: Brill - Step 3
quests.description: The truth is, I don"t actually have the item, it got stolen by some pesky Godions, get it back, return it to Darmbrin, and please don"t tell him I lost it.
quests.hint: Kill Godions for item, then to Darmbrin

quests.title: Intro
quests.description: You"re not welcome here, take over the Air Kingdom, and talk to Darmbrin in the fortress.
quests.completionMessage: Ah, so you are sent by Darmbrin. I will most gladly help unite the clan.
quests.hint: Take over AK, talk to Darmbrin

quests.title: Step 1
quests.description: I have heard what you have done for the others, and I need some Necrolaz shells to bring to Darmbrin as a peace offering. Get the Necrolaz shells, and keep control of the Air Kingdom.
quests.completionMessage: There we go, that is good. I unfortunately need something else from you as well.

quests.title: Step 2
quests.description: I need you to bring me some amulets of protection, so I can keep up with my clan mates when we go hunting, get me the amulets and rings I need, and keep control of the Air Kingdom. Don"t tell anybody else, but the Lontaun comes from a wright in Black Market.
quests.completionMessage: Great work! Now, there is just one last thing I need you to do, before we"re done.
quests.hint: Get the protective amulets and rings

quests.title: Step 3
quests.description: I have placed the item somewhere safe, it"s hidden in a chest, in a room of great peril. I need you to get the contents of this chest. I have entrusted the key with the Ascherions, I think they have taken it to their leader in the Stone Maze.
quests.hint: Take Ascherion leader key and find safe

quests.completionMessage: Here you go dear sir, your reward for helping our great clan rise again!
quests.hint: Talk to Darmbrin, own Air Kingdom

quests.title: Intro
quests.completionMessage: "Hello! I"m Hrestonas, Uspoans long-lost brother! I"ve taken over half of his business, I need some items from you in order to reward you with a shiny new weapon to strike your foes and protect your friends with!"

quests.title: Scavenger Hunt: Part 2 of 2
quests.description: "This hunt will be more difficult than the one you got from my brother. I need a belt from a flob, a jewel that is blue, a sample of a certain kind of ore that I desire, a hammer in need of repair, the dark egg with the shortest name, something that can be used to start a fire, and the Rune from the greater spider-lord. Good luck!"
quests.completionMessage: "You are amazing! These are exactly the items I requested. Here is my token.  Take this to Mooggle. He will redeem it for your new mint-condition weapon."  [More]
quests.hint: Take careful notes unless you want to come back

quests.title: Just one more thing
quests.description: "You found everything I could think of! Well, except for this axe I had been wanting. It is hard to come by. See if you can figure out which one I am talking about."
quests.completionMessage: "Hey, is that the Gisgis Axe? You are truly amazing! That will be a great addition to my collection. Here"s a little something to jingle in your pockets. Now I need to think up some new things for people to hunt. Let me just remind you before you go..." [More]
quests.hint: Which axe could I be thinking of?

quests.title: How to Trade....
quests.completionMessage: First you can hit "ESC" to show the options on the right hand of the screen.

quests.title: Trade
quests.completionMessage: To trade with another player select the "TRADE" button and you will see a list of players in the same zone as you. Select the player name you wish to trade with.

quests.title: Trade1
quests.completionMessage: A trade message will show up on that players interface next to the compass. Once they click on the trade invite a trade window will open for both the players along with your inventory.

quests.title: Trade2
quests.completionMessage: Select the item and chose how many of that type of item you wish to trade if its a stacked item and click on the "ADD" button. The item will then show up on your trade window. add as many items as you wish to trade to this player.

quests.title: Trade3
quests.completionMessage: After you have added everything you wish to trade select the "OFFER" button and wait for the other player to offer his items before selecting the "ACCEPT" button. Once the other player selects offer you will see the items he is trading in the trade window.

quests.title: Trade4
quests.completionMessage: Now select the "ACCEPT" button and the trade will be complete. You will see a confirmation box on your screen.

quests.title: Clans
quests.completionMessage: Hit "ESC" to show the options on the right side of the screen. Then select "CLAN"

quests.title: clan1
quests.completionMessage: To create a clan select the "CREATE" button on the clan box. Then type in the name for your clan and select "OK".

quests.title: clan2
quests.completionMessage: if you want to join a clan the clan leader must be in the same zone as you. In the clan box select the clan leaders name from the list and click on the "OK" button. The clan leader will get a request next to his compass on his interface. He can then accept or decline your request.

quests.title: Fly
quests.completionMessage: First you will need to equip a Jet pack or a set of wings. Hit the "F5" button to open your inventory. Select the Jet Pack or Wings from your inventory. You can then add them to the Quick bar and equip them with a number key shown under the item on the quick bar or equip them directly from the inventory by selecting the "EQUIP" button.

quests.title: Fly1
quests.completionMessage: If they do not equip set your chat box tab to "COMBAT" If an item does not equip this tab will tell you if it is not for your race or if you do not have the skills yet to use it.

quests.title: Fly2
quests.completionMessage: Once you have the Jet Pack or Wings equipped the default key to use it is the "RIGHT MOUSE" button. Hold the button down to maintain flight. Jet Packs do not fly forever, they have a duration and take time when not in use to recharge. Refer to the JETPACK bar on your interface in the lower right corner of the screen.

quests.title: Options
quests.completionMessage: Hit "ESC" to show the menu on the right side of the screen. Select the "OPTIONS" button to bring up a box with 4 primary game options. "QUIT" will close the game. "RETURN" will close the options box. "TOGGLE FPS" will display the FPS on the game screen. and "PREFERENCES" will open a box to allow you to change some of the interface settings.

quests.title: Preferences
quests.completionMessage: In the Preferences box you will see a list of interactions and a key they are bound to. Do not click on an interaction unless you wish to change the key it is bound to. If you do select an interaction the very next button you push will be set to this specific interaction. (WARNING) If you choose a key that is already bound to another interaction that interaction will now be "UNBOUND"

quests.title: Preferences1
quests.completionMessage: You can also adjust the music volume, and mouse Sensitivity in this box. An invert Mouse option is also available.

quests.title: Preferences2
quests.completionMessage: For more advanced key bindings you can toggle the Multibind option to "TRUE". If you do this you will be able to bind more then one key to an interaction as well as more then one interaction to a specific key. If you do not like the preferences you have set you can also reset them back to their defaults by selecting the "DEFAULT" button.

quests.title: Quickbar
quests.completionMessage: The Quickbar is located under the compass in the lower center of your screen. First hit "F5" to open your inventory. Select the item you wish to add to the quickbar and click on the "ADD TO QUICKBAR" button. The item selected will show up on your quickbar in the first available slot.

quests.title: Quickbar1
quests.completionMessage: The number under the item slot is bound to that item and by hitting the number on your keyboard will use it. Items like armor and weapons will equip. Items like Shape Shifting orbs, and Familiar scrolls, and vehicals will activate them. items like Magic scrolls will cast the spell.

quests.title: Quickbar2
quests.completionMessage: You can remove items from your quick bar by opening your inventory and selecting the item copy ON YOUR QUICK BAR. once you select the copy shown on your quickbar the "ADD TO QUICKBAR" button will change to "REMOVE FROM QUICKBAR". Select the button and the item will no longer be on your quickbar.

quests.title: Groups
quests.completionMessage: First hit "F5" to open the options on the right side of the screen. Then select the "GROUP" button. a create box will open. Type in the name you wish to call your group and select the "OK" button. A group window will open in the upper right corner of your screen.

quests.title: Groups1
quests.completionMessage: You can then invite others to join your group. Type in the players name and select the "INVITE" button. The invited player will then be able to accept or decline your group invite. Once they accept their name will be added to the list in your group box.

quests.title: Groups2
quests.completionMessage: The group leader can promote others within the group to be the new leader by selecting the name from the list and then selecting the "PROMOTE" button. You can leave a group by selecting the "LEAVE" button or if you are the leader you can remove others by selecting their name from the list and then selecting the "REMOVE" button.

quests.title: Groups3
quests.completionMessage: While you are in a group you can see the Hit points of the other members in your group. and all members of your group can loot any creature you kill while you are in the group.

quests.title: Intro
quests.completionMessage: Welcome to Endless Ages. This is the Newbie Training grounds. here you will learn how to survive in the main world. These signs will teach you the primary interaction functions. You can examin them by hitting the "X" hot key. You can change your examin hot key once you learn about the preferances. Please explore and have fun!
